style_layer.core: Massive chunky 3D block letters with heavyweight extruded presence — thick uniform extrusion depth of 50-60% of letter height. Front face finished in ultra-glossy lacquer, catching directional key light with natural specular reflections that graduate from bright highlight to deep saturated color — the surface quality of hard candy coating or high-gloss toy paint. Side extrusion planes in a noticeably darker shade of the same hue, creating crisp face-to-depth contrast that reads immediately as three-dimensional volume. Adjacent letters each carry a different vivid saturated color, maximizing chromatic contrast across the word — no two adjacent letters share the same hue family. Hard sharp corner edges where face meets extrusion, no beveling. Long dramatic cast shadows at consistent 45-degree angle, shadow depth approximately 40-50% of letter height. Strong directional key light from upper left. Bold, high-contrast, maximum visual impact. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the glossy 3D extrusion, the directional lighting and the multi-color scheme. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as thick glossy extruded 3D blocks with hard candy-lacquer faces and darker extrusion sides. COLOR PRIORITY: if the font specifies its own colors, keep them; otherwise give each adjacent letter a different vivid saturated hue.
style_layer.scene: Massive colorful 3D block letters centered in frame, filling 75-80% of width. Each letter in a different vivid saturated color — ultra-glossy candy lacquer surface with bright circular specular highlight at center, darker extrusion sides clearly visible. Long parallel cast shadows at 45 degrees. Strong key light from upper left. Background: deep dark studio with rich atmospheric depth — subtle color gradients from warm amber to cool blue, faint volumetric haze, hints of environmental color bleed from the letters. Polished dark floor below letters showing clean mirror reflections of each letter's color. Camera: frontal view, slight low elevation. Letters fill the frame with commanding presence.

style_layer.core: Iridescent chrome surface with oil-slick rainbow spectral shift — diffractive grating physics producing pink-to-violet-to-cyan-to-gold color drift across facing planes, like metallized polyester film catching directional light. style_layer.scene: Centered composition. Iridescent 3D letters filling approximately 70% of frame width. Pure black background. Volumetric studio lighting from upper-left, razor-sharp specular highlights on bevel ridges. Oil-slick rainbow drift across front-facing planes — hot pink transitions through deep violet to electric cyan. Deep cast shadows on ground plane.

style_layer.scene: Vivid Y2K candy colors, hyper-glossy inflated surface with strong circular specular highlights at each convex peak. Pastel gradient or dark candy-store studio background. Ambient occlusion in letter crevices, soft drop shadow below. Joyful party energy, maximum visual impact.

description.de: Shōnen-Manga-Titelschrift: dicke, von Hand getuschte schwarze Konturen, flaches Cel-Shading in harten Licht- und Schattenbändern, schräg gestellte, dynamische Buchstaben auf Weiß mit strahlenförmigen Speedlines.

style_layer.core: rendered as Japanese shounen anime title treatment — bold hand-inked manga lettering with authentic cel-shaded visual energy. Letter construction follows classic shounen manga title card standards: thick black ink outline with natural brush-weight variation defining each letter boundary; flat cel-shading fill with three hard-edge zones — bright highlight zone on upper letter face, highly saturated primary color zone at center, deep shadow zone at lower edge; all zone boundaries knife-edge hard, zero gradient blur, pure flat offset-print ink physics. Energy signature: high-contrast color + thick ink outline = letters that look physically printed on manga paper. The typographic language of classic shounen anime title cards — maximum manga kinetic energy, iconic and immediately recognizable as Japanese anime title typography. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the inked manga outline, the three-zone cel-shading and the kinetic energy. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as bold hand-inked shounen title lettering with a thick black brush outline and hard three-zone cel-shading. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise a high-saturation primary fill with hard highlight and shadow zones.
style_layer.scene: Pure white background with dense radial manga speed lines exploding outward from behind the letter cluster — classic shounen manga title impact panel composition. Speed lines radiating from a concentrated burst point directly behind the text, transitioning to sparser lines toward frame edges. Scattered sharp manga star-burst impact marks and angular emphasis symbols around letters. High contrast: black ink speed lines on pure white background — maximum manga print energy, like a chapter title page from a weekly manga magazine.

description.pt: Personagens anime originais com olhos grandes e brilhantes, lineart limpo e sombreamento cel ou suave, sobre céus pastel, terraços ao pôr do sol ou ruas chuvosas à noite, em pastel ou preto, branco e vermelho.
description.de: Eigene Anime-Figuren mit großen, glänzenden Augen, sauberem Lineart und Cel- oder weicher Schattierung vor Pastellhimmel, Dach im Sonnenuntergang oder verregneter Nachtstraße, in Pastell oder Schwarz, Weiß und Rot.

style_layer.core: original anime-style character art people use as a profile picture, a matching couple or best-friend pfp pair, a phone wallpaper, a sticker or a chat-server banner. CHARACTERS: original characters, head-and-shoulders or half-body facing the viewer (chibi stickers two to three heads tall); large expressive eyes with layered irises and two white catchlights; hair in clean clumped locks with a glossy highlight band; small simple nose and mouth; light blush. LINE AND SHADING: clean line art, heavier on the silhouette; flat cel shading with one hard shadow tone, or soft airbrushed anime shading with a thin rim light. BACKGROUND: a pastel sky with cumulus clouds, a sunset rooftop with a chain-link fence, drifting cherry blossom petals or a rainy night street with bokeh lights, softly blurred. COMPOSITION: every face centred and fully inside a circle crop; for a matching pair the wide image splits into two equal halves, one person centred in each, same style, palette and background across both, poses that answer each other (two halves of a heart, one shared sky), nothing important on the centre line. Any name or short word stays small in a corner, away from faces. TIERS: the soft slice-of-life tier is pastel pink, sky blue and cream in daylight or golden sunset; the dark moody tier is black, white and grey with heavy ink shadows, screentone grain and exactly one red accent (eyes, a ribbon or a red thread). LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the tier palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the character, shading, backdrop and tier palette always fill the picture around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit small over the illustration in the tier's own light with a faint soft shadow.

description.de: Goldene Serifenversalien im warmen Kerzenlicht vor dunkelblauem Samt, umgeben von Stumpenkerzen, Rosenblättern und weichem Bokeh.

style_layer.core:
Intimate candlelit ceremony light field — primary illumination from clusters of tall ivory pillar candles positioned just outside the frame, casting warm amber-orange directional light at 30–45 degrees with the organic pulse of real open flame; this raking warm light catches all forward-facing surfaces while the surrounding environment recedes into rich warm shadow. Background: deep jewel tones — midnight navy, deep burgundy, warm obsidian — that absorb most available light and create maximum luminance contrast around any illuminated subject. Secondary fill: a diffuse rose-gold or warm champagne light from the opposite side at 20–30% of key intensity, preserving shadow depth without flattening it.

Background atmosphere: champagne glass rims refracting amber light into vertical streaks, rose petal edges catching warm highlights, crystal chandelier droplets resolving into circular bokeh halos, wax candle surfaces with subtle orange-amber surface glow — all at extreme shallow depth of field, contributing warmth and occasion as pure bokeh shapes without competing with the illuminated subject.

Color temperature consistently warm throughout at 2800–3200K. Deep jewel-tone backgrounds (midnight blue, burgundy, charcoal) provide maximum luminance contrast. Subtle warm vignette darkens frame edges. The atmosphere of a private ceremony: intimate, still, held against time.

When no specific material is defined by the font: warm candlelight from 40-degree upper-left, deep midnight blue or burgundy background with soft warm vignette, champagne glass and rose petal bokeh at low opacity in background.
style_layer.scene:
Intimate ceremony setting, candlelit and private. The text occupies center frame — formal title-card placement at 60–70% of composition width, set slightly above the vertical midpoint for visual dignity. Against a near-black deep jewel-tone background, the text is the sole illuminated subject.

Flanking the text at extreme shallow focus: tall ivory pillar candles with active amber flames, becoming warm bokeh halos at this depth of field. Lower frame corners: deep crimson roses with petals catching candlelight, soft-defocused, purely atmospheric. A champagne coupe rim catches light in the background — a single arc of refracted warmth, nothing more.

The surface beneath is deep dark, absorbing all ambient light. No cool tones anywhere in the frame. The complete color vocabulary: amber, deep gold, burgundy, midnight blue.

Two-line text: upper line as primary heading at full visual weight, lower line as supporting datum (year, name, or subtitle) at 65% of the primary line's scale. Single-word or single-number compositions: text expands to 75–80% of frame width, background environment fills the surrounding space naturally.

description.zh: 华丽的1920年代 Art Deco 装饰艺术字体——几何对称、抛光金与铬、黑金漆面上的旭日纹样。
description.es: Tipografía Art Deco opulenta de los años 20 — simetría geométrica, oro y cromo pulidos, motivos de sol radiante sobre laca negra y dorada.
description.pt: Tipografia Art Deco opulenta dos anos 20 — simetria geométrica, ouro e cromo polidos, motivos de sol radiante sobre laca preta e dourada.
description.de: Opulente Art-Deco-Typografie der 1920er — geometrische Symmetrie, poliertes Gold und Chrom, Sonnenstrahl-Motive auf schwarz-goldenem Lack.

style_layer.core: an opulent 1920s Art Deco piece — geometric, symmetrical and luxurious. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is finished as polished Art Deco metalwork — warm gold and cool chrome with fine engraved pinlines and engine-turned guilloche, set into black or deep-navy lacquer with sharp beveled facets. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: symmetrical sunburst, fan and stepped-skyscraper motifs radiating around the lettering, a single dramatic directional spotlight, the optimistic glamour of a Jazz Age theatre marquee. PALETTE: black and deep navy grounds with rich gold, champagne and mirror chrome, plus optional emerald or oxblood accents — opulent and high-contrast, never pale or muddy. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (Art Deco gold, machine-age chrome, deco display, ornate or wide serif, gold leaf), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the gold-and-chrome metalwork, the sunburst/fan/stepped motifs, the lacquer ground and the spotlight scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as polished gold-and-chrome Art Deco metal with fine pinline engraving and beveled facets on a black lacquer ground, framed by a symmetrical sunburst, so the 1920s deco luxury always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits bold and symmetrical, finished in polished gold and chrome Art Deco metalwork with fine engraved pinlines, a symmetrical sunburst or stepped fan motif radiating behind it on a black or deep-navy lacquer ground under a single dramatic spotlight. Opulent, optimistic 1920s Jazz Age glamour.

style_layer.core: a bright, high-energy birthday celebration scene — vivid, saturated and punchy. BACKGROUND: bright and celebratory but with REAL color saturation — a bold party backdrop such as a vivid candy-color field, a rich saturated gradient (e.g. hot-pink into tangerine, or turquoise into violet), or a confetti-packed party sky; luminous and cheerful, never muddy or grey, but NOT a washed-out pale pastel wash and NOT a flat near-white ground — enough color and contrast for the text to pop off the background. Bright lively party light with sparkling glints. ATMOSPHERE: a dense energetic burst of multicolor confetti and generous clustered balloons framing the composition, sparkles and light streaks — festive and high-energy, keeping the text clearly legible. LETTERFORM COLOR: when the chosen font defines its own color (rainbow, foil, candy, neon, holographic) keep it fully — bold multi-color and per-letter rainbow are welcome and encouraged; otherwise render the letters in vivid saturated party colors, either bright multi-color (each letter or word a different punchy hue) or one or two bold dominant hues, always with strong contrast and a crisp white outline or soft drop shadow so the letters pop. Never dull, washed-out or muddy. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (balloon, bubble, foil, script, sticker, rainbow, neon, drip, candy), that treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs only the bright saturated party light, confetti, balloons and palette — never the letter shapes. FALLBACK: if the font carries no material of its own, render bold glossy party lettering with a crisp outline and bright highlight in vivid saturated colors, so the birthday energy reads strong. GROUND: keep the space bright (not a dark night stage) but rich with saturated color, never pale or empty. Render the exact text provided, with no extra or altered words.
style_layer.scene: A bright, high-energy birthday scene on a vivid saturated party background — bold candy color or a rich party gradient (not a pale pastel wash, not near-white), with dense multicolor confetti bursting through the air and generous balloon clusters framing the edges, sparkles and light streaks. Strong color and contrast so the text pops. Festive, punchy, joyful party energy.

description.en: Vibrant rainbow cartoon birthday text effects designed for children. Each letter in a different bright saturated color, chunky bubble shapes, colorful balloons and confetti explosions. Perfect for kids birthday cards, party banners and 1st birthday celebrations.
description.ja: 子ども向けにデザインした、鮮やかなレインボーのカートゥーン風バースデー文字エフェクトです。1文字ごとに異なる明るく彩度の高い色を使い、ぷっくりとしたバブル型の文字、カラフルな風船や紙吹雪の弾ける演出で仕上げています。子どものバースデーカードやパーティーバナー、1歳の誕生日祝いにぴったりです。
description.zh: 专为孩子设计的活泼彩虹卡通生日文字特效。每个字母一种明亮饱和的颜色，胖乎乎的泡泡字形，还有五彩气球和撒满屏幕的彩纸。做儿童生日贺卡、派对横幅和周岁庆典都超合适。
description.es: Efectos de texto de cumpleaños con dibujos animados y colores arcoíris vibrantes, pensados para niños. Cada letra en un color brillante y saturado distinto, formas de burbuja gorditas, globos de colores y explosiones de confeti. Ideal para tarjetas de cumpleaños infantiles, pancartas de fiesta y celebraciones del primer añito.
description.pt: Efeitos de texto de aniversário em estilo desenho animado com cores de arco-íris vibrantes, feitos para crianças. Cada letra numa cor brilhante e saturada diferente, formas de bolha fofinhas, balões coloridos e explosões de confete. Perfeito para cartões de aniversário infantil, faixas de festa e comemorações de primeiro aninho.
description.de: Knallbunte Cartoon-Geburtstags-Texteffekte für Kinder. Jeder Buchstabe in einer anderen leuchtenden, satten Farbe, dicke Blasenformen, bunte Luftballons und Konfetti-Explosionen. Perfekt für Kindergeburtstagskarten, Partybanner und Feiern zum 1. Geburtstag.

style_layer.core: rendered in kids birthday cartoon style with vibrant rainbow colors. Each letter in a different bright saturated color (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple cycling). Smooth shiny surfaces with highlight reflections. Large colorful cartoon balloons in multiple colors. Colorful star bursts, hearts, and confetti explosion. Maximum saturation, maximum fun energy. Children party illustration aesthetic. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the cartoon rainbow color, the shiny surfaces and the festive party scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as glossy cartoon letters each in a different bright saturated color, with balloons, confetti and starbursts. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise cycle bright rainbow hues (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple).
style_layer.scene: Bright white background with colorful confetti raining down, natural party daylight, festive streamers loosely framing the edges.

names.ja: ラグジュアリーバースデー

description.en: Elegant gold foil text on deep dark backgrounds. Premium birthday effects with minimal decoration — no colorful confetti, just refined gold lettering and subtle sparkle for milestone celebrations and high-end cards.
description.ja: 深く暗い背景に映える、上品な金箔の文字。カラフルな紙吹雪を使わず、洗練された金の文字とほのかな輝きだけで仕上げる、ミニマルな装飾のプレミアムなバースデーエフェクトです。節目のお祝いや高級感のあるカードに最適です。
description.zh: 深色底上的优雅烫金文字。极简装饰的高端生日特效——没有花哨的彩色纸屑，只有精致的金色字体和淡淡的闪光，为重要生日和高端贺卡而生。
description.es: Texto en pan de oro elegante sobre fondos oscuros y profundos. Efectos de cumpleaños premium con decoración mínima: nada de confeti colorido, solo letras doradas refinadas y un brillo sutil para celebrar grandes ocasiones y tarjetas de alta gama.
description.pt: Texto em folha de ouro elegante sobre fundos escuros e profundos. Efeitos de aniversário premium com decoração mínima: nada de confete colorido, só letras douradas refinadas e um brilho sutil para grandes comemorações e cartões sofisticados.
description.de: Elegante Goldfolien-Schrift auf tiefdunklem Hintergrund. Edle Geburtstagseffekte mit minimaler Deko — kein buntes Konfetti, nur raffinierte Goldschrift und dezentes Funkeln für runde Geburtstage und hochwertige Karten.

style_layer.core: rendered in luxury gold foil birthday style. Letters in premium metallic gold — gradient from bright gold highlight to deep warm shadow, subtle surface sheen and fine gold dust particles. Clean minimal composition — no colorful confetti, no colored balloons. Optional fine gold border frame or minimal gold star scatter (≤8 pieces). Wide letter spacing. High contrast gold-on-dark. Premium printing quality aesthetic. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the metallic gold-foil material, the sheen and the minimal composition. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as premium metallic gold-foil letters with a gradient from bright highlight to warm shadow, fine gold dust and a minimal layout. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise high-contrast gold-on-dark with no colorful confetti.
style_layer.scene: Luxury dark backdrop — deep velvet, dark marble, or rich jewel-toned surface with subtle texture. Loose gold leaf flakes scattered around the text. Premium minimal composition, wide letter spacing, soft warm ambient glow.

description.en: Chinese sumi ink brush calligraphy style applied to Latin letterforms. Deep black ink with authentic bristle texture, thick-to-thin stroke variation, and rice paper atmosphere. Perfect for Chinese restaurant branding, martial arts, wellness, and cultural design.
description.ja: 中国の墨（すみ）による筆文字書道のスタイルをラテン文字に応用しました。深い黒墨に本物の筆先の質感、太細のはっきりした筆致の変化、そして画仙紙の趣を備えています。中華レストランのブランディング、武術、ウェルネス、文化的なデザインに最適です。
description.zh: 把中国水墨毛笔书法的笔意用到拉丁字母上。浓黑墨色，真实的笔锋纹理，粗细变化的运笔，还有宣纸的气息。特别适合中餐品牌、武术、养生和文化类设计。
description.es: El estilo de la caligrafía china con pincel de tinta sumi llevado a las letras latinas. Negro profundo con textura auténtica de cerdas, trazos que van de grueso a fino y ese aire de papel de arroz. Perfecto para marcas de restaurantes chinos, artes marciales, bienestar y diseño cultural.
description.pt: O estilo da caligrafia chinesa com pincel de tinta sumi aplicado às letras latinas. Preto profundo com textura autêntica de cerdas, traços que vão do grosso ao fino e aquele ar de papel de arroz. Perfeito para marcas de restaurantes chineses, artes marciais, bem-estar e design cultural.
description.de: Chinesische Sumi-Tuschekalligrafie im Pinselstil, übertragen auf lateinische Buchstaben. Tiefschwarze Tusche mit authentischer Borstentextur, von dick zu dünn variierenden Strichen und Reispapier-Atmosphäre. Perfekt für das Branding chinesischer Restaurants, Kampfkunst, Wellness und kulturelles Design.

style_layer.core: rendered in Chinese ink brush calligraphy style. Letterforms painted with a fully loaded sumi ink brush — deep black ink, visible bristle marks along stroke edges, wet ink pooling at stroke starts, feathered dry-brush trailing ends. Authentic ink density variation: thick rich black cores fading to grey at thin passages. Rice paper texture visible behind. Traditional Chinese calligraphy energy — each stroke confident, intentional, irreversible. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the sumi ink medium, the bristle and ink-density behavior and the rice-paper ground. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as deep black sumi brush strokes with visible bristle marks, wet ink pooling at stroke starts and feathered dry-brush trails on rice paper. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise rich black ink fading to grey at thin passages.
style_layer.scene: On aged cream rice paper with subtle washi fiber texture, soft diffused natural light from above. Ink bleeds slightly at edges creating natural halo. Quiet contemplative atmosphere.

description.en: Raw dry brush and paint brush lettering with heavy texture, bristle spread, and imperfect grain. Bold paint-loaded strokes, grungy distressed edges, and authentic hand-painted energy. Perfect for streetwear, music branding, sports, packaging, and any project needing raw tactile power.
description.ja: 強いテクスチャ、毛先の広がり、不均一なかすれを持つ、生々しいドライブラシとペイントブラシのレタリングです。塗料をたっぷり含んだ力強いストローク、ざらついた荒れたエッジ、本物の手描きならではのエネルギーを備えています。ストリートウェア、音楽ブランディング、スポーツ、パッケージ、そして荒々しく手触りのある力強さを必要とするあらゆるプロジェクトに最適です。
description.zh: 原始的干笔刷、油漆刷字体，带着浓重的纹理、刷毛散开的痕迹和不完美的颗粒感。饱蘸颜料的粗犷笔触、做旧磨损的边缘，还有地道的手绘能量。街头潮牌、音乐品牌、运动、包装，以及任何需要原始触感冲击力的项目都很搭。
description.es: Letras crudas de pincel seco y brocha con textura marcada, cerdas abiertas y grano imperfecto. Trazos cargados de pintura, bordes desgastados y ásperos, y auténtica energía pintada a mano. Ideal para streetwear, marcas de música, deportes, packaging y cualquier proyecto que necesite fuerza cruda y táctil.
description.pt: Letras cruas de pincel seco e brocha com textura pesada, cerdas abertas e granulado imperfeito. Traços carregados de tinta, bordas gastas e ásperas, e energia autêntica pintada à mão. Perfeito para streetwear, marcas de música, esportes, embalagens e qualquer projeto que precise de força crua e tátil.
description.de: Rohe Pinsel Schrift im Trockenpinsel-Look mit kräftiger Textur, gespreizten Borsten und unregelmäßiger Körnung. Farbgeladene Striche, raue, ramponierte Kanten und echte handgemalte Energie. Perfekt für Streetwear, Musik-Branding, Sport, Verpackung und jedes Projekt, das rohe, greifbare Wucht braucht.

style_layer.core: rendered in dry brush paint style. Bold letterforms created with a heavily loaded paint brush — thick impasto strokes with visible bristle spread across each letterform surface. Raw gritty texture throughout: individual bristle lines visible, rough torn edges where paint runs thin, paint buildup at stroke centers. Distressed grain and organic imperfection in every mark. High-contrast raw paint energy. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the dry-brush paint medium, the bristle texture and the raw gritty grain. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as thick impasto dry-brush strokes with visible bristle spread, rough torn thin edges and paint buildup at stroke centers. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise a single bold raw off-black paint.
style_layer.scene: On rough textured paper or aged wood surface. Paint slightly glistening at stroke centers, matte and dry at edges. Raw, physical, hand-painted atmosphere.

description.en: Japanese Shodo ink brush calligraphy style applied to Latin letterforms. Deep sumi black ink with authentic fude brush energy, controlled single-direction strokes, and washi paper atmosphere. Perfect for Japanese restaurant branding, tattoo design, anime, martial arts, and cultural projects.
description.ja: 日本の書道の墨筆による筆致をラテン文字に応用したスタイルです。深い墨黒のインクに本格的な筆のエネルギー、一方向に制御された筆運び、そして和紙の雰囲気が宿ります。日本食レストランのブランディング、タトゥーデザイン、アニメ、武道、文化系プロジェクトに最適です。
description.zh: 把日本书道的水墨毛笔笔法用到拉丁字母上。浓黑的墨汁配上地道的毛笔笔势、单向可控的运笔，还有和纸的质感。做日料店品牌、纹身设计、动漫、武道和文化类项目都特别合适。
description.es: El estilo de caligrafía con pincel de tinta del shodo japonés llevado a las letras latinas. Tinta sumi negra y profunda con la energía auténtica del pincel fude, trazos controlados en una sola dirección y atmósfera de papel washi. Perfecto para marcas de restaurantes japoneses, diseño de tatuajes, anime, artes marciales y proyectos culturales.
description.pt: O estilo de caligrafia com pincel de tinta do shodo japonês aplicado às letras latinas. Tinta sumi preta e profunda com a energia autêntica do pincel fude, traços controlados numa única direção e atmosfera de papel washi. Perfeito para marcas de restaurantes japoneses, design de tatuagem, anime, artes marciais e projetos culturais.
description.de: Japanischer Shodo-Tuschepinsel-Kalligrafiestil, angewendet auf lateinische Buchstaben. Tiefes Sumi-Schwarz mit authentischer Fude-Pinselenergie, kontrollierten Strichen in eine Richtung und Washi-Papier-Atmosphäre. Perfekt für das Branding japanischer Restaurants, Tattoo-Design, Anime, Kampfkunst und kulturelle Projekte.

style_layer.core:
Japanese ink brush aesthetic — the visual language of sumi calligraphy on washi paper.

INK MEDIUM: sumi pigment in deep black to charcoal range — richest density at mark centers, naturally transitioning outward as ink supply depletes. Fully matte, absorbed into paper surface, producing a tonal range from dense opaque black to transparent grey depending on dilution and brush load.

PAPER SURFACE: natural washi — warm cream-white base with visible paper fiber structure giving slight texture. The absorbent surface creates the characteristic soft border quality of East Asian brush work at all mark edges.

LIGHT ATMOSPHERE: soft diffuse north-facing studio light — the traditional calligrapher's light source. Even, shadowless, allowing the full tonal range of ink marks to read clearly. Warm cream paper tone contrasts against deep sumi black.

AESTHETIC REGISTER: the ma principle — the space between and around marks is as considered as the marks themselves. Compositions have breathing room and deliberate quietness.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default environment — deep sumi black marks on warm cream washi paper, soft diffuse overhead light, meditative studio atmosphere.
style_layer.scene: Text fills the frame, large and centered on natural washi paper surface. Soft diffuse north-facing studio light from above, even and shadowless. Sparse composition with generous white space — the quietness of a Japanese calligraphy studio.

names.ja: ブラッシュスクリプト

description.en: Western brush script with connected letters: thick pressure downstrokes, hairline upstrokes, visible bristle streaks and dry-brush trails in warm off-black ink on textured paper.
description.ja: 文字がつながる西洋の筆記体。筆圧の強い太い下ろし、髪の毛ほど細い上げ、筆の毛の筋とかすれを、温かみのある黒インクで質感のある紙に。
description.zh: 西式毛笔连写体：下笔重压粗、上挑细如发丝，可见笔毛纹理和枯笔拖尾，暖黑墨色落在纹理纸上。
description.es: Script de pincel occidental con letras enlazadas: trazos descendentes gruesos por presión, ascendentes finísimos, vetas visibles de las cerdas y rastros de pincel seco en tinta negra cálida sobre papel texturizado.
description.pt: Script de pincel ocidental com letras ligadas: traços descendentes grossos pela pressão, ascendentes finíssimos, marcas visíveis das cerdas e rastros de pincel seco em tinta preta quente sobre papel texturizado.
description.de: Westliche Pinselschrift mit verbundenen Buchstaben: kräftige Abstriche durch Druck, haarfeine Aufstriche, sichtbare Borstenspuren und Trockenpinsel-Ausläufe in warmer schwarzer Tinte auf strukturiertem Papier.

style_layer.core: rendered as expressive Western brush script lettering with fluid connected strokes. Visible bristle texture with authentic thick-to-thin pressure variation — thick downstrokes, thin upstrokes, just like a loaded calligraphy brush. Ink slightly wet and glistening. Natural ink pooling at stroke starts, feathered dry-brush ending trails. Warm off-black ink on visible surface texture. Hand-crafted artisan energy with real brush imperfection. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the brush-script medium, the thick-to-thin pressure variation and the ink wetness. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as fluid connected brush-script strokes with thick downstrokes, thin upstrokes, wet pooling at starts and feathered dry-brush trails in warm off-black ink. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise warm off-black ink on a textured surface.
style_layer.scene: On warm cream textured paper under soft diffused natural studio light from upper left. Subtle paper grain visible. Light warm shadow cast by letters. Artisan letterpress atmosphere.

description.en: Playful inflated bubble-letter typography — glossy candy gradients, shiny highlights and soft refraction. Perfect for bubble text, name art, stickers and kids designs.
description.ja: ぷっくり膨らんだバブルレター(風船文字)のタイポグラフィ。つやつやのキャンディグラデーション、光沢のあるハイライト、やわらかな屈折感が特徴です。バブルテキスト、名前アート、ステッカー、キッズ向けデザインにぴったりです。
description.zh: 俏皮膨胀的泡泡字排版——糖果光泽渐变、闪亮高光和柔和的折射感。特别适合泡泡文字、姓名艺术字、贴纸和儿童设计。
description.es: Tipografía juguetona de letras infladas tipo burbuja: degradados brillantes de dulce, reflejos relucientes y refracción suave. Perfecta para textos burbuja, arte con nombres, stickers y diseños para niños.
description.pt: Tipografia divertida de letras infladas em estilo bolha: degradês brilhantes de doce, brilhos reluzentes e refração suave. Perfeita para textos bolha, arte com nomes, stickers e designs infantis.
description.de: Verspielte, aufgeblasene Bubble-Buchstaben — glänzende Bonbon-Verläufe, spiegelnde Glanzlichter und weiche Lichtbrechung. Perfekt für Bubble-Schrift, Namenskunst, Sticker und Kinderdesigns.

style_layer.core: a playful inflated bubble-letter piece — glossy, soft and candy-bright. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is rendered as puffy inflated bubble forms with a soft translucent jelly-like material, a glossy reflective surface with bright highlight spots and gentle light refraction, rounded and pillowy. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a light cheerful setting — a soft gradient backdrop, floating bubbles and sparkle, an airy bubblegum mood. PALETTE: candy colors — bubblegum pink, lavender, sky blue, mint and lemon — bright, glossy and sweet, never dark or matte. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (bubble rounded, inflated bubble, bubble outline, bouncy display, candy drip), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the glossy inflated jelly material, the candy gradient and the airy bubble scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as puffy inflated glossy bubbles in a candy pink-purple-blue gradient with bright highlight spots and soft refraction, so the bubbly fun always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits puffy and glossy as inflated candy bubbles with bright highlight spots and soft light refraction, set against a light pastel gradient with floating bubbles and sparkle. Playful, sweet, airy bubblegum mood.

names.ja: モノクロ・エステティック

description.en: Moody black-and-white portraits cropped close in deep shadow, with hard side light, rain and smoke, heavy film grain, a soft vignette and at most one small red accent.
description.ja: 深い影の中に寄ったモノクロの人物、硬いサイド光、雨と煙、強いフィルムグレイン、やわらかな周辺減光、赤は最大でひとつだけ。
description.zh: 深阴影里的近景黑白人像，硬侧光、雨和烟雾、浓重的胶片颗粒、柔和暗角，最多一处小小的红色点缀。
description.es: Retratos en blanco y negro muy cerca y en sombra profunda, con luz lateral dura, lluvia y humo, grano de película intenso, viñeta suave y como mucho un detalle rojo.
description.pt: Retratos em preto e branco bem de perto e em sombra profunda, com luz lateral dura, chuva e fumaça, granulação forte de filme, vinheta suave e no máximo um detalhe vermelho.
description.de: Stimmungsvolle Schwarz-Weiß-Porträts nah und im tiefen Schatten, mit hartem Seitenlicht, Regen und Rauch, starkem Filmkorn, weicher Vignette und höchstens einem kleinen roten Akzent.

style_layer.core: the kind of moody black-and-white picture people set as a profile picture, split into a matching pair for two accounts, use as a phone wallpaper or put on a poster or album cover. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: one subject large and close, usually a face or figure in three-quarter view or seen from behind, cropped tight with deep black space around it; rain streaks, drifting smoke, wet city-night reflections, blurred street lights or a lone window as the setting. For a matching pair the canvas splits into two equal halves, each half a complete square portrait with its face centred in that half, the two figures turned toward each other or sharing one continuous background (one umbrella, one street, one moon). LIGHT: hard single-source side light carving half the face out of darkness, crushed blacks, bright highlights on wet hair, rain and skin. COLOUR: pure black, white and greys only; optionally ONE small deep red accent (a rose, lips, a scarf, a red thread) in one place per picture, one per half in a pair. TEXTURE: visible film grain over the whole image and a soft dark vignette at the corners. TIERS: the ink illustration tier is a manga-style inked portrait with solid brush-black hair, fine hatching and dot screentone shading on white paper; the film photo tier looks like grainy black-and-white photography, shallow depth of field, slight motion blur, pushed high-ISO grain. No real people, celebrities or brand logos. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the black, white and grey palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the black-and-white image, the film grain, the dark vignette and the hard side light always fill the picture around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit small and quiet in the dark negative space beside the subject, under the same hard side light.

description.en: Silver display capitals with crescent moons, stars and planet symbols inlaid into the letters, glowing under cold moonlight in a dark stone observatory.
description.ja: 三日月、星、惑星のシンボルを象嵌した銀色のディスプレイ大文字。暗い石造りの天文台で冷たい月光を受けて輝きます。
description.zh: 银色展示大写字母镶嵌新月、星星与行星符号，在幽暗石砌天文台的冷月光下发亮。
description.es: Mayúsculas plateadas con lunas crecientes, estrellas y símbolos de planetas incrustados, brillando bajo una fría luz de luna en un oscuro observatorio de piedra.
description.pt: Maiúsculas prateadas com luas crescentes, estrelas e símbolos de planetas incrustados, brilhando sob a fria luz da lua num observatório de pedra escuro.
description.de: Silberne Display-Versalien mit eingelegten Mondsicheln, Sternen und Planetensymbolen, leuchtend im kalten Mondlicht einer dunklen steinernen Sternwarte.

style_layer.core:
Mystical atmospheric environment — single cool directional key light from above, deep dark background with subtle environmental depth. The scene atmosphere is esoteric and otherworldly: cool, dark, symbolic. No warm ambient light, no daylight.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment — cold silver-white overhead key light, deep indigo-to-near-black atmospheric background, faint star field at very low opacity. Cool, ethereal, mystical night atmosphere.
style_layer.scene: centered against deep midnight indigo gradient, faint star field, soft overhead moonlight

description.en: Hand-lettered cream chalk on a dark slate board: mixed script and serif lines, flourishes and small doodles, soft chalk-dust edges under warm café lighting.
description.ja: 暗いスレート板に描いたクリーム色のチョーク手描き文字。筆記体とセリフ体の組み合わせに飾り線と小さな落書き、粉っぽい柔らかな輪郭、温かなカフェの照明。
description.zh: 深色石板上的奶油色粉笔手写字：手写体与衬线混排，配花饰和小涂鸦，粉笔边缘柔和带粉尘，暖调咖啡馆灯光。
description.es: Rotulación a mano con tiza crema sobre una pizarra oscura: líneas en script y serifa mezcladas, adornos y pequeños dibujos, bordes suaves con polvo de tiza bajo una cálida luz de cafetería.
description.pt: Letreiramento à mão em giz creme numa lousa escura: linhas em script e serifa misturadas, floreios e pequenos desenhos, bordas suaves com pó de giz sob a luz quente de um café.
description.de: Handgeschriebene cremefarbene Kreideschrift auf dunkler Schiefertafel: Schreibschrift und Serifen gemischt, Schnörkel und kleine Zeichnungen, weiche Kreidestaubkanten im warmen Café-Licht.

style_layer.core:
Chalkboard aesthetic — the visual language of artisan hand-lettering on dark board surfaces.

COLOR CLIMATE: high-contrast warmth defines the palette. Foreground marks: cream-white to warm ivory as the primary tone, with dusty pastel accents — soft coral, sage, lavender, warm mustard — for secondary decorative elements. Background ground: deep chalkboard green-black or charcoal slate. The dark ground is an active compositional element, not neutral filler.

LIGHT ATMOSPHERE: warm overhead ambient at cafe or classroom intensity — the quality of morning light through a cafe window or an evening vintage filament bulb above a pub specials board. Soft directional quality, revealing surface and dimension without creating harsh contrast. Warm, inviting, crafted.

DECORATIVE REGISTER: simple hand-drawn borders of dots, dashes, or double-ruled lines; small illustrative accents (arrows, stars, leaves, dividers); mixed-weight lettering styles on the same surface — all belong to the chalk aesthetic vocabulary and may appear in compositions.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment — warm overhead ambient, cream-white chalk tones against deep chalkboard green-black board ground, soft and matte in quality.
style_layer.scene: Text fills the frame, large and centered against a dark slate chalkboard surface within a wooden frame. Overhead light from above at a low angle. A hint of warm interior visible at the very edges of frame.

description.en: Super-deformed cute characters two to three heads tall with big shiny eyes and blush cheeks, thick soft line art, pastel cel colours and floating hearts, as stickers or cozy scenes.

description.zh: 两到三头身的Q版可爱角色，大而亮的眼睛和腮红，粗而柔的线稿，粉彩赛璐璐配色，漂浮的爱心，做成贴纸或温馨小场景。
description.es: Personajes tiernos superdeformados de dos a tres cabezas de alto, con ojos grandes y brillantes y mejillas rosadas, línea gruesa y suave, colores pastel y corazones flotando.
description.pt: Personagens fofos superdeformados de duas a três cabeças de altura, com olhos grandes e brilhantes e bochechas rosadas, traço grosso e macio, cores pastel e corações flutuando.
description.de: Superdeformierte niedliche Figuren, zwei bis drei Köpfe groß, mit großen glänzenden Augen und rosigen Wangen, dicker weicher Linie, Pastell-Cel-Farben und schwebenden Herzen.

style_layer.core: the kind of chibi art people set as their profile picture, swap with a partner or best friend as matching PFPs, print as stickers, use as streaming or chat emotes or keep as a wallpaper. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: invented super-deformed cute characters two to three heads tall, the head a third to half of the height, tiny rounded hands and feet, big shiny eyes with two white highlights, a small mouth and rosy blush cheeks, in one simple pose (waving, hugging a plushie, holding a heart). A single piece shows one character with its face in the middle; a matching pair gives each character its own half with the face in the middle of that half, drawn the same way and reaching toward or mirroring each other so the halves read as a set. Small hearts, sparkles and tiny clouds float around them; any words sit small in open space beside or below. LIGHT: soft even light, one gentle cel shadow under the chin and hair, tiny white highlights on eyes and hair. COLOUR: a pastel base (baby pink, mint, lavender, butter yellow or sky blue), pink cheeks, one deeper tone for hair or clothes. TEXTURE: thick soft line art of even weight in dark brown, flat or two-tone cel fills. TIERS: the sticker tier puts each character on a plain pale background with a wide white die-cut border hugging the silhouette (avatars, stickers, emotes); the scene tier sets them in a small cozy pastel setting - a bedroom corner, a cafe, a starry sky (wallpapers, matching PFPs, avatars). LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the pastel palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the chibi characters, the pastel palette, the hearts and sparkles and the soft even light always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a pale pastel background under soft even light beside the chibi characters.

description.en: Flowing black Chicano script with long dramatic swashes and sharp Old English capitals, laid down in glossy sign-painter ink with a faint grey shadow, often on skin or cream paper.
description.ja: 長く劇的なスワッシュを持つ流れるような黒のチカーノ筆記体と、鋭いオールドイングリッシュの大文字。看板職人のような艶のある墨に淡いグレーの影、肌やクリーム色の紙の上に。
description.zh: 流畅的黑色奇卡诺手写体，带夸张长花饰笔和锐利的 Old English 大写，招牌画师式亮面墨色加淡灰阴影，常见于皮肤或米色纸上。
description.es: Script chicano negro y fluido con largos remates dramáticos y mayúsculas Old English afiladas, trazado con tinta brillante de rotulista y una tenue sombra gris, a menudo sobre piel o papel crema.
description.pt: Script chicano preto e fluido com longos floreios dramáticos e maiúsculas Old English afiadas, feito com tinta brilhante de letrista e uma leve sombra cinza, muitas vezes sobre pele ou papel creme.
description.de: Fließende schwarze Chicano-Schreibschrift mit langen, dramatischen Schwüngen und scharfen Old-English-Versalien, in glänzender Schildermaler-Tinte mit leichtem grauem Schatten, oft auf Haut oder cremefarbenem Papier.

style_layer.core: a name rendered in Chicano ink and paint. INK/PAINT: rich glossy black ink laid down with sign-painter precision — deep solid blacks with a subtle wet sheen and a faint soft grey drop-shadow lifting the letters off the surface; an optional single accent like lowrider pinstriping — gold-leaf, chrome or deep candy-red. LETTERFORM COLOR: when the chosen font defines its own color keep it; otherwise jet-black glossy ink with at most one metallic or candy-red accent. ATMOSPHERE (always): warm low-key light raking across the surface, deep shadows and a glossy highlight, a proud, personal, street-royal mood. GROUND: a real Chicano carrier — smooth skin, cream aged paper, a lowrider's glossy candy-paint panel, or a grey concrete wall. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (ornate script flourishes and swashes, Old English blackletter, or cholo placa handstyle), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style only governs the ink/paint finish, sheen, drop-shadow, palette and the carrier behind — never the letter shapes. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in glossy solid black ink with crisp clean edges and a faint grey drop-shadow on smooth skin or cream aged paper, so the Chicano hand-lettering pride always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits proud on a real Chicano carrier — inked on skin, hand-lettered on cream paper, or laid over a lowrider's glossy candy-paint panel. Warm low-key light rakes across it, deep shadows and a wet glossy highlight. Proud, personal, street-royal energy — tattoo culture, streetwear and lowrider pride.

description.en: Mirror-finish chrome 3D metallic text with razor-sharp silver highlights and cold industrial precision. Gaming branding, music covers, esports teams — the go-to for bold metallic authority.
description.ja: 鏡面仕上げのクローム3Dメタリックテキスト。鋭くシャープなシルバーのハイライトと、冷たく工業的な精密さが特徴です。ゲームブランディング、音楽ジャケット、eスポーツチームなど、力強いメタリックな存在感を出したいときの定番です。
description.zh: 镜面镀铬 3D 金属文字，银光锐利，透着冷峻的工业精度。游戏品牌、音乐封面、电竞战队——想要金属感的硬派气场，就选它。
description.es: Letras metálicas 3D con acabado cromado de espejo, brillos plateados nítidos y una precisión industrial fría. Branding de gaming, portadas de música, equipos de esports: la opción clara cuando quieres autoridad metálica sin rodeos.
description.pt: Letras metálicas 3D com acabamento cromado espelhado, brilhos prateados afiados e uma precisão industrial fria. Branding de games, capas de música, times de esports: a escolha certa quando você quer autoridade metálica sem meias palavras.
description.de: Spiegelnder Chrom-3D-Metalltext mit messerscharfen Silber-Glanzlichtern und kalter industrieller Praezision. Gaming-Branding, Musikcover, Esports-Teams — die erste Wahl fuer fette metallische Autoritaet.

style_layer.core: Polished chrome metal surface. Cool blue-gray midtones with near-black cold shadow zones. Ultra-sharp razor-thin white specular highlight lines along all curved edges and beveled surfaces. Subtle electric-blue rim light tracing the letter outlines. Mirror-clean surface reflecting the environment with high contrast. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the polished-chrome material, the razor specular highlights and the cool rim light. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as bold 3D-extruded polished chrome with cool blue-grey midtones, near-black cold shadows, razor-thin white specular highlight lines on every bevel and a subtle electric-blue rim light. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise the cool chrome blue-grey with electric-blue rim.
style_layer.scene: bold 3D extruded letters with polished chrome metal surface — cool blue-gray midtones, near-black cold shadows, ultra-sharp razor-thin white specular highlights on all beveled edges. Pure black background with subtle dark atmospheric depth. Cold industrial precision, mirror-finish chrome aesthetic.

description.en: Monumental movie-title capitals in warm gold metal, rim-lit by a low sun with lens flare, floating over a vast mountain landscape at golden hour.

description.zh: 宏大的电影标题大写字母，暖金色金属质感，被低角度阳光勾出轮廓光并带镜头光晕，悬于黄金时刻的辽阔山景之上。
description.es: Monumentales mayúsculas de título de película en metal dorado cálido, perfiladas por un sol bajo con destello de lente, flotando sobre un vasto paisaje de montañas en la hora dorada.
description.pt: Monumentais maiúsculas de título de filme em metal dourado quente, contornadas por um sol baixo com reflexo de lente, flutuando sobre uma vasta paisagem de montanhas na hora dourada.
description.de: Monumentale Filmtitel-Versalien aus warmem Goldmetall, von tief stehender Sonne mit Lens Flare umrissen, schwebend über einer weiten Berglandschaft zur goldenen Stunde.

style_layer.core: Hollywood-grade movie title typography with professional key art quality. Dominant title letterforms with cinematic depth — clear foreground/background separation with atmospheric haze and volumetric light creating dimensional space. Strong directional key light defining letter surface and form. Subtle film grain texture overlay enhancing photographic authenticity. Deep, rich tonal range with controlled shadow depth. Scene and material vocabulary driven by the text's emotional register — heroic calls for epic scale and warm golden light, dark themes call for cold underlighting and shadow, futuristic calls for clean precision and cool tones. Professional cinematic color grading. High-contrast, photorealistic rendering.
style_layer.scene: A grand cinematic landscape at golden hour, distant mountains silhouetted against a warm amber sky. Volumetric light rays cutting through atmospheric haze. Film grain texture. Shallow depth of field fading edges into soft bokeh. Anamorphic lens flare catching the title. Professional key art composition.

description.en: Condensed chrome-steel capitals with fine brushed grain, split warm-orange and cold-blue side light, anamorphic flare and rain-soaked city streets behind.

description.zh: 窄长的铬钢大写字母带细密拉丝纹，一侧暖橙一侧冷蓝的侧光，变形宽银幕光晕，背后是雨水浸透的城市街道。

style_layer.core: Action movie title typography. Precision-machined brushed chrome-steel letters — not polished mirror finish, but tactical weapon-grade metal with fine directional grain. Intense asymmetric side-lighting from one direction: warm orange-gold key light striking one face of each letter, cool blue-white rim light on the opposing edge, creating razor-sharp contrast. Anamorphic horizontal lens flare streaking across the composition. Subtle motion-blur trails on letter edges suggesting high-velocity impact. Background: deep black with faint volumetric haze and sparse high-speed metallic sparks — not ash or embers, but the sparks of metal-on-metal friction. Overall mood: Hollywood action blockbuster, the second before impact. No rust, no scorched earth, no molten cracks. Photorealistic cinematic rendering.

description.zh: 好莱坞级别的电影片名字体，镀铬抛光金属质感，强烈戏剧性聚光灯，加上体积感十足的镜头光晕。专为史诗海报、游戏标题和高冲击力视觉项目打造。

description.de: Filmtitel-Lettering im Hollywood-Maßstab: eine Kino Schrift mit chrompolierter Metalloberfläche, intensivem dramatischem Spotlight und volumetrischem Lens Flare. Gemacht für epische Poster, Game-Titel und wirkungsstarke Bildprojekte.

style_layer.core: Ultra-polished chrome metallic surface with razor-sharp mirror finish. Intense overhead directional spotlight casting hard dramatic shadows. Deep cinematic dark sky background with storm clouds or battle-scarred atmosphere. Volumetric god-rays piercing through darkness behind letters. style_layer.scene: Epic summer blockbuster title reveal moment — storm clouds parting above a ruined battlefield skyline, golden volumetric light shafts breaking through, ember sparks drifting past chrome letters. Anamorphic scope frame, IMAX scale.

description.de: Horrorfilm-Titelschrift mit rissigen, blutverschmierten Oberflächen und trübem, kränklichem Licht — die Horror-Schrift für Halloween-Designs, Thriller-Poster und dunkle, atmosphärische Visuals.

style_layer.core:
Cinematic horror movie title typography. The scene dominates -- letterforms exist inside a complete horror world, not placed in front of a background.

CINEMATIC HORROR RULES (apply to every shot):
- Single light source. Psychologically wrong origin: a bulb too dim, daylight too harsh, a glow with no identifiable source. One light. Hard edges.
- Extreme tonal contrast: deep shadow occupies at least 60% of the frame. The darkness is not empty -- it contains the threat.
- Negative space is active: what is NOT shown is more frightening than what is shown. Leave room for the unseen.
- The camera angle is wrong: slightly too low, too close, or canted in a way that creates unease.
- NOT balanced composition. NOT safe. NOT studio light. NOT neutral background.

ATMOSPHERE: physical presence, not decorative effect. Fog has weight and source. Dust is disturbed by something. The air itself carries wrong information.

LETTER SURFACE FALLBACK (when font defines no specific material):
Letters carry the evidence of horror -- surfaces show dried blood seepage along crack lines, rust oxidation staining, decay marks, or age damage. NOT clean. NOT neutral. The letters have been through something.
style_layer.scene: Wide cinematic frame. Title text centered, filling 65-80% of frame width. Cold blue-green underlight source at ground level casting long vertical shadows rising above letters into absolute darkness above. Dense fog layer pooling at letter bases. Desolate horror atmosphere.

description.en: Science fiction film title typography with cold brushed titanium surface, precision-machined edges, and deep space backgrounds. Ideal for game titles, tech brands, and futuristic designs.
description.ja: 冷たいヘアライン加工のチタン表面、精密加工されたエッジ、深宇宙の背景を組み合わせたSF映画タイトルタイポグラフィです。ゲームタイトル、テックブランド、未来的なデザインに最適です。
description.zh: 科幻电影片名式排版，冷调拉丝钛金属表面、精密加工的锐利边缘，配上深邃太空背景。适合游戏标题、科技品牌和未来感设计。
description.es: Tipografía de títulos de películas de ciencia ficción con superficie de titanio cepillado frío, bordes maquinados con precisión y fondos de espacio profundo. Ideal para títulos de videojuegos, marcas tecnológicas y diseños futuristas.
description.pt: Tipografia de títulos de filmes de ficção científica com superfície de titânio escovado frio, bordas usinadas com precisão e fundos de espaço profundo. Ideal para títulos de jogos, marcas de tecnologia e designs futuristas.
description.de: Filmtitel-Typografie im Science-Fiction-Stil mit kalter, gebürsteter Titanoberfläche, präzisionsgefrästen Kanten und Hintergründen aus den Tiefen des Weltraums. Ideal für Spieletitel, Tech-Marken und futuristische Schrift-Designs.

style_layer.core: Cold brushed titanium surface with precision-machined edges and micro-etched detail lines. Cryogenic blue-white edge illumination — cold internal glow emanating from letter seams, the photonic quality of light bending near a gravitational event horizon. Hard vacuum atmospheric quality: zero ambient scatter, maximum edge contrast, each hairline stroke reading as a laser-cut threshold between titanium and void. Surface texture: aerospace-grade matte titanium with subtle anisotropic grain direction. The visual language of modern hard science-fiction cinema — monumental, minimal, cold, inevitable. Forbidden: warm tones, organic textures, soft edges, lens flare colour.
style_layer.scene: Deep space operational environment — a colossal space station or alien megastructure silhouetted against a ringed gas giant at the horizon, its running lights tracing cold blue-white geometry through the void. Hard vacuum starfield: maximum-contrast cold stars against absolute black. Letters catch a single cold directional source — the light of a distant star, entering frame from upper-left at a precise angle, casting razor-edge technical shadows. One anamorphic streak: cold cyan-white, horizontal, transient. The scale of the scene dwarfs everything. Interstellar silence. No warm tones anywhere.

description.en: Tall condensed sans capitals in warm yellow with a dark outline and glow, a small episode line above, over a golden-hour city rooftop.
description.ja: 暖かな黄色に濃いフチと光彩をつけた縦長サンセリフの大文字。上に小さなエピソード表記、背景はゴールデンアワーの街の屋上。

style_layer.core: video creator title typography. Modern, energetic, high-visibility letterforms designed for digital screens and video thumbnails. Vibrant yet controlled color palette — warm amber, bright cyan, electric yellow or bold white against rich dark backgrounds. Dynamic scene backgrounds: urban streets, rooftops at golden hour, neon-lit city nights, or cinematic outdoor vistas. Strong directional lighting with clear focal hierarchy. Clean typographic structure supporting multi-line titles: channel name / episode title / series indicator. Film grain optional. Contemporary video creator aesthetic — confident, bold, watchable.
style_layer.scene: Urban rooftop at golden hour, warm amber light flooding the scene, city skyline blurred behind. The letters glow with warm backlight against the dusky cityscape. Three-layer typography structure: dominant channel name, secondary subtitle, minimal series indicator.

description.en: Bold comic book action typography with halftone dots, speed lines, pow/bam burst effects and classic superhero lettering style.

description.zh: 粗犷的美式漫画动作字体，配上半调网点、速度线、POW/BAM 爆炸特效和经典超级英雄字形。
description.es: Tipografía de acción de cómic bien atrevida con puntos de semitono, líneas de velocidad, efectos de explosión pow/bam y el clásico lettering de superhéroes.
description.pt: Tipografia de ação de quadrinhos bem marcante com pontos de meio-tom, linhas de velocidade, efeitos de explosão pow/bam e o clássico lettering de super-herói.
description.de: Kräftige Comic-Action-Typografie mit Halbtonpunkten, Speed-Lines, Pow-/Bam-Explosionseffekten und klassischem Superhelden-Lettering. Diese Comic Schrift bringt jede Botschaft mit voller Wucht auf die Seite.

style_layer.core: Bold black ink outline tracing every letterform edge — a clean, hard border between 2 and 6 pixels thick, ensuring every letter reads as a distinct graphic element against any background. Ben-Day halftone dot screen underlying all color areas: regular circular ink dots on white paper substrate, creating the characteristic optically-mixed color of classic four-color printing. Color palette operating at maximum primary contrast: action yellow, impact red, force blue, knockout white — the exact pigments of Silver Age comic printing, saturated to their loudest value. Ink energy in the environment: diagonal speed lines radiating from behind letterforms, faint cosmic crackle energy dots scattered in the shadows, halftone dots diffusing into white at the edges of color areas. The letters exist as graphic symbols pressed onto the page — flat, bold, and a pure statement of graphic force. When no specific material is defined by the font: default environment — action yellow fill on each letterform, thick black outline border, Ben-Day halftone dot pattern overlay at 40% across color areas, white knockout background with speed-line radiating marks.
style_layer.scene: Classic Silver Age comic book action panel — newsprint-warm white background. The text in massive impact letterforms explodes at dead center, filling 72% of frame width. Letters filled with action yellow, hard flat black outline 5px thick. Behind the text: a classic starburst explosion burst shape in racing red with jagged geometric spike points radiating outward to all frame edges. Ben-Day halftone dot grid overlays the red burst — dots sharp, regular, dense. Four-color print register: 1px color offset between yellow fill and black outline, authentic printing misalignment. Two thin horizontal speed lines cross behind the burst at 30% opacity. Pure graphic composition, no photography, zero gradients.

description.en: Satin ribbon bows, thin candy-stripe borders, scalloped frames, tiny trees, cherries and pearls on cream and pale pink, with lots of space and soft daylight.

description.zh: 缎带蝴蝶结、细细的糖果条纹边、波浪边框、小圣诞树、樱桃和珍珠，铺在奶白和浅粉上，大量留白，日光柔和。
description.es: Moños de satén, finos bordes de rayas de bastón de caramelo, marcos festoneados, arbolitos, cerezas y perlas sobre crema y rosa pálido, con mucho espacio y luz de día suave.
description.pt: Laços de cetim, bordas finas listradas de bengala de doce, molduras recortadas em ondas, arvorezinhas, cerejas e pérolas sobre creme e rosa-claro, com muito espaço e luz do dia suave.
description.de: Satinschleifen, feine Zuckerstangen-Streifenränder, Bogenrahmen, kleine Tannenbäume, Kirschen und Perlen auf Creme und Zartrosa, mit viel Luft und weichem Tageslicht.

style_layer.core: a coquette Christmas phone wallpaper, card, invitation or gift tag that a girl who loves bows and ribbons would actually set or send. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: delicate decoration around the words - satin ribbon bows, thin red-and-white or pink-and-white candy stripes along a border, scalloped or oval frames, tiny hand-drawn Christmas trees, cherries, pearls and little hearts - placed sparingly with lots of breathing room; a bow often crowns the frame and ribbon tails trail down the sides. LIGHT: soft, diffused daylight, airy and gentle, faint shadows under ribbons. COLOUR: cream and pale pink backgrounds with deep cherry red or soft pink for the bows and stripes; the red is the only strong colour and is used in small amounts; touches of sage green for the tiny trees. TEXTURE: smooth card with a fine linen grain, satin sheen on the ribbons, delicate lace edges, a few pearls. TIERS: the soft pink tier is blush, cream and pink bows, very light; the cherry red tier is cream with deep red bows, red stripes and cherries, a little vintage. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; cherry red or soft pink colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the bows, stripes, frames and cream-and-pink palette always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit inside a scalloped frame on cream linen card under soft diffused daylight.

description.en: Flowing pen-and-ink cursive: connected letters, looped ascenders and long swash entry and exit strokes, written in black ink on fine white paper with soft raking light.
description.ja: 流れるようなペンとインクの筆記体。文字がつながり、アセンダーはループを描き、入りと抜けに長いスワッシュ。上質な白い紙に黒インク、柔らかな斜光。
description.zh: 流畅的钢笔墨水连写体：字母相连，升部成环，入笔与收笔拖出长花饰，黑墨写在细白纸上，柔和斜光。
description.es: Cursiva fluida de pluma y tinta: letras enlazadas, ascendentes en bucle y largos remates de entrada y salida, escrita en tinta negra sobre papel blanco fino con luz rasante suave.
description.pt: Cursiva fluida de pena e tinta: letras ligadas, ascendentes em laço e longos floreios de entrada e saída, escrita em tinta preta sobre papel branco fino com luz rasante suave.
description.de: Fließende Feder-und-Tinte-Schreibschrift: verbundene Buchstaben, geschlungene Oberlängen und lange Schwünge am Anfang und Ende, in schwarzer Tinte auf feinem weißem Papier bei sanftem Streiflicht.

style_layer.core: placed in a soft, refined calligraphy light field — a gentle directional light rakes across the surface from an upper angle, grazing the strokes so their natural ink body and subtle sheen read with depth, while a soft fill keeps shadows intimate rather than harsh. GROUND: a clean elegant art surface — fine hot-press cotton paper, smooth cream card, a soft neutral or a quiet dark editorial ground — with generous negative space so the lettering breathes. ATMOSPHERE: the timeless, romantic feel of masterful pen calligraphy — poised and versatile, at home on a name, a quote, a bio or a card. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes and built-in flourishes take priority and own the letters; this style governs only the surrounding light, ground and finish, never the letter shapes. When no specific material is defined by the font: rich flowing ink with a soft natural sheen and a fine wet-edge glisten where strokes catch the light, on the clean paper ground. COLOR: if the font declares its own color keep it; otherwise the ink reads as a deep elegant tone — classic near-black or a soft romantic ink hue — on the light ground.
style_layer.scene: The word sits large and centered with generous negative space on a clean elegant art surface — fine cream cotton paper, a smooth ivory card or a quiet dark editorial ground. A gentle directional light rakes across from an upper angle, grazing the strokes so the flowing ink body and its soft sheen read with depth. Timeless, romantic pen-calligraphy feel — at home on a name, a quote or a card.

names.ja: エステティック筆記体

description.en: Thin pink cursive with bouncy loops, a pearly glitter fill and tiny hearts, on a soft blush background with a satin bow and sparkles.
description.ja: 弾むループの細いピンクの筆記体に、パールのようなラメと小さなハート。淡いブラッシュピンクの背景にサテンのリボンときらめき。
description.zh: 纤细的粉色连写体，弹跳的圆环，珍珠光泽的闪粉填色和小爱心，衬在柔和腮红粉背景上，配缎面蝴蝶结与星光。
description.es: Cursiva rosa y fina con bucles saltarines, relleno de purpurina perlada y pequeños corazones, sobre un suave fondo rosa rubor con un lazo de satén y destellos.
description.pt: Cursiva rosa e fina com laços saltitantes, preenchimento de glitter perolado e pequenos corações, sobre um fundo rosa-blush suave com laço de cetim e brilhos.
description.de: Feine rosa Schreibschrift mit hüpfenden Schlaufen, perlmuttartiger Glitzerfüllung und kleinen Herzen, auf zartem Rosé-Hintergrund mit Satinschleife und Funkeln.

style_layer.core: styled as a soft, dreamy coquette aesthetic. SURFACE / INK: the lettering has a delicate, pretty finish — soft matte or a whisper of pearly shimmer, with a faint dusting of fine sparkle catching the light, sweet and dainty rather than bold. GROUND: a soft, dreamy backdrop — blush pink, cream, pastel lilac or a gentle gradient — with airy negative space, tiny out-of-focus sparkles, pearls, ribbons or a soft bokeh glow. LIGHT: soft, diffused and glowy — a gentle dreamy light with no harsh shadows, the mood hazy and romantic. ATMOSPHERE: the sweet, girly charm of a soft-girl / coquette aesthetic — social media bios, journal pages, dreamy mood boards, delicate and playful. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes and flourishes take priority and own the letters; this style governs only the finish, ground and light, never the letter shapes. When no specific material is defined by the font: a soft delicate lettering finish with a faint pearly shimmer and a light dusting of fine sparkle, on the dreamy pastel ground. COLOR: if the font declares its own color keep it; otherwise the lettering reads as a soft romantic tone — a delicate blush pink, soft rose or a gentle charcoal — on the pastel ground.
style_layer.scene: The word sits large and centered with airy negative space on a soft, dreamy backdrop — blush pink, cream or pastel lilac with a gentle gradient, tiny out-of-focus sparkles, pearls or a soft bokeh glow. Soft, diffused dreamy light, no harsh shadows. Sweet, girly soft-girl coquette mood.

names.ja: カリグラフィースクリプト

description.en: Formal pointed-pen copperplate: strong thick-thin contrast, slanted oval letters and swash capitals, crisp black ink on cream paper with faint ruled guidelines.
description.ja: 尖ったペンによる格式あるカッパープレート体。強い太細の差、傾いた楕円の字形、スワッシュの大文字を、薄い罫線のあるクリーム色の紙に黒インクで。
description.zh: 正式的尖头笔铜版体：粗细对比强烈，倾斜的椭圆字形和花饰大写，清晰黑墨写在带淡色格线的米色纸上。
description.es: Copperplate formal de pluma puntiaguda: fuerte contraste grueso-fino, letras ovaladas inclinadas y mayúsculas con remates, tinta negra nítida sobre papel crema con tenues líneas guía.
description.pt: Copperplate formal de pena pontiaguda: forte contraste grosso-fino, letras ovais inclinadas e maiúsculas com floreios, tinta preta nítida sobre papel creme com linhas-guia leves.
description.de: Formelle Copperplate mit Spitzfeder: starker Kontrast von dick und dünn, schräge ovale Buchstaben und geschwungene Versalien, klare schwarze Tinte auf cremefarbenem Papier mit feinen Hilfslinien.

style_layer.core: laid down as the exacting art of formal pointed-pen calligraphy. SURFACE / INK: crisp, controlled ink — deep black or warm sepia — sitting cleanly on the page with fine wet-ink edges and a faint natural sheen where it catches the light, precise and disciplined rather than loose, the exacting hand of a master penman. GROUND: fine calligraphy paper — smooth hot-press cotton, cream or ivory practice stock, sometimes with faint ruled guideline slants, or a formal certificate or invitation ground — with generous margins so the lettering reads. LIGHT: even, clean studio light — soft and flat — showing the crisp ink edges and fine wet-ink detail, minimal drama. ATMOSPHERE: formal, timeless and disciplined — the tradition of copperplate and Spencerian penmanship, wedding invitations, diplomas and certificates, the poised craft of the calligrapher's desk. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes and built-in flourishes take priority and own the letters; this style governs only the ink surface, ground and light, never the letter shapes. When no specific material is defined by the font: crisp controlled pointed-pen ink with fine wet edges and a faint sheen, in a single deep tone, on the calligraphy-paper ground. COLOR: if the font declares its own color keep it; otherwise the ink reads as a classic penmanship tone — deep black or warm sepia — on the pale paper ground.
style_layer.scene: The word sits large and centered with generous margins on fine calligraphy paper — smooth cream or ivory hot-press stock, sometimes with faint ruled guideline slants, or a formal invitation ground. Even, clean studio light shows the crisp ink edges and fine wet-ink detail. Formal, timeless, disciplined penmanship feel.

description.en: Bold modern brush script: heavy loaded-brush strokes, a bouncing baseline and dry-brush drag where the brush lifts, matte black ink on a clean light ground.
description.ja: 太く現代的なブラシ筆記体。たっぷり墨を含んだ太い線、上下に弾むベースライン、筆を離す所のかすれ。明るく清潔な地にマットな黒インク。
description.zh: 粗壮的现代毛笔手写体：饱蘸墨的粗笔触，基线上下跳动，提笔处带枯笔拖痕，哑光黑墨落在干净浅色底上。
description.es: Script de pincel moderno y grueso: trazos cargados de tinta, línea base que rebota y arrastre de pincel seco donde se levanta, tinta negra mate sobre un fondo claro y limpio.
description.pt: Script de pincel moderno e encorpado: traços carregados de tinta, linha de base saltitante e arrasto de pincel seco onde ele levanta, tinta preta fosca sobre um fundo claro e limpo.
description.de: Kräftige moderne Pinselschrift: satte, tintenschwere Striche, eine hüpfende Grundlinie und Trockenpinsel-Spuren beim Absetzen, mattschwarze Tinte auf hellem, sauberem Grund.

style_layer.core: grounded in bold, contemporary brush-lettering ink. SURFACE / INK: rich, confident ink laid down with a loaded brush — mostly matte with a faint fresh-ink sheen, a subtle brushed texture in the strokes and a touch of dry-brush grain where they lift, energetic and hand-made. GROUND: a clean, modern surface — a bright studio backdrop, a soft neutral, a bold flat colour block, or a contemporary branding/packaging context — with generous space so the lettering pops. LIGHT: clean, even, contemporary studio light — punchy and bright, minimal drama. ATMOSPHERE: current, confident and commercial — the look of modern brand lettering, apparel graphics, packaging and social content. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs only the ink surface, ground and light, never the letter shapes. When no specific material is defined by the font: rich confident brush ink, mostly matte with a subtle brushed texture, on the clean modern ground. COLOR: if the font declares its own color keep it; otherwise the lettering reads as a bold contemporary tone — deep black or a single confident colour — on the clean ground.
style_layer.scene: The word sits large and centered with generous space on a clean, modern surface — a bright studio backdrop, a soft neutral or a bold flat colour block. Clean, even, punchy contemporary studio light makes the bold brush lettering pop. Current, confident, commercial modern-branding feel.

description.en: A hand-signed autograph: one fluid pen line with a dominant capital, small connected letters and a long underline swash, in flat blue-black ink on white paper.
description.ja: 手書きのサイン。一本の流れる線で、目立つ頭文字に小さくつながる文字、最後に長いアンダーラインのスワッシュ。白い紙に青黒いインク。
description.zh: 亲笔签名：一笔流畅连成，首字母突出、后续小写相连，末尾一道长下划线花饰，蓝黑墨水写在白纸上。
description.es: Una firma autógrafa: una sola línea fluida con una inicial dominante, minúsculas pequeñas enlazadas y un largo subrayado ornamental, en tinta negro azulada sobre papel blanco.
description.pt: Um autógrafo assinado à mão: uma única linha fluida com uma inicial dominante, minúsculas pequenas ligadas e um longo sublinhado ornamental, em tinta preto-azulada sobre papel branco.
description.de: Eine handschriftliche Unterschrift: eine einzige fließende Linie mit markantem Anfangsbuchstaben, kleinen verbundenen Buchstaben und einem langen Unterstreichungsschwung, in blauschwarzer Tinte auf weißem Papier.

style_layer.core: captured as an authentic hand-signed autograph. SURFACE / INK: the name is laid down in one confident pass as a real pen signature — a fine ballpoint or fountain-pen line in flat matte ink, with natural pen texture: subtle ink pooling where strokes turn, faint pen-skips where the nib lifts, no gloss, no metallic, no decorative shine. GROUND: a plain, real signing surface — crisp white document or card stock, a signed letter or contract, a clean notebook page or a soft neutral paper — understated and everyday, with generous space so the name reads. LIGHT: even, natural, document-like — soft flat daylight or a gentle desk light, minimal drama, the signature reading clear and legible the way a real autograph does. ATMOSPHERE: personal, confident and authentic — the feel of a genuine hand-signed name or personal-brand mark, dashed off yet unmistakably distinctive. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes and personal flourishes take priority and own the letters; this style governs only the ink surface, ground and light, never the letter shapes. When no specific material is defined by the font: a fine matte pen-ink line with natural ballpoint or fountain-pen texture in a single flat ink color, on the clean paper ground. COLOR: if the font declares its own color keep it; otherwise the ink reads as a deep classic signing tone — near-black or a dark blue-black — on the light paper ground.
style_layer.scene: The name sits large and centered with generous negative space on a plain, real signing surface — crisp white document or card stock, a signed letter or a clean notebook page. Even soft daylight reads the signature flat and clear, the way a real autograph does. Personal, confident, authentic hand-signed feel.

description.en: Chubby little ghosts, smiling pumpkins and a sleepy black cat scattered like stickers on cream, in pumpkin orange, peach and soft lilac with thick soft outlines and flat light.
description.ja: ほっぺが赤いまるいおばけ、にっこりかぼちゃ、眠る黒猫をクリーム色の地にステッカーのように散らし、かぼちゃ色・ピーチ・ラベンダーで、太くやわらかな線とフラットな光で描くスタイル。
description.zh: 圆滚滚的小幽灵、笑脸南瓜和睡着的黑猫像贴纸一样散在奶油底上，南瓜橙、桃色和浅紫配色，粗而柔的描边，平光。
description.es: Fantasmitas redondos, calabazas sonrientes y un gato negro dormido esparcidos como stickers sobre crema, en naranja calabaza, durazno y lila suave, con contornos gruesos y suaves y luz plana.
description.pt: Fantasminhas redondos, abóboras sorridentes e um gato preto dormindo espalhados como adesivos sobre creme, em laranja abóbora, pêssego e lilás suave, com contornos grossos e macios e luz chapada.
description.de: Runde kleine Gespenster, lächelnde Kürbisse und eine schlafende schwarze Katze wie Sticker auf Creme verteilt, in Kürbisorange, Pfirsich und zartem Flieder, mit dicken weichen Konturen und flachem Licht.

style_layer.core: the kind of cute Halloween picture people set as a phone wallpaper, print as stickers, copy as doodles or send out for a kids' Halloween party. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: round chubby little ghosts, smiling jack-o-lanterns, a sleepy black cat, candy corn, wrapped sweets, tiny bats, stars and a crescent moon, scattered like stickers around the edges or gathered into a frame, with lots of calm open space around the words; the characters have simple dot eyes and rosy blush cheeks. LIGHT: soft even flat light, no dramatic shadows, only small soft highlights. COLOUR: cream, peach and soft lilac as the base, pumpkin orange and black as the main tones, pink blush as the accent. TEXTURE: thick soft rounded outlines, smooth flat fills, a faint hand-drawn paper grain. TIERS: the kawaii sticker tier is die-cut stickers with a white border around each character (wallpapers, stickers, clipart, kids' party); the soft watercolor storybook tier uses gentle transparent washes, pale cream watercolor paper and loose ink lines (cards, invitations). LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the cream, orange and lilac palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the little ghosts, pumpkins and black cat, the open cream space and the soft flat light always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a cream background under soft even light with a few sticker-style characters around them.

description.en: Chrome block capitals with magenta and cyan color fringing, horizontal glitch slices and scanlines, glowing over a rainy neon megacity at night.
description.ja: マゼンタとシアンの色ずれ、水平のグリッチスライスと走査線が入ったクロームのブロック体大文字。雨の夜のネオン巨大都市の上で光ります。
description.zh: 铬金属方块大写字母带品红与青色色边，横向故障切片和扫描线，在雨夜霓虹巨型都市上空发光。
description.es: Mayúsculas de bloque cromadas con franjas de color magenta y cian, cortes glitch horizontales y líneas de escaneo, brillando sobre una megaciudad de neón lluviosa por la noche.
description.pt: Maiúsculas em bloco cromadas com franjas de cor magenta e ciano, cortes glitch horizontais e linhas de varredura, brilhando sobre uma megacidade de neon chuvosa à noite.
description.de: Chrom-Blockversalien mit magenta- und cyanfarbenen Farbsäumen, horizontalen Glitch-Schnitten und Scanlines, leuchtend über einer verregneten Neon-Megastadt bei Nacht.

style_layer.core: RGB chromatic aberration: cyan channel offset 4px left, magenta channel offset 4px right, vivid color fringing on all hard edges. Fine horizontal scan-line cuts at 15-20px intervals at 25% opacity crossing all surfaces. Digital glitch slice displacement: 2-3 horizontal bands shifted rightward 6-8px, simulating CRT signal failure. Electric cyan-white plasma threads arcing along character perimeters. Cold ambient fill: blue-tinted shadow zones on all non-illuminated surfaces. Color palette restricted to: electric cyan (#00E5FF), hot magenta (#FF00FF), cold chrome (#C0C0C0), near-black background — no warm tones, no unmotivated gradients. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment — cold blue-white overhead arc light, cyan and magenta neon fill from both sides, near-black background with subtle atmospheric fog.
style_layer.scene: Set in a rain-soaked neon-lit back alley at night — wet asphalt reflecting fractured cyan and magenta light below, steam venting from grates, blurred neon signs in the extreme background out of focus. Dense atmospheric fog, oppressive tech-noir mood.
