description.en: Toxic acid-rain corrosion effect with dripping green chemicals and rusted metal surfaces. Industrial dystopia aesthetic.
description.ja: 滴り落ちる緑色の化学薬品と錆びた金属表面で表現する、有毒な酸性雨の腐食エフェクト。工業ディストピアの美学です。
description.zh: 有毒酸雨腐蚀特效，绿色化学液体滴落，金属表面锈迹斑斑。工业反乌托邦美学。
description.es: Efecto de corrosión de lluvia ácida tóxica con químicos verdes que gotean y superficies de metal oxidado. Estética de distopía industrial.
description.pt: Efeito de corrosão de chuva ácida tóxica com químicos verdes escorrendo e superfícies de metal enferrujado. Estética de distopia industrial.
description.de: Toxischer Säureregen-Korrosionseffekt mit tropfenden grünen Chemikalien und verrosteten Metalloberflächen — eine industrielle Dystopie-Ästhetik im Look einer Grunge-Schrift.

style_layer.core: rendered in acid rain cyberpunk style. Letters appear corroded and melting from toxic chemical exposure — dripping toxic-green (#00FF41) acid trails eating into the letterforms, rust-orange oxidation patches spreading from letter edges, eroded metal surface texture with pitted craters and chemical burn marks. High contrast, visceral, industrial. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the corroded melting metal, the toxic acid trails and the oxidation. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as corroded melting letters with dripping toxic-green acid trails, rust-orange oxidation patches and pitted chemical-burn metal. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise toxic green (#00FF41) and rust orange on a dark industrial ground.
style_layer.scene: Industrial wasteland atmosphere. Acid-green mist rising from below, rust-stained concrete in background, warning-yellow hazard chevrons fading into fog. Poisonous rain droplets streaking down in foreground.

description.en: Biomechanical fusion of organic tissue and metal machinery. H.R. Giger-inspired dark industrial aesthetic.
description.ja: 有機的な組織と金属機械が融合したバイオメカニカル。H.R. Gigerにインスパイアされたダークでインダストリアルな美学です。
description.zh: 有机组织与金属机械的生物机械融合。灵感源自 H.R. Giger 的暗黑工业美学。
description.es: Fusión biomecánica de tejido orgánico y maquinaria de metal. Estética industrial oscura inspirada en H.R. Giger.
description.pt: Fusão biomecânica de tecido orgânico e maquinário de metal. Estética industrial sombria inspirada em H.R. Giger.
description.de: Biomechanische Verschmelzung von organischem Gewebe und Metallmaschinerie. Dunkle, industrielle Ästhetik im Stil von H.R. Giger.

style_layer.core: biomechanical style — the visual world is dark industrial: oil-stained forged steel (#1A1A1E), calcium-white bone matter (#F5EFE0) erupting through stressed joint seams, gear teeth and piston housings corroded with machine oil, welded seams with mineral calcium deposits along stress fractures. Material contrast: cold dark metal exoskeleton vs warm ivory organic bone — both present simultaneously in the same space. Lighting environment: single cold blue-white industrial arc overhead as primary; deep amber-orange fill from lower-left simulating background furnace or machinery glow. Atmosphere: interior of a decommissioned bio-mechanical industrial facility — corrugated dark metal ribbed walls recede into shadow, faint amber workshop glow from deep background machinery, oil-stained concrete floor below. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment — cold blue-white overhead arc from directly above, amber-orange warm fill from lower-left, near-black background with faint corroded dark metal wall texture, ground plane shows faint oil-stained concrete reflection.
style_layer.scene: Text centered in frame, filling 75-85% of frame width. Background: dark bio-mechanical industrial chamber — corrugated dark metal walls with exposed pipe bundles and cable conduits, biomechanical machinery silhouettes barely visible in deep background darkness, single cold industrial overhead arc light creating a tight oval pool on the oil-slick dark floor below the letters. Dim amber workshop glow from deep background machinery warming the lower atmosphere. Deep shadows at frame edges. Camera at eye level, slight low angle looking up at the letterforms.

description.en: Hyper-reflective liquid chrome with mirror-finish surfaces and sharp specular highlights. Cold, premium and futuristic.
description.ja: 鏡のような仕上げの表面と鋭いスペキュラハイライトを備えた、超反射的なリキッドクローム。冷たく、上質で、未来的な質感です。
description.zh: 超强反光的液态镀铬，镜面质感搭配锐利的高光。冷冽、高级、充满未来感。
description.es: Cromo líquido híper-reflectante con superficies tipo espejo y brillos especulares nítidos. Frío, premium y futurista.
description.pt: Cromo líquido híper-reflexivo com superfícies tipo espelho e brilhos especulares nítidos. Frio, premium e futurista.
description.de: Hyperreflektierendes flüssiges Chrom mit spiegelblanken Oberflächen und scharfen Glanzlichtern. Kalt, edel und futuristisch.

style_layer.core: rendered in liquid chrome metal style. Mirror-finish metallic letterforms with hyper-reflective surfaces showing environmental reflections, sharp bright specular highlights running along letter edges, cool steel blue-silver color palette with deep shadow contrast. Surface feels like polished liquid mercury frozen in place. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the liquid-chrome mirror material and the sharp edge speculars. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as mirror-finish liquid-chrome letters with hyper-reflective environmental reflections and bright edge highlights. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise a cool steel blue-silver with deep shadow contrast.
style_layer.scene: Against a minimal dark studio background with subtle floor reflection, a single overhead key light creating dramatic specular highlights on the metal surface. Clean and premium.

description.en: Cascading data stream text with digital rain and terminal green glow. Hacker and code aesthetic.
description.ja: ハッカーとコードの美学です。
description.zh: 黑客与代码美学。
description.es: Estética hacker y de código.
description.pt: Estética hacker e de código.
description.de: Diese hacker schrift bringt Hacker- und Code-Ästhetik auf den Punkt.

style_layer.core: rendered in digital data stream style. Primary letters formed from bright terminal-green (#00FF41) monospace characters with strong phosphor-screen glow, secondary layer of cascading smaller code characters flowing through and around the letterforms like falling rain, character density highest at letter edges creating a dissolving effect, old CRT monitor scanlines and subtle screen-door pixel grid texture, deep contrast. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the terminal-green phosphor code rain, the cascading characters and the CRT scanlines. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as bright terminal-green monospace letters with cascading digital-rain characters, phosphor glow and CRT scanlines. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise terminal green (#00FF41) on a near-black screen.
style_layer.scene: Pure black void environment evoking a dark terminal screen. Vertical streams of cascading green code characters falling at different speeds and opacities in the deep background, subtle green ambient glow on ground plane.

names.ja: エレクトリックネオン

description.en: Classic neon tube glow effect — single vivid color, soft light bloom and the authentic warmth of a real neon sign.
description.ja: 定番のネオン管が放つ発光エフェクト。単一の鮮やかな色、柔らかな光のにじみ、そして本物のネオンサインならではの温かみを再現します。
description.zh: 经典霓虹灯管发光效果——单一鲜亮色彩、柔和光晕，还原真实霓虹招牌的那份暖意。
description.es: El clásico brillo del tubo de neón: un solo color vibrante, un halo de luz suave y la calidez auténtica de un letrero de neón de verdad.
description.pt: O clássico brilho do tubo de neon: uma única cor vibrante, um halo de luz suave e o calor autêntico de um letreiro de neon de verdade.
description.de: Klassischer Neonroehren-Leuchteffekt — eine einzige leuchtende Farbe, weiches Lichtbloom und die authentische Waerme eines echten Neonschilds. Diese neon Schrift bringt das Nachtleben in deinen Text.

style_layer.core: rendered as real neon tube sign lettering. Letters formed from glowing neon tubes with authentic tube thickness variation, warm light bloom radiating outward with soft falloff, realistic neon color saturation — choose from electric blue, hot pink, acid green or golden yellow. Subtle tube reflection on a dark backing panel. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the glass neon-tube material, the warm light bloom and the dark backing panel. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as glowing neon-tube letters with authentic tube thickness, soft outward bloom and subtle reflection on a dark backing panel. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise electric blue, hot pink, acid green or golden yellow neon.
style_layer.scene: Mounted on a dark textured wall — exposed brick or matte black panel. Moody ambient light, a slight haze in the air catching the neon glow. Bar or studio atmosphere.

description.en: Translucent holographic projection effect with layered scan lines and iridescent cyan glow. Sci-fi UI aesthetic.
description.ja: 積層されたスキャンラインと虹色に光るシアンの輝きが特徴の、半透明なホログラフィック投影エフェクトです。SF的なUIの美学を表現します。
description.zh: 半透明的全息投影效果，叠加扫描线和虹彩青色光晕。科幻界面质感。
description.es: Efecto de proyección holográfica translúcida con líneas de escaneo superpuestas y un brillo cian iridiscente. Estética de interfaz sci-fi.
description.pt: Efeito de projeção holográfica translúcida com linhas de varredura sobrepostas e um brilho ciano iridescente. Estética de interface sci-fi.
description.de: Durchscheinender holografischer Projektionseffekt mit geschichteten Scanlinien und schillerndem cyanfarbenem Leuchten. Sci-Fi-UI-Ästhetik.

style_layer.core: rendered in holographic projection style. Letters appear as translucent light-projected holograms — multiple semi-transparent cyan/teal layers slightly offset to create depth, iridescent color fringing at edges shifting between cyan and electric blue, fine horizontal scan lines running through the letterforms, flickering static noise at letter edges, glass-like refraction within letter fills. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the holographic projection, the offset depth layers and the scanlines. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as translucent cyan/teal holographic letters with semi-transparent offset layers, fine scanlines and iridescent edge fringing. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise cyan shifting to electric blue.
style_layer.scene: Dark void environment suggesting a high-tech command center. Faint hexagonal grid floor in deep teal, barely visible. Atmospheric blue-cyan ambient light casting soft volumetric glow.

description.en: RGB color-split glitch effect with chromatic aberration and pixel distortion. Iconic look for gaming and streaming.
description.ja: 色収差とピクセルの歪みを伴うRGBカラースプリットのグリッチエフェクトです。ゲームや配信で定番のルックを演出します。
description.zh: RGB 色彩分离故障效果，带色差错位和像素扭曲。游戏和直播圈的标志性风格。
description.es: Efecto glitch con separación de color RGB, aberración cromática y distorsión de píxeles. El look icónico del gaming y el streaming.
description.pt: Efeito glitch com separação de cor RGB, aberração cromática e distorção de pixels. O visual icônico do gaming e do streaming.
description.de: RGB-Farbtrennungs-Glitch-Effekt mit chromatischer Aberration und Pixelverzerrung. Diese Neon-Schriftart hat den ikonischen Look für Gaming und Streaming.

style_layer.core: set in the neon signal aesthetic -- the visual language of electric light and digital transmission failing beautifully in a dark environment. AMBIENT LIGHT FIELD: the primary light source is the letterform itself -- surrounding environment is near-black, no competing light sources. Residual electromagnetic atmosphere: faint haze of scattered photons surrounds all illuminated forms, creating a soft luminous penumbra that separates subject from background without hard mask edges. COLOR CLIMATE: electric spectrum -- cyan, magenta, acid green, hot pink, and blue-white are the dominant emission frequencies; warm white or amber permissible as secondary accent. Never flat, never pastel: all colors are maximally saturated emission colors, not reflected colors. CONTRAST REGIME: extreme high contrast -- lit surfaces at near-maximum brightness, shadow zones at near-black; mid-tones are narrow and transitional, not gradual. SIGNAL QUALITY: the visual environment has imperfect transmission -- some form of signal noise, interference, or degradation is present in the atmosphere even when not on the letterform itself: background may carry faint scanline texture, atmospheric static grain, or ghost-image echoes at very low opacity. SURFACE BEHAVIOR: whatever material the letterform carries, it interacts with neon-spectrum illumination -- cool electric light from above and both sides, zero warm ambient fill. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment -- cold blue-white overhead arc light, cyan and magenta neon fill from left and right at 45-degree angles, near-black background with subtle atmospheric scanline fog at 15% opacity.
style_layer.scene: Against a pure black background with faint horizontal scan lines and subtle digital-rain falling pixels in the extreme background. Grid floor in dark purple fading to black.

description.en: Retro 80s synthwave aesthetic with neon pink-purple gradient text and iconic grid floor. Vaporwave nostalgia meets cyberpunk.
description.ja: ネオンのピンク・パープルのグラデーション文字と象徴的なグリッドの床が特徴の、レトロな80年代シンセウェイブ美学。ヴェイパーウェイブの郷愁とサイバーパンクが融合します。
description.zh: 复古80年代 Synthwave 风格，霓虹粉紫渐变文字配上标志性的网格地面。Vaporwave 的怀旧撞上 Cyberpunk。
description.es: Estética synthwave retro de los 80 con texto en degradado rosa-morado neón y el icónico suelo de rejilla. La nostalgia Vaporwave se cruza con el Cyberpunk.
description.pt: Estética synthwave retrô dos anos 80 com texto em degradê rosa-roxo neon e o icônico chão de grade. A nostalgia Vaporwave encontra o Cyberpunk.
description.de: Retro-80er-Synthwave-Ästhetik mit neonpink-violettem Verlaufstext und ikonischem Gitterboden. Vaporwave-Nostalgie trifft auf Cyberpunk.

style_layer.core: rendered in synthwave retro-futuristic style. Letters in deep magenta-to-violet gradient (#FF006E to #8B00FF), outlined with bright neon pink electric glow, beveled 3D extrusion giving depth, chrome-like inner highlight strip along top edge of each letter, slight lens flare on sharp corners, bold and geometric letterforms. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the synthwave gradient, the neon-pink glow outline and the 3D extrusion. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as magenta-to-violet gradient letters outlined with bright neon-pink glow, beveled 3D extrusion and a chrome top-edge highlight. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise deep magenta (#FF006E) to violet (#8B00FF).
style_layer.scene: Iconic 80s synthwave scene: infinite perspective grid floor in neon pink lines converging to horizon, oversized sun with horizontal stripe gradient (magenta, coral, yellow) sitting on the horizon, deep purple-to-black sky with sparse pink-tinted stars.

description.en: Sci-fi heads-up display interface style — scan lines, targeting brackets, data readouts and tactical UI framing.
description.ja: SF風のヘッドアップディスプレイ(HUD)インターフェーススタイル。スキャンライン、照準ブラケット、データ表示、そして戦術的なUIフレーミングが特徴です。
description.zh: 科幻抬头显示界面风格——扫描线、瞄准框、数据读数和战术 UI 边框。
description.es: Estilo de interfaz HUD de ciencia ficción: líneas de escaneo, corchetes de mira, lecturas de datos y marcos de UI tácticos.
description.pt: Estilo de interface HUD de ficção científica: linhas de varredura, colchetes de mira, leituras de dados e molduras de UI tática.
description.de: Sci-Fi-Heads-up-Display-Interface-Stil — Scanlinien, Zielklammern, Datenanzeigen und taktische UI-Rahmung.

style_layer.core:
Cold tactical information display environment — the ambient light field of an active HUD system operating in deep darkness.

Primary light: cold arc light from directly overhead, hard-edged, creating a single strict illumination plane with no warm fill. Secondary ambient fill: phosphor-green and electric-cyan light bleeding in from off-screen display banks flanking the composition — these colored hazes pool at the edges and mid-ground.

Background environment: near-absolute black with traces of cold blue-grey electromagnetic haze at 3-5% opacity. A faint horizontal scan-line interference field crosses the entire visual plane — the physical signature of a live electronic display screen, not a filter effect. Small data annotation elements (coordinate labels, signal readout numbers, range indicators) exist as environmental background overlays in the far information plane, always at lower opacity than the primary text.

LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own specific color or material (phosphor green, electric cyan, amber-orange alert, holographic blue), that font-defined color takes absolute priority and must be preserved exactly. The style color palette applies to letterform color only when the font does not specify one.
ATMOSPHERE: cold cyan (#00CFFF) and phosphor-green (#39FF14) environmental light always appears in background screen halos and atmospheric haze — regardless of font color choice.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment — cold blue-white overhead arc light from directly above at full intensity, cyan atmospheric fill from off-screen display banks on both sides, near-black void background with cold electromagnetic haze at 4% opacity, faint horizontal scan-line field across the full visual plane at 3% opacity.
style_layer.scene: Text positioned at center frame, HUD title-card placement at 65-70% of composition width, set at or slightly above the vertical midpoint. Pure dark tactical display environment — no physical location, no room, no physical objects. The darkness is the setting. The text reads as a live system readout.

description.en: Heavy glossy red block letters with thick paint drips hanging from every base, teardrop ends and pooled paint on the floor, against a dark concrete wall.
description.ja: 艶のある極太の赤いブロック体。すべての文字の下から太い塗料が垂れ、先端は涙形、床には塗料だまり。背景は暗いコンクリートの壁。
description.zh: 粗重亮面的红色方块字，每个字底都挂着浓稠颜料滴，末端成泪滴状，地面积着颜料，背景是深色水泥墙。
description.es: Letras de bloque rojas, gruesas y brillantes con espesos chorreones de pintura colgando de cada base, puntas en forma de lágrima y pintura acumulada en el suelo, frente a un muro de hormigón oscuro.
description.pt: Letras em bloco vermelhas, grossas e brilhantes com escorridos espessos de tinta pendendo de cada base, pontas em gota e tinta empoçada no chão, diante de uma parede de concreto escura.
description.de: Dicke, glänzende rote Blockbuchstaben, an jeder Grundlinie hängen zähe Farbtropfen mit tropfenförmigen Enden, Farbpfützen auf dem Boden, vor einer dunklen Betonwand.

style_layer.core:
Bold letterforms constructed from thick glossy liquid paint — letter bodies appear built from saturated pigment material with smooth high-gloss surface catching specular highlights. Heavy tear-shaped drip extensions hang from letter bases with realistic surface tension, viscous fluid trails of varying lengths, pigment pooling at the base. Each letterform reads as a 3D liquid-material object: glossy top surface, drip shadows underneath, paint depth visible at letter edges. Realistic liquid physics: drops taper to rounded points, trails thin before breaking.

Color direction: choose paint color based on text meaning and mood — FIRE / RAGE / HEAT → vivid red-orange; TOXIC / ALIEN / ACID → neon yellow-green; OCEAN / FROST / ICE → electric cyan-blue; GOLD / ROYAL / CROWN → rich metallic gold; SHADOW / VOID / DARK → deep violet-black; CANDY / SWEET / POP → hot pink; default → vivid electric blue with high saturation.
style_layer.scene: Urban street art wall — dark concrete or brick surface, paint drips catching ambient light from below, raw graffiti energy. Thick glossy paint trails cascade from letter bases with surface tension visible at each drip head. Deep shadow between drips, bright specular glint at the curved top of each drop. Paint pooling at the ground line.

names.ja: 血のしたたるフォント

description.en: Bold crimson letters with a wet, dark-red surface and long blood drips ending in round drops, isolated on pure black under side light.
description.ja: 濡れた暗赤色の表面を持つ太い深紅の文字。長い血の滴は丸い粒で終わり、横からの光を受けて真っ黒な背景に浮かびます。
description.zh: 粗体深红字母，表面湿润暗红，长长的血滴末端凝成圆珠，在侧光下孤立于纯黑背景。
description.es: Letras carmesí gruesas con una superficie roja oscura y húmeda y largos goteos de sangre que terminan en gotas redondas, aisladas sobre negro puro con luz lateral.
description.pt: Letras carmesim grossas com superfície vermelho-escura e molhada e longos escorridos de sangue terminando em gotas redondas, isoladas sobre preto puro com luz lateral.
description.de: Kräftige karminrote Buchstaben mit nasser, dunkelroter Oberfläche und langen Blutläufen, die in runden Tropfen enden, freigestellt auf reinem Schwarz im Seitenlicht.

style_layer.core: Thick crimson blood saturating every surface — viscous, high-density fluid with authentic physical behavior: large tear-shaped drops suspended at each drip terminus with surface tension visible at the meniscus, connecting streams thinning as they extend downward, deep near-black pooling where blood accumulates. Material properties: subsurface scattering gives deep red glow when backlit, specular gloss on convex drip surfaces catching directional light, matte-dark at clotted pooling zones. Blood color gradient from bright arterial red (#CC0000) at active drip streams to near-black clot (#3D0000) at base pools. Gravity-driven physics — every drip pulled downward with anatomically accurate tension. Horror film practical effects quality — not painted, not stylized, photorealistic blood. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the viscous blood fluid physics, the suspended drips and the pooling. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as viscous crimson blood letters with tear-shaped drops held by surface tension, thinning connecting streams and near-black pooling. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise arterial red (#CC0000) grading to near-black clot (#3D0000).
style_layer.scene: Pure black void background — zero ambient fill, maximum contrast for crimson blood reads. Single cold key light from upper-left at 45° strikes letterform surfaces and ignites specular peaks on wet blood drip heads; cast shadows fall lower-right, deep and sharp. Letters occupy center frame with generous breathing room. Blood drips descend past the baseline toward lower-third, heaviest drip formations on letters with large surface area. No background decoration — only letters, blood, and darkness.

names.ja: アイスクリームドリップフォント

description.en: Chunky letters swirled with pink and cream soft-serve, melting into thick rounded drips over a pastel pink background.
description.ja: ピンクとクリームのソフトクリームが渦巻く厚い文字。丸く太いしずくとなって溶け落ち、背景はパステルピンク。
description.zh: 厚实字母上盘旋着粉色与奶油色软冰淇淋，融化成浓稠的圆润滴落，背景是粉彩粉色。
description.es: Letras gruesas cubiertas de helado suave rosa y crema en espiral, derritiéndose en gotas espesas y redondeadas sobre un fondo rosa pastel.
description.pt: Letras grossas envoltas em sorvete cremoso rosa e creme em espiral, derretendo em gotas espessas e arredondadas sobre um fundo rosa pastel.
description.de: Dicke Buchstaben, umwunden von rosa und cremefarbenem Softeis, das in dicken, runden Tropfen auf einem pastellrosa Hintergrund schmilzt.

style_layer.core: rendered in ice cream drip font style. Bold block letterforms dripping with melting soft-serve ice cream — thick creamy fluid flowing from every letter bottom, large rounded cream drops hanging with soft surface tension, slow viscous trails running down each letterform. Photorealistic ice cream texture: smooth creamy surface with subtle gloss, warm pastel color palette. Sweet summer aesthetic, gravity-pulled soft serve, visually delicious. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the melting soft-serve ice-cream fluid, the creamy drips and the gloss. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as bold block letters dripping melting soft-serve ice cream with large rounded cream drops and slow viscous trails. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise a warm pastel ice-cream palette.
style_layer.scene: Warm soft pastel background. Gentle overhead light — warm and inviting. Each letter dripping realistically with soft-serve ice cream.

description.en: Glossy orange-red letters liquefying from the base down, with molten drips, warped lower edges and a glowing puddle on a dark charcoal floor.
description.ja: 下から液化していく艶のあるオレンジレッドの文字。溶けた滴、ゆがんだ下端、暗いチャコールの床に光る水たまり。
description.zh: 亮面橙红字母从底部开始液化，熔融滴落、下缘变形，深炭色地面上一滩发光的液体。
description.es: Letras rojo anaranjado brillantes que se licúan desde la base, con goteos fundidos, bordes inferiores deformados y un charco luminoso sobre un suelo carbón oscuro.
description.pt: Letras laranja-avermelhadas brilhantes se liquefazendo a partir da base, com escorridos derretidos, bordas inferiores deformadas e uma poça luminosa num chão carvão escuro.
description.de: Glänzende orangerote Buchstaben, die von unten her flüssig werden, mit geschmolzenen Tropfen, verzogenen Unterkanten und einer leuchtenden Pfütze auf dunklem anthrazitfarbenem Boden.

style_layer.core: letter material liquefying and flowing downward under heat — lower portions lose structural integrity, edges softening and rounding outward as gravity pulls the molten mass down. Multiple drips of varying thickness: one to two thick primary flows with slight bulge at origin and teardrop termination, two to three medium streams, fine capillary trails between them. Surface tension visible at drip necks. Viscous pooling accumulates at the letter base with a faint wet-surface sheen. When no specific material is defined, the default melt color is warm amber-to-deep-orange — the natural thermal color of heated translucent material.
style_layer.scene: Intense overhead key light bleaches the top surface of the melting material, specular highlight arc running along the highest point of each character. Ambient heat glow radiates outward from the letterforms against a deep dark background with faint warm undertone — not pure black, the surrounding air carries residual heat. Glossy accumulated liquid at letter bases catches the overhead light as a narrow bright streak. Fine depth gradation: melting surface sharp, drip extremities crisp, heat haze softens at background edges.

description.en: Bold condensed slab capitals in one bright color with a halftone dot texture and a solid offset shadow in a second color, on a flat contrasting ground.
description.ja: 太く縦長のスラブセリフ大文字。片方の明るい色にハーフトーンの網点、もう一色でずらしたベタの影。対照的な色のフラットな地に。
description.zh: 粗壮窄长的板衬线大写字母，一种亮色带半调网点纹理，另一种颜色做实心错位阴影，置于对比色平涂底上。
description.es: Mayúsculas slab condensadas y gruesas en un color vivo con textura de semitono y una sombra sólida desplazada en un segundo color, sobre un fondo plano de contraste.
description.pt: Maiúsculas slab condensadas e grossas numa cor viva com textura de meio-tom e uma sombra sólida deslocada numa segunda cor, sobre um fundo chapado contrastante.
description.de: Kräftige, schmale Slab-Versalien in einer leuchtenden Farbe mit Rasterpunkt-Textur und einem versetzten Vollschatten in einer zweiten Farbe, auf einem flachen Kontrastgrund.

style_layer.core: a bold duotone piece — graphic, punchy and print-like. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is rendered in a striking two-color treatment — one bright color dominating the letter face, a second deep contrasting color filling the drop shadow, bevel inset or offset layer — with a visible halftone screen-dot pattern in the dominant color and a crisp hard-edged graphic finish. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a flat bold poster setting — clean two-tone ground, simple geometric or halftone accents, high-contrast graphic energy. PALETTE: any high-contrast two-color pair — vermillion red + midnight navy, electric blue + hot pink, black + bright accent — flat, saturated and bold, never gradient-soft or muddy. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (retro or Clarendon slab, condensed or geo sans, halftone comic, 3D shadow, sticker outline), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the two-color split, the halftone dots and the graphic poster finish. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in a bold duotone — bright face with a deep contrasting offset shadow and a halftone dot pattern — so the punchy two-color graphic always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits bold and graphic in a two-color duotone — a bright face with a deep contrasting offset shadow and a visible halftone dot pattern — on a clean flat two-tone ground with high-contrast poster energy. Punchy, graphic, print-style mood.

names.ja: エレガントスクリプト

description.en: Fine gold script with long hairline swashes and a looping capital, laid on matte black or ivory card beside luxury props under soft grazing light.
description.ja: 髪の毛のように細い長いスワッシュとループする頭文字を持つ繊細な金の筆記体。マットな黒やアイボリーのカードに高級な小物を添え、柔らかな斜光で。
description.zh: 精致的金色手写体，发丝般的长花饰与回环大写，置于哑光黑或象牙白卡纸上，旁有奢华道具，柔和掠射光。
description.es: Script dorado y fino con largos remates finísimos y una mayúscula en bucle, sobre cartulina negra mate o marfil junto a objetos de lujo bajo una luz rasante suave.
description.pt: Script dourado e fino com longos floreios finíssimos e uma maiúscula em laço, sobre cartão preto fosco ou marfim ao lado de objetos de luxo sob luz rasante suave.
description.de: Feine goldene Schreibschrift mit langen haarfeinen Schwüngen und geschlungener Initiale, auf mattschwarzem oder elfenbeinfarbenem Karton neben Luxusobjekten im sanften Streiflicht.

style_layer.core: the hushed luxury of a hand-signed brand mark. SURFACE / FINISH: where the lettering catches light it reads as fine metallic ink — warm gold, champagne or a soft rose-gold — or as a crisp blind-emboss / engraving pressed into the surface; restrained and expensive, never flashy. GROUND: a premium luxury surface — deep matte black, ivory or champagne card, soft marble, blush, or a dark editorial backdrop — with generous negative space and a single soft directional light that grazes the strokes. ATMOSPHERE: the elegant, intimate feel of a perfume-bottle signature, a couture label, a boutique logo or an engraved monogram — luxury branding, not a wedding scene. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own material or color, that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs the finish, the luxury ground, the light and the negative space. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in fine warm gold metallic ink on a premium ground (deep black, ivory or marble) with a single soft grazing light, so the luxury-signature feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The signature sits large and centered with elegant negative space on a premium luxury surface — deep matte black, an ivory card, soft marble or a blush editorial backdrop. A single soft directional light grazes the strokes to catch the metallic finish, with at most a whisper of an accent (a thin rule or a small sprig). Refined, intimate, expensive — a luxury brand signature, perfume label or boutique mark.

description.en: Serif capitals blind-embossed into ivory cotton paper: no ink, only a raised relief with a crisp highlight ridge and soft shadow from low raking light.
description.ja: アイボリーのコットン紙に空押ししたセリフ体大文字。インクはなく、低い斜光が浮き上がった凹凸のくっきりした稜線と柔らかな影だけを描きます。
description.zh: 衬线大写字母盲压在象牙白棉纸上：不着墨，只有凸起的浮雕，低角度斜光勾出清晰的高光脊与柔和阴影。
description.es: Mayúsculas con serifa estampadas en seco sobre papel de algodón marfil: sin tinta, solo un relieve con una arista de luz nítida y una sombra suave bajo luz rasante.
description.pt: Maiúsculas serifadas gravadas em relevo seco sobre papel de algodão marfim: sem tinta, apenas um relevo com aresta de luz nítida e sombra suave sob luz rasante baixa.
description.de: Serifenversalien blind in elfenbeinfarbenes Baumwollpapier geprägt: keine Tinte, nur ein Relief mit klarer Lichtkante und weichem Schatten im flachen Streiflicht.

style_layer.core: Fine paper fibers visible around letter edges where the relief meets the flat surface. Raking light from upper-left at a low angle reveals the raised topology: crisp highlight ridge along the top edge of each letter, soft shadow on the opposite side. No color added — tonal contrast is the only visual language. No gradients on letter faces, no glow, no outline strokes. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters, rendered as raised relief; this style governs the embossed topology and the raking light. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as a clean blind-embossed relief raised from premium paper, read only through raking-light highlight and shadow. COLOR PRIORITY: emboss adds no color of its own — keep the surface tonal; if the font specifies a color render it as a subtle tinted relief, otherwise natural paper tone.
style_layer.scene: Warm side lighting raking across a premium paper or card surface to emphasize the dimensional relief, fine paper-fiber texture catching the light, a soft shadow on the lee side of each letter. Minimal, elegant stationery aesthetic.

description.en: Flat slash-cut panels with a title plate and info bar, dark arena rim light, one team colour plus one acid accent, film grain and halftone edges.
description.ja: 斜めカットのパネルにタイトル板と情報バー、アリーナのリムライト、チームカラーと蛍光色のアクセント、フィルムグレインとハーフトーンの縁。
description.zh: 斜切面板配标题板和信息条，场馆轮廓光，一种队伍色加一种荧光强调色，胶片颗粒与网点边缘。
description.es: Paneles planos con corte diagonal, placa de título y barra de datos, luz de contorno de arena, un color de equipo más un acento ácido, grano y bordes de semitono.
description.pt: Painéis planos com corte diagonal, placa de título e barra de informações, luz de contorno de arena, uma cor de time mais um acento ácido, granulação e bordas em meio-tom.
description.de: Flache, schräg geschnittene Panels mit Titelplatte und Infoleiste, Arena-Kantenlicht, eine Teamfarbe plus ein knalliger Akzent, Filmkorn und Rasterkanten.

style_layer.core: esports team and tournament graphics a pro team or game streamer would publish: matchday poster, roster or result post, channel banner, stream screen, team badge. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: flat angular panels all cut at one shared slash angle of about 15 degrees, outer corners chamfered; a solid title panel carries the headline and a slim info bar beneath it carries the match or channel details; a tight group of three chevrons and one thin band of diagonal hazard stripes point one way; small corner brackets and tiny metadata text; optionally a row of empty sponsor boxes along one edge. LIGHT: a dark arena - hard white rim light from behind and above the subject, a soft team-coloured wash from an off-frame LED wall, light haze crossed by two or three narrow stage beams; edges brighter than the centre. COLOUR: near-black or deep navy over most of the frame; one bold team colour as a large flat panel field; one high-saturation accent (acid lime, electric cyan, hot magenta or signal orange) in one or two small spots; white only for small text; no rainbow gradients. TEXTURE: fine film grain, halftone dot fades along panel edges and faint scanlines; panels read as flat printed shapes, not glossy 3D objects. TIERS: streamer tier is darker with a thin accent glow along panel edges; pro tier floods larger areas with the team colour, drops the glow and shows more grain. No real game, league or team logos, no game characters, no player likenesses. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the team palette colours the letterforms only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the team colour and accent always appear in panels, rim light, LED wash and haze regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the headline sits on the flat title panel under hard white rim light, lifted by a thin dark drop shadow, in a dark arena of team-coloured haze.

description.en: Ornate silver serif capitals with a small crown, glowing softly in a midnight castle room beside an open storybook, with drifting golden sparkles.
description.ja: 小さな王冠をのせた華やかな銀のセリフ体大文字。真夜中の城の一室でほのかに光り、開いた絵本と舞う金色のきらめきが添えられます。
description.zh: 华丽的银色衬线大写字母顶着小王冠，在午夜城堡房间里微微发光，旁边是摊开的故事书和飘散的金色光点。
description.es: Mayúsculas con serifa plateadas y ornamentadas con una pequeña corona, brillando suavemente en una sala de castillo a medianoche junto a un libro de cuentos abierto y destellos dorados.
description.pt: Maiúsculas serifadas prateadas e ornamentadas com uma pequena coroa, brilhando suavemente num quarto de castelo à meia-noite ao lado de um livro de histórias aberto e brilhos dourados.
description.de: Verzierte silberne Serifenversalien mit kleiner Krone, sanft leuchtend in einem mitternächtlichen Burgzimmer neben einem aufgeschlagenen Märchenbuch und schwebendem Goldfunkeln.

style_layer.core:
Warm enchanted light environment — magical golden-amber luminosity fills the space from all sides, as if the air itself is enchanted: no single hard light source, but a diffuse warm glow that wraps all surfaces with candlelit warmth. Secondary light: cool silver-white moonlight touches from directly above, creating subtle top-catch highlights. Background palette: deep midnight blue to forest shadow black — rich darkness that makes warm magic visible. Atmospheric particles: fine light-dust drifts freely in the illuminated space — the ambient radiance of an enchanted world, not stuck-on decorative sparkles. Color tonality: warm gold and amber as dominant warmth, rose-pink as secondary accent, silver-white as moonlit crown catch.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default fairy tale light field — soft warm-amber ambient illumination wrapping all surfaces, gentle silver moonlight from above, deep midnight-blue to forest-black background, fine floating light-dust in air.
style_layer.scene: Enchanted world at night receding into soft bokeh depth behind the text — distant castle silhouette against moonlit sky, or ancient forest canopy with silver starlight filtering through, or candlelit storybook interior dissolving in warm shadow. Illumination: warm golden ambient light rising from within the scene, as if from an enchanted source below and around — not direct sunlight, not neon. Floating micro-particles: soft firefly traces far behind, gossamer sparkle in deep background layers, light-haze giving the air magical luminosity. Composition: text occupies the center third of the frame, bokeh depth pushing the enchanted world into dreamlike softness behind.

description.en: Warm family-love typography — cozy knit, soft golden light and heartfelt hand-written warmth. Perfect for family name signs, home quotes and cozy decor.
description.ja: 家族への愛情を感じさせる、あたたかなタイポグラフィ。心地よいニット、やわらかな黄金色の光、手書きのぬくもりが息づいています。家族の表札やホームクオート、居心地のよいインテリア装飾にぴったりです。
description.zh: 温暖的家庭之爱字体——柔软针织质感、金色暖光和手写的温柔心意。用来做家庭姓氏牌、居家标语和温馨装饰再合适不过。
description.es: Tipografía llena de amor familiar: tejido acogedor, luz dorada suave y la calidez de lo escrito a mano con el corazón. Perfecta para carteles con el apellido, frases para el hogar y decoración con encanto.
description.pt: Tipografia cheia de amor de família: tricô aconchegante, luz dourada suave e a ternura do escrito à mão com o coração. Perfeita para placas com o sobrenome, frases para casa e decoração cheia de charme.
description.de: Warme Familienliebe-Typografie — kuscheliges Strickmuster, sanftes goldenes Licht und herzliche handgeschriebene Wärme. Passend zu Familiennamensschildern, Wohnsprüchen und gemütlicher Deko, wenn du eine Familie Schrift für zu Hause suchst.

style_layer.core: a warm, heartfelt family-love piece — cozy, sincere and tender. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is finished with warmth — soft golden light emanating from the forms, cozy knit or fabric texture, a hand-written sincerity or a gentle vintage-photo warmth — depending on the chosen font. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a snug home setting — honey-golden light, soft blankets, a warm fireside or window glow, the tender mood of a family keepsake. PALETTE: warm and soft — honey gold, cream, soft terracotta, dusty rose and warm brown — cozy and heartfelt, never cold or harsh. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (cozy knit, handwritten or rounded hand, modern calligraphy, floral script, watercolor brush, velvet), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the warm golden light, the cozy texture and the heartfelt home scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in warm hand-written forms with soft honey-golden light and a cozy texture, so the heartfelt family warmth always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits warm and heartfelt with soft honey-golden light emanating from the forms, a cozy knit or fabric texture, set in a snug home with soft blankets and a warm fireside glow. Sincere, tender, family-love mood.

description.en: Blazing fire and smoke effects, dramatic heat waves and ember glow.
description.ja: 燃え盛る炎と煙のエフェクト、劇的な熱波と燃え残りの輝きを表現します。
description.zh: 熊熊燃烧的火焰与烟雾特效，戏剧化的热浪和余烬光芒。
description.es: Efectos ardientes de fuego y humo, ondas de calor dramáticas y el brillo de las brasas.
description.pt: Efeitos ardentes de fogo e fumaça, ondas de calor dramáticas e o brilho das brasas.
description.de: Lodernde Feuer- und Raucheffekte, dramatische Hitzewellen und Glutschein – eine Feuer Schrift, die wirklich brennt.

style_layer.core: Real combustion physics: white-yellow inner core transitioning through orange and deep red to wispy blue-grey outer tips. Turbulent flame tongues surge upward with natural random motion. Dense dark smoke billows in heavy rolling columns, curling upward — charcoal and near-black with faint translucency at edges. Firelight self-illuminates from below with warm amber-orange cast. Dramatic upward rim from intense heat source underneath. Background: deep charcoal haze with faint ember glow — not pure black. Cinematic fire photography quality. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the flame-and-smoke material, the combustion glow and the cast light. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters ablaze — a white-yellow core through orange to deep red flame tongues with dark rolling smoke and warm self-illumination from below. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise the natural fire spectrum of amber, orange and deep red.
style_layer.scene: Deep black background with dramatic contrast between the fire glow and the surrounding darkness, glowing embers drifting upward, a warm amber cast lighting the haze, heavy smoke curling into the black above.

names.ja: フラットカートゥーン

description.en: Friendly flat vector characters with dot eyes and simple shapes on plain colour fields or soft blobs, in bright coral, yellow and sky blue or muted terracotta and sage.
description.ja: 点の目とシンプルな形でできた親しみやすいフラットなベクターキャラを、無地の色面ややわらかな図形の上に。明るいコーラル・黄・空色、または落ち着いたテラコッタとセージで。
description.zh: 友好的扁平矢量角色，点点眼睛、简单几何形，站在纯色底或柔和色块上；明亮的珊瑚红、黄和天蓝，或柔和的陶土色和鼠尾草绿。
description.es: Personajes vectoriales planos y amables, con ojos de punto y formas simples sobre fondos lisos o manchas suaves, en coral, amarillo y celeste vivos o terracota y salvia apagados.
description.pt: Personagens vetoriais planos e simpáticos, com olhos de pontinho e formas simples sobre fundos lisos ou manchas suaves, em coral, amarelo e azul-celeste vivos ou terracota e sálvia suaves.
description.de: Freundliche flache Vektorfiguren mit Punktaugen und einfachen Formen auf schlichten Farbflächen oder weichen Blobs, in kräftigem Koralle, Gelb und Himmelblau oder gedecktem Terrakotta und Salbei.

style_layer.core: the kind of flat cartoon picture people set as a profile picture, split into matching couple or best-friend PFPs, print as stickers or post as a simple illustration. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: modern flat vector character illustration - friendly people and pets built from simple geometric shapes: round heads, dot eyes, a small curved smile, hair, hands and clothes as single solid shapes. Edges are colour against colour, with no heavy contour lines. Each character sits on one plain colour field or a soft organic blob, with a few small shapes around it: circles, leaves, sparkles, hearts. A single avatar keeps head and shoulders large and centred; a matching pair is two characters side by side, each centred in its own half on its own colour field, echoing each other in pose and palette so each half works alone as a profile picture. LIGHT: flat even fills with one soft darker shadow tone per shape, no gradients or gloss. COLOUR: four to six solid colours per picture. TEXTURE: crisp vector edges, at most faint background grain. TIERS: the playful bright tier uses saturated coral, sunny yellow, sky blue, mint and pink on cream or white (cartoon avatars, stickers, cheerful posts); the muted earthy tier uses terracotta, mustard, sage, dusty blue and warm beige with more empty space (calm couple PFPs, editorial illustrations). Characters are original, never famous cartoon or anime characters, never with big shiny anime eyes. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the tier palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the flat cartoon characters, plain colour fields, blob shapes and small scattered shapes in the palette always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a plain flat colour field under even shadowless light next to the flat cartoon characters.

description.en: Cream serif capitals entwined with burgundy peonies, cream roses and green vines that bloom from the letter ends, on a dark green ground.
description.ja: ワインレッドの牡丹、クリーム色のバラ、緑のつるが絡むクリーム色のセリフ体大文字。花は線の端から咲き、地は深い緑。
description.zh: 奶油色衬线大写字母缠绕着酒红牡丹、奶油玫瑰与绿藤，花朵从笔画末端绽放，底色为深绿。
description.es: Mayúsculas con serifa color crema entrelazadas con peonías burdeos, rosas crema y enredaderas verdes que florecen desde los extremos de las letras, sobre un fondo verde oscuro.
description.pt: Maiúsculas serifadas creme entrelaçadas com peônias bordô, rosas creme e trepadeiras verdes que florescem das pontas das letras, sobre um fundo verde-escuro.
description.de: Cremefarbene Serifenversalien, umrankt von bordeauxroten Pfingstrosen, cremefarbenen Rosen und grünen Ranken, die aus den Buchstabenenden erblühen, auf dunkelgrünem Grund.

style_layer.core: solid letterforms with botanical ornamentation — the letter strokes are the structural foundation, botanical elements are decoration growing FROM the surface, never replacing or obscuring the stroke. Letter outlines and counters must remain clearly readable at all times. Blooms cluster specifically at stroke terminals, junction points, and cap-height apexes; vines trail only along stroke edges without crossing into counter spaces; leaves emerge at stroke corners as thin accent details. Floral coverage rule: botanical elements visible on no more than 35% of any individual stroke face — the remaining 65% shows the clean letter surface beneath. Three-depth botanical layering: foreground accent blooms fully rendered with visible petal detail and stamens; mid-ground sprigs partially lit; background foliage dissolving into shadow. Default palette when no font specifies otherwise: deep jewel-toned botanicals against the letter surface — burgundy peonies, cream roses, forest-green leaves with venation, gold-dusted stamens — the restrained botanical ornament of Dutch Golden Age letter-painting, not a floral wreath that happens to spell a word.
style_layer.scene: Single directional key light from upper-left at 45° — the defining illumination of Dutch Golden Age floral still-life: dramatic tonal separation, foreground petals catching full light with translucent petal-edge glow, mid-ground blooms half-lit, background foliage dissolving into shadow. Background: deep dark — velvet black, forest green near-black, or midnight navy — never white; the letterforms emerge from darkness as botanical sculptures. Fine depth of field: front-most petals razor-sharp with visible surface texture (petal veining, waxy leaf sheen, stamen filament detail), background botanical elements dissolving into soft painterly blur. The impression: a letter-shaped Dutch floral arrangement photographed in a dark painter's studio — not a graphic, but a painting that happens to contain a letter.

names.ja: フューチャリスティック

description.en: Capitals built from glowing blue wireframe triangles, semi-transparent with a bright scan beam, floating over a grid floor between HUD corner brackets.
description.ja: 光る青いワイヤーフレームの三角メッシュで組んだ大文字。半透明で明るいスキャン光が走り、グリッド床の上、HUDの角括弧の間に浮かびます。
description.zh: 由发光蓝色线框三角网格构成的大写字母，半透明并有明亮扫描光束，悬浮在网格地面上方，四角有 HUD 括角。
description.es: Mayúsculas construidas con triángulos de malla azul luminosa, semitransparentes y con un haz de escaneo brillante, flotando sobre un suelo de cuadrícula entre esquinas de HUD.
description.pt: Maiúsculas construídas com triângulos de malha azul luminosa, semitransparentes e com um feixe de varredura brilhante, flutuando sobre um piso quadriculado entre cantos de HUD.
description.de: Versalien aus leuchtenden blauen Drahtgitter-Dreiecken, halbtransparent mit hellem Scanstrahl, schwebend über einem Rasterboden zwischen HUD-Eckklammern.

style_layer.core: rendered as a three-dimensional holographic projection — letterforms constructed from luminous triangulated wireframe mesh with razor-thin electric blue wireframe edges (RGB 0,160,255) forming the skeletal structure of each letter. Letter volumes are semi-transparent with inner glow: cold white core fading to electric blue at the edges. A horizontal scan beam of pure white-blue light sweeps across the letter surfaces. Letter surfaces have a glass-thin depth — exactly 15-20% letter-width thickness with beveled top face. Sharp neon blue outer glow halo radiates 4-6px around each letter edge. The material reads as: light-projected holographic data rendered by a near-future AI interface.
style_layer.scene: Deep space-black studio environment. A faint isometric ground grid in electric blue (#003366) extends toward the horizon — subtle, not dominant. The holographic text floats 20% above the grid plane, casting a soft blue glow-shadow downward. Ambient: deep blue atmospheric mist at the horizon, zero warm light sources. HUD corner-brackets in dim electric blue frame the four corners of the composition — thin single-pixel lines. Optional: a faint horizontal data-stream of tiny binary or hex characters scrolling behind the letters at 10% opacity. The scene reads as: a classified sci-fi interface rendered in real-time, clinical and cold, zero decoration.

description.en: Bauhaus capitals built from circles, squares and straight strokes in flat red, blue, yellow and black, standing as solid blocks under hard overhead light.
description.ja: 円、四角、直線で組み立てたバウハウス風の大文字。赤・青・黄・黒のベタ塗りで、硬いトップライトの下に積み木のように立ちます。
description.zh: 包豪斯式大写字母，由圆、方与直线构成，平涂红、蓝、黄、黑，像实心积木一样立在硬朗顶光下。
description.es: Mayúsculas Bauhaus construidas con círculos, cuadrados y trazos rectos en rojo, azul, amarillo y negro planos, erguidas como bloques sólidos bajo una luz cenital dura.
description.pt: Maiúsculas Bauhaus feitas de círculos, quadrados e traços retos em vermelho, azul, amarelo e preto chapados, de pé como blocos sólidos sob uma luz zenital dura.
description.de: Bauhaus-Versalien aus Kreisen, Quadraten und geraden Strichen in flachem Rot, Blau, Gelb und Schwarz, die wie massive Bausteine im harten Oberlicht stehen.

style_layer.core:
Bauhaus geometric environment: hard overhead directional light — single cold-white source, zero ambient scatter, ruler-sharp geometric shadow edges below all forms. Background plane is architecturally flat: pure black void, deep matte concrete, or stark white plaster. No depth haze, no organic texture, no atmospheric bokeh. Scene vocabulary: Bauhaus workshop geometry, De Stijl primary-color planes, Constructivist poster surface, Swiss grid precision.

Primary color atmosphere (always active): flat geometric primary-color planes — signal red, cobalt blue, cadmium yellow — appear as background architectural blocks or compositional color bars alongside the letterforms. Zero gradient, zero sheen.

When no specific material is defined by the font: letterforms rendered with Bauhaus primary color flat-paint treatment — each letter one vivid matte hue cycling across the primary palette: signal red, cobalt blue, cadmium yellow, flat black. Hard 45-degree isometric extrusion with pure-black side wall, depth 25% of letter height. Flat matte acrylic surface, zero sheen. Sharp machined edge between color face and extrusion wall.
style_layer.scene: Text centered, filling 78% of frame width. Background: pure flat black — absolute architectural void, no visible floor, no horizon. Head-on camera angle, zero perspective tilt. 4:3 format.

description.en: Clear optical-glass capitals refracting light, with bright edge highlights and caustics, reflected on a dark surface under a green-blue aurora sky.
description.ja: 光を屈折させる透明な光学ガラスの大文字。明るい縁のハイライトとコースティクスが、緑青のオーロラの空の下、暗い面に映り込みます。
description.zh: 透明光学玻璃大写字母折射光线，边缘高光明亮并带焦散，倒映在深色台面上，背景是青绿色极光夜空。
description.es: Mayúsculas de vidrio óptico transparente que refractan la luz, con brillos intensos en los bordes y cáusticas, reflejadas en una superficie oscura bajo una aurora verdeazulada.
description.pt: Maiúsculas de vidro óptico transparente refratando a luz, com brilhos fortes nas bordas e cáusticas, refletidas numa superfície escura sob uma aurora verde-azulada.
description.de: Klare Versalien aus optischem Glas, die Licht brechen, mit hellen Kantenlichtern und Kaustiken, gespiegelt auf dunkler Fläche unter grünblauem Polarlicht.

style_layer.core: sculpted from high-clarity optical glass — letters cast from pure transparent glass with intense light refraction through the material body. Brilliant caustic light patterns projected below each letter. Sharp specular highlights trace the letter edges where glass thickness transitions. Slight organic surface tension gives letterforms a subtle liquid-pulled quality at terminals and curves. Deep internal optical depth visible through the glass. Purely transparent — no frosting, no color tinting, no opacity. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the optical-glass material, the refraction and the caustics. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as high-clarity transparent optical glass with intense refraction, sharp edge specular highlights and bright caustic patterns cast below. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise pure clear glass with no tint.
style_layer.scene: Soft pastel gradient background — lavender to pale blue — a clean modern airy studio, with bright caustic light patterns pooling on the smooth surface below the letters, gentle ambient reflections and a light, weightless atmosphere.

description.en: Shattered into sharp glass fragments exploding outward — razor-sharp shards radiating from the impact center with jagged fracture lines. Cinematic high-impact destruction quality.
description.ja: 鋭いガラスの破片へと砕け散り、外へ向かって飛び散ります。衝撃の中心から放射状に広がるカミソリのように鋭い破片と、ギザギザに走る亀裂。映画のワンシーンのような、迫力ある破壊の質感です。
description.zh: 碎裂成锋利的玻璃碎片向外爆开——刀刃般的碎片从撞击中心呈放射状迸射，伴随锯齿状的裂纹。电影级的高冲击破坏质感。
description.es: Estallado en filosos fragmentos de vidrio que explotan hacia afuera: esquirlas afiladas como navajas que irradian desde el centro del impacto con líneas de fractura dentadas. Calidad de destrucción cinematográfica de alto impacto.
description.pt: Estilhaçado em fragmentos de vidro afiados que explodem para fora: cacos cortantes como lâmina irradiando do centro do impacto com linhas de fratura serrilhadas. Qualidade de destruição cinematográfica de alto impacto.
description.de: Zersplittert in scharfe Glasfragmente, die nach außen explodieren — messerscharfe Scherben, die vom Einschlagzentrum ausstrahlen, mit gezackten Bruchlinien. Filmreife Zerstörung mit hoher Wucht.

style_layer.core: shattered broken glass letterforms — each letter exploded from a central impact point with radial spiderweb crack networks. Three-tier shard fragmentation: large primary shards near impact core nearly flat; medium secondary shards tilting 15-45° outward; small tertiary splinters detached and floating in mid-air. Every glass shard face shows distinct optical behavior: front-facing shards catch brilliant white specular highlights; tilted shards reveal blue-green glass tint at thick edges; suspended splinters fire needle-sharp white glints from all four edges; crack intersections scatter concentrated white light. Peak visual moment: a constellation of needle-thin edge-glints from every floating shard — glass frozen mid-flight at maximum kinetic energy.
style_layer.scene: Deep charcoal-to-black gradient background with subtle concrete texture suggesting a demolished industrial interior. Harsh directional spotlight from upper-left: glass shards catch intense white specular flares on facing surfaces while back edges recede into deep shadow. Fine glass dust particles catch the spotlight as tiny bright specks floating in the air around each letter. Dramatic cinematic chiaroscuro — the frozen moment after violent impact, dangerous and sharp.

description.en: Thick solid glass letters, each a different jewel tone, casting colored light pools and caustic fans across a bright white studio floor.
description.ja: 一文字ずつ違う宝石色の、厚く中身の詰まったガラス文字。明るい白いスタジオの床に色の光だまりとコースティクスの扇を落とします。
description.zh: 厚实的实心玻璃字母，每个字母一种宝石色，在明亮的白色影棚地面上投出彩色光斑和焦散光扇。
description.es: Letras gruesas de vidrio macizo, cada una en un tono joya distinto, que proyectan charcos de luz de color y abanicos cáusticos sobre un suelo de estudio blanco y luminoso.
description.pt: Letras grossas de vidro maciço, cada uma num tom de joia diferente, projetando poças de luz colorida e leques cáusticos sobre um piso de estúdio branco e luminoso.
description.de: Dicke Buchstaben aus massivem Glas, jeder in einem anderen Edelsteinton, die farbige Lichtflecken und Kaustikfächer auf einen hellen weißen Studioboden werfen.

style_layer.core: sculpted as thick solid colored glass letterforms — each letter formed from deep-saturated jewel-tone glass with visible material weight and depth. The glass holds intense color throughout its body: ruby red, sapphire blue, emerald green, amber gold, cyan, or violet — color set by scene context. Top surfaces carry sharp mirror-bright specular highlights; side edges reveal full glass thickness with bright refracted light lines. Internal light scatters creating subsurface color gradients — luminous at the core, deeply saturated at edges. Caustic light patterns (rainbow-edged refraction fans) radiate from letter bases onto surrounding surfaces. Style may range from smooth precision-cut optical glass sculpture (modern) to segmented cathedral stained glass (traditional lead-came divided jewel panes) — determined by font choice. The defining quality: saturated transparent color glowing with transmitted light, like jewels held to sunlight.
style_layer.scene: Dark polished surface — black marble or deep charcoal lacquer — reflecting the colored glass letters from below with mirror clarity. A single strong spotlight from above-left generates brilliant caustic light fans spreading across the dark surface in the letter's dominant hue. Background fades to near-black with a faint complementary-color gradient haze. No clutter — the glass letters are the only light source, their refracted color the most saturated element in the frame.

description.en: Carved from pure gemstone crystal — faceted diamond-cut surfaces with brilliant rainbow prism dispersion and luxury sparkle. Caustic light patterns cast below.
description.ja: 純粋な宝石クリスタルから削り出した、ダイヤモンドカットのファセット面。鮮やかな虹色のプリズム分光と高級感あふれる輝きが特徴です。下面には集光模様が映し出されます。
description.zh: 从纯净宝石水晶中雕琢而成——钻石切割的刻面，绽放绚丽彩虹棱镜色散和奢华闪光。焦散光斑投落其下。
description.es: Tallado en cristal de gema pura: superficies facetadas con corte de diamante, brillante dispersión de prisma arcoíris y destello de lujo. Patrones de luz cáustica proyectados debajo.
description.pt: Esculpido em cristal de gema pura: superfícies facetadas com corte de diamante, dispersão de prisma arco-íris brilhante e brilho de luxo. Padrões de luz cáustica projetados abaixo.
description.de: Aus reinem Edelstein-Kristall geschliffen – facettierte Flächen im Diamantschliff mit brillanter Regenbogen-Prismenzerstreuung und luxuriösem Funkeln. Kaustische Lichtmuster fallen darunter.

style_layer.core: carved from flawless gemstone crystal — each letterform cut with precision faceted geometry following brilliant-cut and emerald-cut diamond principles. Table facet, crown facets, girdle edge, pavilion facets all precisely rendered. Optically pure material: Brilliance (white light return), Fire (rainbow spectral dispersion), Scintillation (extreme facet contrast sparkle). Internal caustic corridors visible. Six-point sparkle flares at letter apexes. Maximum optical drama — every letter a dazzling cut precious gemstone.
style_layer.scene: Deep navy-to-midnight-black gradient background — dark jeweler's velvet display atmosphere. Single hard overhead pinpoint spotlight creating extreme specular contrast on each crystal letter: table facets near-white brilliant, shadowed pavilion facets deep blue-violet — maximum facet contrast revealing every cut plane. Sharp six-point sparkle flares at each letter apex and prominent crown facet junction. Prismatic rainbow fire beams (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet) radiating from crown facets as sharp precise color beams across the dark background. Internal caustic light corridors glowing from within each letter. The letters appear to float against the deep dark background, each one a dazzling cut gemstone — the contrast between crystalline brilliance and deep background making every facet sing.

description.en: Encased in solid ice — thick frozen block with sharp edge facets, deep internal frost cracks, and icicle drips. Photorealistic frozen water quality.
description.ja: 分厚い氷の塊に閉じ込められた文字。鋭くカットされた氷のファセット、内部まで深く走る霜のひび割れ、そして垂れ下がるつらら。実写のようにリアルな氷結の質感です。
description.zh: 封进厚实的坚冰里——冰块棱角锋利，内部布满深层霜裂纹，还挂着垂落的冰锥。写实的冻水质感。
description.es: Encerrado en hielo macizo: un bloque grueso y congelado con facetas de bordes filosos, grietas internas de escarcha y goteos de carámbanos. Calidad fotorrealista de agua congelada.
description.pt: Preso em gelo maciço: um bloco espesso e congelado com facetas de bordas afiadas, rachaduras internas de geada e pingos de estalactites de gelo. Qualidade fotorrealista de água congelada.
description.de: In festem Eis eingeschlossen — dicker gefrorener Block mit scharfen Kantenfacetten, tiefen inneren Frostrissen und Eiszapfen-Tropfen. Diese Eis-Schrift hat fotorealistische Gefrierwasser-Qualität.

style_layer.core: rendered in deep-frozen solid ice letterforms — each letter a massive glacial ice block. Surface: smooth-polished outer ice face with faint frost micro-crystal bloom at letter edges and surface rim frost texture. Body: thick translucent ice with pale blue-white tint, internal air bubble inclusions caught as bright white spherical highlights, faint crack networks branching inward from surface stress points. Internal: deep cold glow emanating from letter center — subsurface scattering of cold light through the ice mass, brighter at core, fading toward edges. Optical behavior: incoming light refracts at the polished ice surface creating bright rim caustic lines at letter edges; internal ice density variation bends light into cold blue-white spectral micro-prisms; icicle extensions at letter bases show pure refraction clarity — crisp cold caustic light fans below. Peak visual moment: cold internal glow + surface frost bloom + refracted rim light + hanging icicle drips = letters physically frozen in time. Reference: blue glacier ice cave walls / Arctic sea ice block at dawn / Jökulsárlón glacial lagoon ice / professional ice sculptor competition piece under cold spotlight.
style_layer.scene: Deep arctic midnight background — near-black with a wide cold blue-teal atmospheric aurora glow spreading across the upper frame, subtly illuminating the frozen letters from behind. Fine airborne ice crystal particles catch the cold light as bright specks. The frozen letters are the sole light source in the dark composition — their internal cold glow and refracted rim light are the brightest elements in the frame. Zero warm tones. Maximum cold drama.

description.en: Rounded letters of flowing liquid glass in clear aqua, with glossy wet highlights and soft internal refraction, on a pale lavender-to-blue gradient.
description.ja: 流れる液体ガラスでできた丸みのある透明アクア色の文字。濡れたような艶のハイライトと柔らかな内部の屈折、淡いラベンダーから青へのグラデーション背景。
description.zh: 圆润的流动液态玻璃字母，透明水蓝色，带湿润光泽高光和柔和内部折射，背景是浅薰衣草到蓝的渐变。
description.es: Letras redondeadas de vidrio líquido fluido en aguamarina transparente, con brillos húmedos y una suave refracción interna, sobre un degradado de lavanda pálido a azul.
description.pt: Letras arredondadas de vidro líquido fluido em água-marinha transparente, com brilhos molhados e uma suave refração interna, sobre um degradê de lavanda claro a azul.
description.de: Runde Buchstaben aus fließendem Flüssigglas in klarem Aquamarin, mit nassen Glanzlichtern und sanfter innerer Brechung, vor einem Verlauf von zartem Lavendel zu Blau.

style_layer.core: Molten glass mid-flow physics: glossy wet surface with intense white specular highlights tracing maximum curvature points. Semi-transparent material with clear-to-blue-teal color gradient — shallow edge regions show faint blue-green tint, thick central volumes show deeper refractive depth. Internal caustic light patterns scatter within the glass body. Soft overhead diffused key light creates strong specular crowns while allowing the glass transparency to breathe against the background. Background: soft pastel gradient — pale lavender to ice blue — clean and airy, maximising glass transparency, refraction colour, and internal caustic visibility. Premium spatial-computing material aesthetic — premium, translucent, organically three-dimensional. Default drip rule: letters are solid volumetric glass forms — no drips, no liquid trails, no elongated drops hanging from letter bases, no actively flowing liquid effects. Exception: if the selected font explicitly describes drip, flow, or liquid-trail effects, follow the font description exactly — font-level drip instructions override this default.
style_layer.scene: Letters centered in frame, filling 75% of frame width. Soft pastel gradient background — pale lavender to ice blue — clean studio atmosphere. Diffused overhead light: intense white specular crown on each form, soft shadow beneath. Faint blue-green tint at letter bases, glass-depth gradient from edge to centre. Luxury tech product typography aesthetic — translucent, airy, premium.

description.en: Milky semi-transparent frosted glass panels with soft blur and glassmorphism aesthetic — thin glass border, blurred colorful background visible through surface. Modern UI quality.
description.ja: 乳白色の半透明フロストガラスパネルに、柔らかなブラーとグラスモーフィズムの質感を組み合わせたスタイルです。薄いガラスの縁取りと、表面を通して透ける色鮮やかでぼかされた背景が特徴です。モダンなUIならではの完成度を実現します。
description.zh: 乳白半透明的磨砂玻璃面板，柔和模糊，玻璃拟态质感——细细的玻璃边框，透过表面能看到背后模糊的彩色背景。现代 UI 级别的品质。
description.es: Paneles de vidrio esmerilado semitransparentes y lechosos, con desenfoque suave y estética glassmorphism: borde fino de vidrio y un fondo colorido y difuminado que se ve a través de la superficie. Calidad de UI moderna.
description.pt: Painéis de vidro fosco leitosos e semitransparentes, com desfoque suave e estética glassmorphism: borda fina de vidro e um fundo colorido e desfocado visível através da superfície. Qualidade de UI moderna.
description.de: Milchig-halbtransparente Milchglas-Paneele mit sanftem Weichzeichner und Glasmorphismus-Ästhetik — dünner Glasrand, verschwommener, farbiger Hintergrund durch die Oberfläche sichtbar. Moderne UI-Qualität.

style_layer.core: rendered as frosted glassmorphism panel letterforms — each letter a translucent frosted glass slab suspended in space with multi-layer depth. The glass material has three distinct optical zones: outer edge — a razor-thin bright white specular highlight line tracing the full letter perimeter; interior surface — semi-transparent milky frosted glass with subtle gaussian blur revealing the colorful background through it with 15-20% opacity; inner highlight — a soft internal glow where light concentrates at letter center. The frosted surface scatters light into a soft diffuse halo around each letter. Letter faces show characteristic glassmorphism: white inner border, background color bleeding through with subtle color shift, soft dark inner shadow at letter edges creating tactile depth. The typographic language of modern mobile-OS frosted panels, desktop glassmorphism UI, modern SaaS dashboard design — contemporary, airy, premium digital.
style_layer.scene: Rich bokeh background with vivid floating color orbs — deep midnight blue base with luminous colored light spheres: coral-orange, electric violet, cyan-teal, emerald green circles softly out of focus behind the frosted glass letters. The frosted letters sit in front of this colorful depth, their semi-transparent surfaces showing the blurred color orbs through them — each letter a window onto the colorful bokeh world behind. Background dark enough that frosted glass edge highlights read clearly. Overall aesthetic: modern premium app UI, floating glass cards over a vibrant abstract background — airy, layered, depth-rich.

description.en: White sans capitals split by red and cyan channel offsets, sliced by horizontal displacement bands and scanlines, reflected on a wet neon street at night.
description.ja: 赤とシアンのチャンネルずれで裂けた白いサンセリフ大文字。水平の変位スライスと走査線が走り、夜の濡れたネオン街に映ります。
description.zh: 白色无衬线大写字母被红青通道错位撕开，横向位移切片和扫描线贯穿，倒映在夜里湿漉漉的霓虹街道上。
description.es: Mayúsculas sans serif blancas partidas por desplazamientos de canal rojo y cian, cortadas por franjas horizontales y líneas de escaneo, reflejadas en una calle de neón mojada de noche.
description.pt: Maiúsculas sans serif brancas partidas por deslocamentos de canal vermelho e ciano, cortadas por faixas horizontais e linhas de varredura, refletidas numa rua de neon molhada à noite.
description.de: Weiße serifenlose Versalien, aufgerissen durch rote und cyanfarbene Kanalversätze, durchschnitten von horizontalen Verschiebungen und Scanlines, gespiegelt auf nasser Neonstraße bei Nacht.

style_layer.core: Core glitch effect: authentic RGB chromatic aberration — red channel shifted 5–8px to the left, cyan channel shifted 5–8px to the right, creating the classic double-vision color split on every letter edge. CRT scan lines: dense horizontal parallel lines across the entire text surface, spacing 3–4px, semi-transparent, rhythmic — simulating a real CRT phosphor screen. Pixel block artifacts: 3–5 sharp-edged rectangular chunks of letter pixels displaced horizontally by 10–25px at random vertical positions along the text. Edge glow: subtle cyan-white phosphor bloom emanating from letter boundaries. The glitch distortion is controlled and deliberate — text remains clearly readable. No random noise flood. No cartoon effects. Professional digital corruption aesthetic. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the RGB chromatic aberration, the scan lines and the pixel-displacement corruption. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters with a red/cyan channel split, dense CRT scan lines and displaced pixel blocks, kept clearly readable. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise the red-and-cyan split with cyan-white phosphor glow on a dark digital void.
style_layer.scene: Text fills the frame with maximum visual presence — large and dominant. VHS tracking error bands across the frame, dark digital void background with scattered corrupted pixel clusters.

description.en: Iron blackletter with sharp spurs and forged texture, edges burning crimson from backlight, inside a dark cathedral with cobwebs and drifting smoke.
description.ja: 鋭いとげと鍛造の質感を持つ鉄のブラックレター。縁は逆光で深紅に焼け、蜘蛛の巣と漂う煙のある暗い大聖堂の中に。
description.zh: 带尖刺和锻打纹理的铁质哥特黑体字，边缘被背光烧成深红，置于挂着蛛网、烟雾弥漫的幽暗大教堂中。
description.es: Blackletter de hierro con espolones afilados y textura forjada, bordes ardiendo en carmesí por la contraluz, dentro de una catedral oscura con telarañas y humo.
description.pt: Blackletter de ferro com esporões afiados e textura forjada, bordas ardendo em carmesim pela contraluz, dentro de uma catedral escura com teias de aranha e fumaça.
description.de: Eiserne Fraktur mit scharfen Sporen und geschmiedeter Textur, die Kanten im Gegenlicht karminrot glühend, in einer dunklen Kathedrale mit Spinnweben und Rauch.

style_layer.core: a dark, dramatic gothic piece, ominous and atmospheric. SURFACE / STYLE: heavy gothic lettering forged from cold dark material — black iron with hammer marks and rust, or deep-carved weathered stone, or wet black surfaces — with cobweb strands stretching across the gaps and beads of cold moisture. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: deep shadow pierced by dramatic crimson backlighting that burns glowing red edges around the letters, faint drifting smoke or mist, the air of a dungeon, crypt or gothic cathedral. PALETTE: near-black and charcoal grounds with deep blood-crimson light and cold steel highlights — dark and saturated, never bright. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (iron blackletter, dripping blood, stained glass, flame, engraved tombstone, metal-band logo, ornate tattoo), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs the dark material, the crimson backlight, the cobweb-and-smoke atmosphere and the crypt scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as cold dark iron or weathered stone with a crimson rim-light burning behind them, faint cobweb and cold moisture, against a near-black ground, so the dark gothic dread always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text stands bold and dominant in deep shadow, dramatic crimson backlighting burning glowing red edges around it, faint cobweb strands and drifting smoke in the gaps, set in a cold gothic crypt, dungeon or cathedral of damp dark stone. Ominous, atmospheric, dread-soaked dark-gothic mood.

description.en: Precise Textura blackletter: narrow broken strokes, diamond terminals and strong thick-thin contrast, in black ink with gold-touched edges on dark aged parchment.
description.ja: 端正なテクストゥーラのブラックレター。細く折れる線、菱形の筆端、強い太細の差を、金でふちどった黒インクで暗い古い羊皮紙に。
description.zh: 严谨的 Textura 哥特黑体：窄长的折笔、菱形笔端和强烈粗细对比，黑墨带金色描边，写在深色旧羊皮纸上。
description.es: Blackletter Textura precisa: trazos estrechos y quebrados, remates en rombo y fuerte contraste grueso-fino, en tinta negra con toques dorados sobre pergamino oscuro y envejecido.
description.pt: Blackletter Textura precisa: traços estreitos e quebrados, terminais em losango e forte contraste grosso-fino, em tinta preta com toques dourados sobre pergaminho escuro e envelhecido.
description.de: Präzise Textura-Fraktur: schmale, gebrochene Striche, rautenförmige Enden und starker Kontrast von dick und dünn, in schwarzer Tinte mit Goldakzenten auf dunklem, altem Pergament.

style_layer.core: rendered in precise gothic blackletter letterforms with authentic calligraphic construction — diamond-shaped stroke terminals, strong thick-thin contrast, pointed arch counters. Rich black ink with warm depth on dark parchment or deep charcoal background. Subtle gold ink highlights on serifs and capitals. Medieval scribal precision. No cobwebs, no rust, no atmospheric fog — pure typographic craft. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the rich ink, the parchment ground and the subtle gold highlights. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as precise gothic blackletter in rich black ink with subtle gold highlights on dark parchment — pure typographic craft, no cobwebs, rust or fog. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise black ink with warm gold accents.
style_layer.scene: Medieval cathedral interior with stone arches fading into fog, candlelight flickering on nearby surfaces, shaft of pale moonlight from broken stained glass window, incense smoke curling through the air.

description.en: Wildstyle spray-paint letters with sharp arrows and overlapping shapes, filled in bright layered colors, locked in a thick black outline with drips on a red brick wall.
description.ja: 鋭い矢印と重なり合う形のワイルドスタイルのスプレー文字。鮮やかな色を重ねて塗り、太い黒フチで締め、赤レンガの壁に塗料の垂れ。
description.zh: 狂野风格的喷漆字母，带尖锐箭头和重叠造型，填满层叠的鲜艳色彩，粗黑描边锁边，红砖墙上还有颜料滴痕。
description.es: Letras wildstyle de espray con flechas afiladas y formas superpuestas, rellenas de colores vivos en capas, encerradas en un grueso contorno negro con chorreones sobre un muro de ladrillo rojo.
description.pt: Letras wildstyle de spray com setas afiadas e formas sobrepostas, preenchidas com cores vivas em camadas, presas num contorno preto grosso com escorridos sobre uma parede de tijolos vermelhos.
description.de: Wildstyle-Sprühbuchstaben mit scharfen Pfeilen und überlappenden Formen, in leuchtenden Farbschichten gefüllt, von dicker schwarzer Kontur gehalten, mit Farbläufen auf roter Backsteinwand.

style_layer.core: a wall coming alive with spray paint. PAINT: bold letters built up in physical layers of aerosol — a base fill, a thick load-bearing black outline holding the shapes, bright highlights and a 3D block shadow; paint drips run from the heavy spots, overspray mist haloes the edges, spray-can mottling and splatter droplets on the surface.
