COLOR: a full high-impact spray-can palette chosen for chromatic vibration — classic chrome-silver-and-black, electric blue, hot magenta, lime, orange, or multi-color fades — saturated for maximum punch at distance. GROUND: a real urban surface — red brick, grey concrete, a metal roller shutter or subway car — paint drips pooling below. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (wildstyle arrows, stencil bridges, marker handstyle, bubble, blockbuster, drips), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs the spray layering, outline, drips, palette and the wall behind. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, spray the letters in layered aerosol with a thick black outline, bright fill, drips and overspray on a brick or concrete wall, so the graffiti energy always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text dominates a real urban wall — red brick, grey concrete or a metal roller shutter — sprayed large and bold with paint drips running down to the pavement below, overspray haze around it and a couple of splatter marks. Gritty street daylight. Raw graffiti-piece energy with attitude — streetwear, hip-hop and skate culture.

description.en: Ransom-note letters cut from mixed newspaper type, taped onto raw photocopied paper with halftone speckle, torn edges and a single punk-red accent.
description.ja: さまざまな新聞の活字を切り抜いた脅迫状風の文字。コピーした粗い紙にテープで貼り、ハーフトーンの粒、破れた縁、パンクな赤をひとさし。
description.zh: 从各式报纸字剪下拼成的勒索信字母，用胶带贴在影印粗纸上，带半调噪点、撕边和一抹朋克红。
description.es: Letras de nota de rescate recortadas de distintos periódicos, pegadas con cinta sobre papel fotocopiado tosco con moteado de semitono, bordes rasgados y un único acento rojo punk.
description.pt: Letras de bilhete de resgate recortadas de vários jornais, coladas com fita sobre papel fotocopiado áspero com pontilhado de meio-tom, bordas rasgadas e um único toque vermelho punk.
description.de: Erpresserbrief-Buchstaben aus verschiedenen Zeitungen geschnitten, mit Klebeband auf rauem Kopierpapier mit Rasterkörnung, eingerissenen Kanten und einem einzigen Punk-Rot-Akzent.

style_layer.core: a photocopied punk-zine world. PRINT: everything looks run through a cheap copier and pasted up by hand — coarse halftone dot screens, heavy black ink that bleeds and clogs, low-ink dropout and roller streaks, photocopy speckle and nth-generation blur on raw off-white newsprint and photocopy paper. TEXTURE: torn and scissor-cut paper edges, strips of tape, lifted corners, creases, scratches, smears and spray-paint overspray — the evidence of a hand working under pressure. LIMITED PALETTE: the cheap two-color reproduction palette — high-contrast black ink and raw off-white paper, with one punchy punk RED as the accent (occasionally a hit of acid yellow), printed slightly off-register. ENERGY: a layered cut-and-paste collage grammar, asymmetric and disrupted like a stapled zine. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own material or treatment (ransom-note collage, riso halftone, distressed, spray, stamp, ink-bleed), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs the paper, print degradation, palette and surrounding collage. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, print the letters in heavy high-contrast black ink on raw off-white paper with photocopy grain, ink bleed and torn edges, so the grunge zine feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits bold and dominant, pasted up like the cover of a photocopied punk zine on raw off-white paper, surrounded by torn paper scraps, strips of tape, ink splatter and a slash of red. Halftone grain, photocopy speckle and a faint off-register print shift run across everything. Raw, asymmetric, cut-and-paste DIY energy — punk poster, streetwear and album-cover attitude.

description.en: Delicate handwritten script in walnut-brown ink on warm cream paper, with flowing connected letters and soft loops, beside a dip pen and an inkwell.
description.ja: 暖かなクリーム色の紙に書いたウォルナットブラウンのインクの繊細な手書き筆記体。文字はなめらかにつながり柔らかなループ、横にはつけペンとインク壺。
description.zh: 细腻的胡桃棕墨水手写体，写在暖米色纸上，字母流畅相连、回环柔和，旁边是蘸水笔和墨水瓶。
description.es: Delicado script manuscrito en tinta marrón nogal sobre papel crema cálido, con letras enlazadas y bucles suaves, junto a una plumilla y un tintero.
description.pt: Delicado script manuscrito em tinta marrom-nogueira sobre papel creme quente, com letras ligadas e laços suaves, ao lado de uma pena de molhar e um tinteiro.
description.de: Zarte Handschrift in nussbrauner Tinte auf warmem cremefarbenem Papier, mit fließend verbundenen Buchstaben und weichen Schlaufen, neben Federhalter und Tintenfass.

style_layer.core:
Intimate writing-desk light field — warm directional light arriving from a 30–45-degree upper-left angle, the quality of morning window light filtering through gauze or the halo of a brass desk lamp; this raking light travels across the paper surface at low angles, revealing fiber tooth and ink body depth simultaneously. Secondary warm fill from the right side at 20–25% key intensity preserves intimate shadow without eliminating it. The substrate is always textured paper: hot-press cotton rag, aged parchment, smooth vellum, cream laid stock, or cold-press watercolor paper — paper surface grain and fiber are visibly revealed under raking light, with a subtle warmth yellowing toward the edges. Ink sits proud on the surface: a subtle wet sheen at maximum-density stroke points, matte dry finish at hairlines; at dramatic stroke termini, micro-droplets of ink may cling to paper fiber. Atmospheric details: floating paper dust motes caught in window light rays, faint ink bloom halos around dense stroke endpoints. Color temperature: warm amber-sepia throughout the background environment and paper surface; slightly cooler clear-white at the central text zone for luminous contrast. Background beyond the writing surface: soft warm bokeh or warm shadow — never competing with the foreground. Letter surface color and material are defined entirely by each font's own prompt_core — this style provides only the writing-desk light field, paper substrate environment, and ink-on-surface atmosphere.

When no specific material is defined by the font: morning window light from upper-left at 35 degrees on warm cream cotton laid paper, paper fiber texture clearly visible under raking light, soft amber fill from the right at 25% intensity.
style_layer.scene: Cream hot-press cotton rag paper fills the entire frame — the paper surface IS the background. Raking morning light from the upper-left at 30 degrees reveals every fiber and chain line in the paper tooth; the paper glows warmly toward the light, deepening to a rich parchment amber toward the lower-right corner. The calligraphic text sits centered in the upper-to-mid area of the frame, occupying most of the available width. Ink sits proud on the paper surface: thick downstrokes hold a subtle wet sheen, hairline upstrokes almost disappear into the cream fibers. In the lower-right area of the paper: a deep crimson wax seal — round, roughly 2 cm — stamped with a small botanical motif, its raised relief casting a tiny shadow. No table surface visible. No background beyond the paper itself. The paper edges are softly lit, with a very slight vignette. This is a letter, complete and intimate, before it was ever sent.

description.en: Tropical Hawaiian typography with tiki bar aesthetics, hibiscus flower accents, bamboo textures, ocean sunset gradients and island paradise vibes.
description.ja: ティキバー風の意匠にハイビスカスの花のアクセント、竹のテクスチャ、海に沈む夕日のグラデーション、南国の楽園ムードを重ねたトロピカルなハワイアンタイポグラフィです。
description.zh: 热带夏威夷字体，融合提基酒吧风情、木槿花点缀、竹子纹理、海洋日落渐变和海岛天堂氛围。
description.es: Tipografía tropical hawaiana con estética de bar tiki, detalles de flores de hibisco, texturas de bambú, degradados de atardecer sobre el mar y vibras de paraíso isleño.
description.pt: Tipografia tropical havaiana com estética de bar tiki, detalhes de flores de hibisco, texturas de bambu, degradês de pôr do sol no mar e clima de paraíso das ilhas.
description.de: Tropische Hawaii Schrift mit Tiki-Bar-Ästhetik, Hibiskus-Akzenten, Bambustexturen, Ozean-Sonnenuntergangs-Verläufen und Inselparadies-Vibes.

style_layer.core: Tropical tiki bar atmosphere — deep aged mahogany surfaces with natural bamboo grain running horizontally across the letterforms, shallow relief carved texture suggesting hand-carved island woodwork. Warm overhead sunlight blazing from above creates bright golden highlights on raised bamboo ridges and deep amber shadow in carved recesses. Coral orange rim light from the side edge catches every groove. The material environment is saturated island warmth: deep tropical brown, burnished coral gold, leaf shadow green in the background. Hibiscus blossoms and broad palm fronds surround the composition as environmental elements — not decorating the letters but present as living tropical backdrop. Forbidden: cold steel or chrome surfaces, urban concrete backgrounds, snow or ice textures, any muted or desaturated palette.
style_layer.scene: Deep tropical nightfall tiki bar setting — weathered dark wood plank walls with coconut shell and tiki torch sconces casting warm amber pools of light. Text centered with generous breathing room, set against a dark bamboo-paneled wall draped with fresh plumeria flower garlands. Tiki torches frame the left and right edges, their flame glow warming the scene edges with flickering orange. Ground level scattered with tropical flowers in soft focus. Atmosphere: golden-hour warmth, lush, celebratory.

description.en: Rounded sans letters with an iridescent foil surface shifting violet, cyan, pink and gold, glossy reflections on a dark floor with small light specks.
description.ja: 紫、シアン、ピンク、金へと移ろう虹色の箔面を持つ丸いサンセリフ文字。暗い床に艶のある映り込みと小さな光の粒。
description.zh: 圆润的无衬线字母，镭射箔面在紫、青、粉、金之间变幻，深色地面上有亮面倒影和细小光点。
description.es: Letras sans serif redondeadas con superficie de lámina iridiscente que cambia entre violeta, cian, rosa y dorado, con reflejos brillantes en un suelo oscuro y pequeños puntos de luz.
description.pt: Letras sans serif arredondadas com superfície de folha iridescente que muda entre violeta, ciano, rosa e dourado, com reflexos brilhantes num chão escuro e pequenos pontos de luz.
description.de: Runde serifenlose Buchstaben mit irisierender Folienoberfläche, die zwischen Violett, Cyan, Pink und Gold wechselt, glänzend gespiegelt auf dunklem Boden mit kleinen Lichtpunkten.

style_layer.core: rendered with iridescent holographic foil effect — multi-layer diffractive film surface producing rainbow spectral shifts across the letter faces, cycling through deep violet, electric cyan, hot pink to warm gold as viewing angle changes, like light diffracting through a stacked polymer security foil. The color shift is the result of structural interference, not pigment: each hue blooms and fades with directional light. Semi-transparent depth visible through the letter surface — background bleeds through with slight chromatic distortion. At all letter edges, rainbow chromatic fringe dissolves outward into scattered prismatic light particles, softening the hard boundary between letterform and space. Fine diffraction grating micro-texture across the surface. Pure black background. Directional overhead light source.
style_layer.scene: Centered composition on pure black background. Prismatic scattered light spots in background from diffractive scatter off letter surfaces. Mirror-like reflective base plane with iridescent color bleed in ground reflections.

description.en: Thin jagged red letters dripping blood, lit by a single bare bulb in a flooded tunnel, reflected in dark still water.
description.ja: 血が滴る細くぎざぎざした赤い文字。水没したトンネルのただ一つの裸電球に照らされ、暗く静かな水面に映ります。
description.zh: 细瘦参差的红色字母不断滴血，被积水隧道里唯一一盏裸灯照亮，倒映在漆黑静止的水面上。
description.es: Letras rojas finas y dentadas que gotean sangre, iluminadas por una sola bombilla desnuda en un túnel inundado y reflejadas en agua oscura y quieta.
description.pt: Letras vermelhas finas e serrilhadas pingando sangue, iluminadas por uma única lâmpada nua num túnel alagado e refletidas em água escura e parada.
description.de: Dünne, gezackte rote Buchstaben, von denen Blut tropft, beleuchtet von einer einzigen nackten Glühbirne in einem gefluteten Tunnel und gespiegelt im dunklen, stillen Wasser.

style_layer.core:
Consumer Halloween horror typography. Graphic, bold, and immediately readable as "spooky" -- the visual language of seasonal design: T-shirts, party invites, phone cases, social media posts.

HALLOWEEN HORROR RULES (apply to every shot):
- Underlighting by default. Warm amber-orange key from directly below, deep shadow filling the upper two-thirds. Candle-beneath-the-face.
- Extreme contrast, no mid-tones. Lit surfaces near-maximum brightness, shadow zones near-black. Nothing gradual, nothing soft.
- Background always dark. Near-black with warm amber or sickly yellow-green secondary fill at very low opacity. No neutral grays.
- Color regime: blood is deep candy-red to dark crimson; fire is amber-orange with bright core; decay is dark brown, rust, mold green.
- Graphic and immediate. If the effect reads clearly on a printed T-shirt or party poster, it is correct.

FORBIDDEN: cinematic framing rules, single-light psychological analysis, desaturated fog atmospherics, flat studio lighting.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment -- warm amber-orange underlighting from directly below, deep shadow above, near-black background with sickly yellow-green secondary fill at 8% opacity at ground level.
style_layer.scene: Against a near-black background with rough dark stone wall texture at 10% opacity. Warm amber-orange light from directly below casting deep upward shadows. Faint wisps of ground-level fog. Haunting, Halloween atmospheric composition.

description.en: Translucent ice-crystal capitals with spiky frost feathering along every edge, glowing under icy blue backlight with drifting snow dust.
description.ja: すべての縁にとげのような霜の羽が伸びる半透明の氷の結晶の大文字。氷のような青い逆光で輝き、雪の粉が舞います。
description.zh: 半透明的冰晶大写字母，每道边缘都长着尖刺状霜花，冰蓝色逆光下发光，四周飘着雪尘。
description.es: Mayúsculas translúcidas de cristal de hielo con plumas de escarcha puntiagudas en cada borde, brillando bajo una contraluz azul helada con polvo de nieve.
description.pt: Maiúsculas translúcidas de cristal de gelo com plumas de geada pontiagudas em cada borda, brilhando sob uma contraluz azul gelada com pó de neve.
description.de: Durchscheinende Eiskristall-Versalien mit stacheligen Raureiffedern an jeder Kante, leuchtend im eisblauen Gegenlicht mit treibendem Schneestaub.

style_layer.core: a frozen ice-crystal piece — cold, crystalline and luminous. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is formed from clear crystalline ice with frost feathering like frozen fern leaves spreading from the edges, transparent ice refracting light, tiny suspended ice particles and a glassy frozen surface. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a cold winter setting — icy blue backlight, drifting frost and snow dust, dramatic rim light catching the crystal edges. PALETTE: cool blue-white — ice blue, cyan, frost white and pale teal with crisp highlights — cold and luminous, never warm. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (ice crystal, ice shard, 3D ice, frost display, ice drip, clear glass), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the crystalline ice material, the frost feathering, the cool backlight and the blue-white palette. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as clear crystalline ice with frost feathering at the edges, refraction and a cold blue rim light, so the frozen ice feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits clear and crystalline as frozen ice, frost feathering like fern leaves spreading from the edges, suspended ice particles in cold air, dramatic icy blue backlight catching the crystal edges. Cold, luminous, frozen winter mood.

description.en: Bold 45-degree text shadow effects in flat retro-poster colors — the long shadow look vintage design templates are built on.
description.ja: 45度のフラットな長い影がつく文字エフェクト。暖色系のレトロポスター配色で、ヴィンテージデザインテンプレートの定番になっている見た目です。
description.zh: 扁平45度长阴影文字效果，暖色调复古海报配色——就是复古设计模板常用的那种长阴影质感。
description.es: Efectos de sombra de texto en 45 grados con colores de póster retro planos — el look de sombra larga en el que se basan las plantillas de diseño vintage.
description.pt: Efeitos de sombra de texto em 45 graus com cores de pôster retrô planas — o visual de sombra longa em que os templates de design vintage são construídos.
description.de: Kräftige 45-Grad-Textschatten-Effekte in flachen Retro-Poster-Farben — der Long-Shadow-Look, auf dem Vintage-Design-Vorlagen basieren.

style_layer.core:
LONG SHADOW (mandatory, every letter): each letter casts a second, darker copy of its shape, dragged toward the lower-right at 45 degrees, 2.5-3x the letter height -- large, unmistakable, covering much of the background. NOT a plain letter with no shadow. NOT a small drop shadow. The shadow is one flat solid color with a crisp straight edge: no gradient, no blur, no glow, no bevel, no vanishing point -- flat, not a 3D block.

COLOR: font's own color takes priority for the letter; the shadow uses a darker tone of it. No font color -> cream-white letter, deep brown-black shadow.

ATMOSPHERE: a flat-graphic register -- no photographic texture, no gradient sky -- in a warm muted retro palette (mustard, burnt orange, faded teal, olive), one consistent light source from the upper-left, like a printed vintage text-effect template rather than a photograph.
style_layer.scene: Centered on a flat solid-color background, filling about 70% of the frame width, generous even margin on all sides, no other elements in frame.

description.en: Rounded retro computer windows with a slim info bar, scattered heart and sparkle stickers, soft daylight, a cream base with two pastels, grid paper and lace.

description.zh: 带细信息条的圆角复古电脑窗口，散落的爱心和闪光贴纸，柔和日光，奶白底配两种粉彩，方格纸与蕾丝。

style_layer.core: soft pastel stream graphics a cute streamer or VTuber would actually put on stream or post: starting-soon, be-right-back and stream-ended screens, debut announcements, channel banners, schedule posts and info panels. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: the words sit in rounded retro computer windows and soft UI panels with tiny title bars, three little dot buttons and a slim info bar beneath the title; on starting and ending screens one large empty rounded window is left open for the streamer's avatar or camera; small stickers are scattered around the edges - hearts, four-point sparkles, stars, puffy clouds and ribbon bows - and small notes or instant-photo frames may sit in the corners. COLOUR: a cream white or very pale base with two pastel colours (baby pink and sky blue, lilac and mint, or peach and lavender) plus small touches of a third; lots of breathing space; never dark, never neon-saturated. TIERS: the sweet tier is white, pink and sky blue with lace, clouds and ribbons, very bright; the Y2K pixel tier uses lilac and baby pink with pixel-stepped window corners, pixel buttons and tiny pixel hearts. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the pastel palette colours the letterforms only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the pastel palette, the windows and the stickers always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the title sits in a rounded window under soft even daylight with a faint soft shadow, on a cream grid-paper background.

description.es: Letras de globo metalizado brillante en rosa, amarillo, azul y verde, flotando entre pequeños globos, confeti, estrellas y corazones sobre un fondo azul cielo claro.
description.pt: Letras de balão metalizado brilhante em rosa, amarelo, azul e verde, flutuando entre pequenos balões, confete, estrelas e corações sobre um fundo azul-céu claro.
description.de: Glänzende Folienballon-Buchstaben in Pink, Gelb, Blau und Grün, schwebend zwischen kleinen Ballons, Konfetti, Sternen und Herzen vor hellem Himmelblau.

style_layer.core: a playful, joyful kids-gift piece — bright, fun and magical. style_layer.scene: The text sits bright and playful as glossy chunky toy letters, foil balloons or chunky crayon strokes in candy colors, with cute stars, hearts, confetti and rainbow sparkle scattered around a cheerful party backdrop. Joyful, magical kids-party mood.

description.pt: Maiúsculas sans serif grossas cortadas em madeira de bétula quente, com bordas de corte queimadas e veios visíveis, em relevo sobre uma tábua de nogueira escura com luz lateral âmbar.
description.de: Kräftige serifenlose Versalien aus warmem Birkenholz gelasert, mit verkohlten Schnittkanten und sichtbarer Maserung, erhaben auf dunklem Nussbaumbrett im bernsteinfarbenen Seitenlicht.

style_layer.core:
Precision fabrication aesthetic: text exists as physical cut material — not rendered, not painted. The laser kerf is the only boundary: mathematically exact edges, zero roughness.

MATERIAL SURFACE RULES:
— Wood: warm grain on letter face (birch honey or dark walnut); charred dark seam along every kerf edge; cross-grain cross-section at cut face. Gentle warm transmission through thin sections.
— Acrylic: glassy-smooth kerf edges scatter light as luminous halos — frosted emits soft white-blue edge glow; clear creates prismatic edge-light. Face stays matte or polished.
— Metal: bright machined cut face against brushed exterior. Raking light reveals mechanical precision and directional grain.
— Paper/Organic: bone-clean cut edges casting hairline shadows on backing. Maximum filigree detail preserved.

FABRICATION LAWS (all materials):
— Enclosed counters (O,D,B,P,R,A) retained by structural bridge connections — thin material tabs turned into design features.
— Material thickness always visible as dimensional depth: each letter is a physical slab.
— Negative space is real air or backing material showing through.
— No added outlines, glow effects, or drop shadows — the kerf edge is the only boundary.

FORBIDDEN: graphic fills, smooth gradient fills on letter faces, extruded 3D depth.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting — warm amber side light raking from low-left, deep warm shadow on right and behind, dark warm-brown craft-studio background.
style_layer.scene: Dark raw-timber workshop surface or dark slate slab beneath the cut piece, background in near-black with warm craft-studio atmosphere. Directional key light from upper-left at a shallow rake angle — casting fine sharp shadow lines along every kerf edge and revealing the material slab depth. Warm amber secondary fill from low right. The cut piece presented flat, just released from the machine bed: clean, exact, nothing to add.

description.ja: 細かな箔のしわがある重厚な鋳造金の大文字。くぼみには深い琥珀色の影、頂点には明るい反射。一灯のスポットライトで黒の中に浮かびます。
description.zh: 厚重的铸金大写字母带细密箔纹，凹处是深琥珀阴影、高点是明亮反光，在单束聚光下孤立于黑色背景。
description.es: Mayúsculas pesadas de oro fundido con un fino arrugado de lámina, sombras ámbar profundas en los huecos y brillos especulares intensos, aisladas sobre negro bajo un solo foco.
description.pt: Maiúsculas pesadas de ouro fundido com um fino amassado de folha, sombras âmbar profundas nos recessos e brilhos especulares intensos, isoladas sobre preto sob um único holofote.
description.de: Schwere gegossene Goldversalien mit feiner Folienknitterung, tiefen bernsteinfarbenen Schatten in den Vertiefungen und hellen Glanzspitzen, freigestellt auf Schwarz unter einem einzigen Spot.

style_layer.core: Liquid 24-karat gold molten surface — microscopic foil crinkle texture across all faces, deep amber pooling in recesses, rich warm gold across main surfaces, razor-bright champagne-white specular peaks where direct light strikes. Subtle embossed relief depth — each letterform has physical mass and weight, like cast or stamped precious metal with visible surface thickness. Single dramatic spotlight from upper-left, angled 45°, creates crisp directional shadow and intense highlight contrast. Background: pure deep black — zero ambient fill, forcing all luminosity to belong to the gold.
style_layer.scene: Letters centered in frame, filling 70-80% of canvas width. Pure deep black background — high contrast to maximise gold luminosity. Optional: subtle warm amber light pool on the ground plane beneath letters.

description.en: Ancient spellbook typography with mystical runes, arcane glow effects, dark magical atmosphere and wizard-inspired ornate letterforms.
description.ja: 神秘的なルーン、秘術的なグローエフェクト、ダークな魔法の雰囲気、そして魔法使いを思わせる装飾的な文字で表現する、古い魔導書のようなタイポグラフィです。
