description.es: Tipografía de grimorio antiguo con runas místicas, efectos de brillo arcano, atmósfera de magia oscura y letras ornamentadas al estilo de los magos.
description.pt: Tipografia de grimório antigo com runas místicas, efeitos de brilho arcano, atmosfera de magia sombria e letras ornamentadas ao estilo dos magos.
description.de: Uralte Zauberbuch-Typografie mit mystischen Runen, arkanen Leuchteffekten, dunkler magischer Atmosphäre und vom Zauberer inspirierten, verzierten Buchstabenformen. Diese fantasy schrift bringt hohe Magie auf jedes Wort.

style_layer.core: rendered as ancient spellbook text with mystical arcane energy — glowing runes and magical symbols orbiting the letters. Ethereal purple and gold magical aura, floating sparkle particles and wisps of magical smoke. Ornate fantasy serif letterforms with subtle glow.
style_layer.scene: Dark enchanted atmosphere with old leather-bound book pages, wizard tower candlelight, ancient library setting.

description.en: Ancient manuscript-inspired typography with illuminated letterforms, parchment textures, ornate borders and medieval calligraphy.
description.ja: 古写本にインスパイアされたタイポグラフィ。装飾写本文字、羊皮紙のテクスチャ、華麗な縁飾り、中世カリグラフィが特徴です。
description.zh: 灵感源自古代手抄本的排版：装饰性字母、羊皮纸质感、华丽花边和中世纪书法。
description.es: Tipografía inspirada en los manuscritos antiguos, con letras iluminadas, texturas de pergamino, bordes ornamentados y caligrafía medieval.
description.pt: Tipografia inspirada nos manuscritos antigos, com letras iluminadas, texturas de pergaminho, bordas ornamentadas e caligrafia medieval.
description.de: Von alten Handschriften inspirierte Typografie mit illuminierten Buchstaben, Pergamenttexturen, verzierten Bordueren und mittelalterlicher Kalligrafie. Diese mittelalter Schrift versetzt deinen Text ins Skriptorium.

style_layer.core:
illuminated manuscript atmosphere — warm amber candlelight as primary light source from upper right, casting directional warmth across aged parchment surfaces and making gold leaf accents flare with brilliant hot highlights. Color signature: rich jewel-tone pigments — deep ruby red, cobalt blue, emerald green — the medieval manuscript palette applied as flat opaque hand-painted color zones glowing under candlelight. Burnished gold leaf accents contrast against aged ochre-cream vellum. Background: aged vellum parchment — warm cream-to-ochre with faint foxing marks and manuscript surface texture.
When no specific material is defined by the font: deep ruby red or cobalt blue flat pigment fill with burnished gold leaf outer edges, aged parchment background, warm candlelight illumination.
style_layer.scene: Text centered in frame, filling 75-85% of frame width. Background: warm aged vellum parchment with visible surface texture, subtle ink stain vignette at corners, the color of centuries-old manuscript page. Foreground: a richly decorated Celtic knotwork border of emerald green and antique gold frames the text composition — thin double-line border with small illuminated rosette ornaments at the four corners. Below the text: faint Latin marginalia in fine minuscule script ghosting in the background at reduced opacity. Lighting: warm amber candlelight from upper right at 45 degrees, the parchment glowing warmly at center, fading to deep ochre shadow at edges. A feathered quill rests at lower right corner of the composition, slightly out of focus. Monastic scriptorium atmosphere — reverent, ancient, hand-crafted.

description.en: Beveled 3D capitals mixing polished gold and brushed steel, with sharp highlight lines and a cool reflective floor under directional studio light.
description.ja: 磨いた金とヘアラインのスチールを組み合わせた面取りの3D大文字。鋭いハイライトの線、方向性のあるスタジオ光の下で冷たい反射床に映ります。
description.zh: 斜面 3D 大写字母混合抛光金与拉丝钢，高光线条锐利，在定向影棚光下倒映在冷色反光地面上。
description.es: Mayúsculas 3D biseladas que combinan oro pulido y acero cepillado, con líneas de brillo nítidas y un suelo reflectante frío bajo luz direccional de estudio.
description.pt: Maiúsculas 3D chanfradas combinando ouro polido e aço escovado, com linhas de brilho nítidas e um piso refletor frio sob luz direcional de estúdio.
description.de: Abgeschrägte 3D-Versalien aus poliertem Gold und gebürstetem Stahl, mit scharfen Glanzlinien auf einem kühlen, spiegelnden Boden im gerichteten Studiolicht.

style_layer.core: Rendered as bold 3D extruded letters with realistic metal surface physics — two signature material tracks: brushed steel with directional anisotropic highlight streaks across the surface, matte-satin finish, subtle horizontal grain texture, industrial grey with cool undertones; and gold/trophy with warm amber-yellow color temperature, wide smooth specular gradient from bright highlight to deep shadow, achievement trophy polish and weight. Supporting track: chrome/mirror for high-contrast metallic accent work. Core optical behavior rules across all tracks: wide specular highlight gradient (not a point highlight), ambient reflection in shadow zones capturing environmental color, material-specific color temperature held consistently, edge highlight compression where bevel planes meet. Never flat grey paint — always show the metal's interaction with light. Dark industrial background to maximize material contrast. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the metal-surface physics, the specular lighting and the finish. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as bold 3D-extruded metal — brushed steel or polished gold/trophy with a wide specular gradient and compressed edge highlights. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise hold the chosen metal's color temperature — cool steel grey or warm trophy gold.
style_layer.scene: Deep charcoal-to-steel-blue gradient background — industrial atmosphere with subtle environmental depth, not pure black. Studio key light from upper-left at 45 degrees, creating strong directional specular highlights and crisp cast shadows. Warm secondary fill light from lower-right adding separation. Letter surfaces show brushed grain texture or warm gold gradient depending on material. Dark reflective platform below with subtle material reflection. Ultra-clean precision manufacturing atmosphere.

description.en: Dark grey geometric sans with generous spacing and a single hairline rule beneath, flat and matte on an almost empty off-white ground.
description.ja: 字間をたっぷり取ったダークグレーの幾何学サンセリフに、下に一本の細い罫線。フラットでマット、ほぼ何もないオフホワイトの地に。
description.zh: 深灰色几何无衬线字，字距宽松，下方一道发丝细线，平涂哑光，置于几乎空白的米白底上。
description.es: Sans serif geométrica gris oscuro con espaciado generoso y una sola línea finísima debajo, plana y mate sobre un fondo blanco roto casi vacío.
description.pt: Sans serif geométrica cinza-escura com espaçamento generoso e uma única linha finíssima abaixo, chapada e fosca sobre um fundo off-white quase vazio.
description.de: Dunkelgraue geometrische Grotesk mit großzügiger Laufweite und einer einzigen Haarlinie darunter, flach und matt auf fast leerem gebrochenem Weiß.

style_layer.core: a clean, minimal, spacious piece — restrained and modern, defined by what is left out. SURFACE / STYLE: refined typography with generous letterspacing and abundant negative space, a flat matte finish and at most a single fine accent rule or hairline detail — no texture, no gloss, no ornament. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a calm, bright, uncluttered setting — clean white or soft neutral ground, even diffuse light, architectural emptiness, the luxury of breathing room. PALETTE: a sophisticated monochrome — soft white, light warm grey, charcoal and black, with at most a single muted accent — quiet and tonal, never loud. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (clean geometric sans, neutral grotesque, condensed sans, zen minimal, fine monoline), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the generous spacing, the negative space, the matte monochrome finish and the calm bright scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in a clean thin modern sans in soft charcoal on a bright white ground with wide letterspacing, abundant negative space and a single fine accent rule, so the minimal elegance always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits calm and perfectly centered with generous letterspacing in soft charcoal on a clean white or neutral ground, abundant negative space around it, even diffuse light and a single fine accent rule. Restrained, elegant, breathing-room minimalism.

description.en: Cream-gold brush script woven with pink peonies, roses and lavender sprigs, petals resting on the strokes, over warm burgundy bokeh.
description.ja: ピンクの牡丹、バラ、ラベンダーの小枝を編み込んだクリームゴールドのブラシ筆記体。花びらが線の上に落ち、背景は温かなワインレッドのボケ。
description.zh: 奶油金色毛笔手写体，粉色牡丹、玫瑰与薰衣草穿插在笔画间，花瓣落在字上，背景是温暖的酒红光斑。
description.es: Script de pincel crema dorado entretejido con peonías rosas, rosas y ramitas de lavanda, con pétalos sobre los trazos, sobre un cálido bokeh burdeos.
description.pt: Script de pincel creme-dourado entrelaçado com peônias rosa, rosas e raminhos de lavanda, pétalas pousadas nos traços, sobre um bokeh bordô quente.
description.de: Cremegoldene Pinselschrift, verwoben mit rosa Pfingstrosen, Rosen und Lavendelzweigen, Blütenblätter auf den Strichen, vor warmem bordeauxrotem Bokeh.

style_layer.core: Elegant hand-lettered calligraphy with soft flowing script and graceful swashes. Rich 3D floral integration: realistic soft pink peonies, blush roses, and lavender sprigs physically woven through the letterforms — petals resting on strokes, flowers blooming from between letters, stems curling around the baseline. Warm golden bokeh light filtering through the floral arrangement. Color palette: letters in warm cream-white with gold ink shimmer, flowers in soft blush pink and dusty rose, sage green foliage, gentle gold accents. Background: deep rich dark — burgundy rose to wine-mauve gradient — creating strong contrast that makes letters and flowers glow. Mood: tender, celebratory, luxurious — evoking deep love and heartfelt gratitude.
style_layer.scene: Softly lit studio with a warm blush-toned background, gentle golden light spilling from upper left, scattered loose rose petals resting on the surface below the text.

description.en: Slanted chrome capitals reflecting a pink-to-purple sunset and a cyan grid, with neon edge glow, over a perspective grid floor lined with palm silhouettes.
description.ja: ピンクから紫の夕焼けとシアンのグリッドを映す斜体のクロームの大文字。縁にネオンの光、足元にはヤシのシルエットが並ぶ遠近グリッドの床。
description.zh: 倾斜的铬金属大写字母映出粉紫日落与青色网格，边缘带霓虹辉光，下方是延伸的透视网格地面和棕榈剪影。
description.es: Mayúsculas cromadas inclinadas que reflejan un atardecer de rosa a morado y una cuadrícula cian, con brillo neón en los bordes, sobre un suelo de cuadrícula en perspectiva con siluetas de palmeras.
description.pt: Maiúsculas cromadas inclinadas refletindo um pôr do sol do rosa ao roxo e uma grade ciano, com brilho neon nas bordas, sobre um piso de grade em perspectiva com silhuetas de palmeiras.
description.de: Schräge Chromversalien, die einen Sonnenuntergang von Pink bis Lila und ein cyanfarbenes Raster spiegeln, mit Neon-Kantenglühen, über einem perspektivischen Rasterboden mit Palmensilhouetten.

style_layer.core:
Chrome metallic letter surfaces with mirror-finish reflectivity — the letters are environmental mirrors.
Upper half of each letter reflects the synthwave sunset gradient: hot pink fading into electric purple into deep navy.
Lower half reflects the perspective grid floor below: electric cyan and purple grid lines warped across the chrome surface.
Letter edges: dual neon halo — tight inner ring of electric purple, wider outer bloom of hot pink, faint cyan rim at the very edge of each stroke.
Surface texture: high-gloss automotive chrome with zero visible grain — reflections are sharp and clean, not brushed.
Shadows cast by letters onto the grid floor are deep and crisp, with purple-tinted ambient fill.
VHS analog quality: subtle horizontal scan line texture across the full composition, barely perceptible but present.
Forbidden: matte or brushed metal finish, white or grey letter color, soft ambient lighting without directional neon source, cyberpunk rain-wet scenes, any warm white or yellow tones. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the chrome reflections, the dual neon halo and the synthwave palette. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as mirror-finish chrome reflecting the synthwave sunset above and the perspective grid below, edged with a dual pink-and-purple neon halo. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise hold the hot-pink / electric-purple / cyan synthwave palette.
style_layer.scene:
Outrun synthwave landscape — geometric perspective wireframe grid floor in electric cyan and purple lines receding to a single vanishing point at the center-horizon. Letters centered in frame, filling 78% of frame width, floating 20% above the grid surface — chrome letter bases casting sharp purple shadows on the grid below.
Horizon: vivid layered sunset gradient — hot pink band at the horizon line, electric purple mid-sky, deep navy-black at top. Palm tree silhouettes in black against the pink horizon band, symmetrical on both sides.
Stars: sharp white pinpoints in the dark upper sky zone, arranged in loose clusters.
No atmospheric haze, no rain, no wet surfaces — hard-edged, geometric, clean.
The mood is speed and distance: a road that goes forever, a night that never ends.

description.en: Rounded neon-tube capitals alternating cyan and magenta, with bright tube cores, soft bloom and colored reflections on wet ground in the dark.
description.ja: シアンとマゼンタを交互にした丸いネオン管の大文字。明るい管の芯と柔らかなにじみ、暗がりの濡れた地面に色の映り込み。
description.zh: 青色与品红交替的圆润霓虹灯管大写字母，灯管芯明亮、光晕柔和，在黑暗中把彩色倒影投在湿地面上。
description.es: Mayúsculas redondeadas de tubo de neón alternando cian y magenta, con núcleos brillantes, halo suave y reflejos de color en el suelo mojado en la oscuridad.
description.pt: Maiúsculas arredondadas de tubo de neon alternando ciano e magenta, com núcleos brilhantes, halo suave e reflexos coloridos no chão molhado no escuro.
description.de: Runde Neonröhren-Versalien abwechselnd in Cyan und Magenta, mit hellen Röhrenkernen, weichem Schein und farbigen Spiegelungen auf nassem Boden im Dunkeln.

style_layer.core: rendered as real bent glass neon tubes with visible tube brackets and mounting hardware. Bright cyan and magenta neon light, sharp glowing edges with soft light bloom, visible glass tube refraction. Slightly uneven brightness between letters for realism. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the glass-tube neon material, the glow bloom and the color. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as real bent glass neon tubes with visible brackets, glowing with sharp edges and soft bloom. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise bright cyan and magenta neon.
style_layer.scene: Mounted on a dark concrete wall, each letter's colored light pooling softly on the floor beneath it, tiny dust particles caught in the glow, faint reflections on the slightly damp ground, deep shadow gathering around the edges of the frame.

description.en: Hollow outline capitals traced by a single glowing blue-violet neon line, dark inside, with a soft halo and a glossy floor reflection.
description.ja: 一本の青紫に光るネオン線だけで描いた中空のアウトライン大文字。内側は暗く、柔らかな光の輪と艶のある床への映り込み。
description.zh: 空心描边大写字母，只由一条发光的蓝紫霓虹线勾出，内部漆黑，外有柔和光晕和亮面地面倒影。
description.es: Mayúsculas huecas trazadas por una sola línea de neón azul violeta luminosa, oscuras por dentro, con un halo suave y reflejo en un suelo brillante.
description.pt: Maiúsculas vazadas traçadas por uma única linha de neon azul-violeta luminosa, escuras por dentro, com halo suave e reflexo num piso brilhante.
description.de: Hohle Konturversalien aus einer einzigen leuchtenden blauvioletten Neonlinie, innen dunkel, mit weichem Halo und Spiegelung auf glänzendem Boden.

style_layer.core: Pure neon outline letterforms — each letter defined only by its glowing stroke border, interior completely hollow and dark. The outline stroke glows with a continuous tube-light energy: bright white-hot center line along the stroke path, vivid neon glow zone expanding outward, soft wide halo bleeding into surrounding darkness. Glow is wider on the outside edge of the stroke than the inside, following real gas-tube light physics. Interior of each letter reads as deep void — no fill, no ambient light bleed inward. Stroke width is crisp and consistent, geometric precision. Slightly uneven brightness variation along the stroke path for organic gas-tube character. Choose neon color based on text meaning and mood: electric blue + deep violet for tech/cyber/cold words, neon pink + magenta for vibrant/pop/fun words, lime green + cyan for acid/gaming/hacker words, warm amber + orange for retro/diner/warm words, or multi-color with each letter a different hue for festive/creative content. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters, rendered as their glowing hollow outline; this style governs the gas-tube glow physics and the color. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render each letter as a pure hollow glowing neon outline with a white-hot center line, outward glow and a dark void interior. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise choose the neon hue by the word's mood (electric blue/violet for tech, pink/magenta for fun, lime/cyan for gaming, amber for retro).
style_layer.scene: Wide 16:9. APEX as neon outline letters, centered at 72% of frame width. Each letter is pure hollow, only the glowing stroke outline exists, interior is deep dark void. The outline strokes emit electric blue and deep violet neon light: bright white-hot center line, vivid colored glow zone expanding outward asymmetrically, wider halo on the outside edge of each stroke than the inside, exactly as real gas-tube physics dictates. Background: deep midnight blue-black — NOT pure black. A rich, dark atmospheric gradient: upper zone is deep indigo-black, lower zone shifts to dark navy with the faintest electric blue ambient scatter from the letters illuminating the space around them. Subtle depth and air. Very fine atmospheric haze in the glow field — barely visible floating micro-particles catching the neon light, adding spatial depth. Lower third: perfectly smooth dark floor — obsidian-toned but with a faint wet sheen. The neon outline letters reflect downward as elongated color columns, precise mirror image softening and fading toward the viewer. No warm tones anywhere. The atmosphere is cold, electric, deep. High-end minimal cyberpunk — the darkness has depth, not flatness.

description.en: Classic roadside neon sign: glass tubes glowing warm pink and amber on a dark brick wall, with brackets and wet pavement reflections.
description.ja: クラシックなロードサイドのネオンサイン。暗いレンガの壁で温かなピンクと琥珀色に光るガラス管に取り付け金具、濡れた路面への映り込み。
description.zh: 经典路边霓虹招牌：玻璃灯管在深色砖墙上发出暖粉与琥珀色光，带安装支架，湿地面上有倒影。
description.es: Clásico letrero de neón de carretera: tubos de vidrio que brillan en rosa cálido y ámbar sobre un muro de ladrillo oscuro, con soportes y reflejos en el pavimento mojado.
description.pt: Clássico letreiro de neon de beira de estrada: tubos de vidro brilhando em rosa quente e âmbar numa parede de tijolos escura, com suportes e reflexos no asfalto molhado.
description.de: Klassische Neonreklame am Straßenrand: Glasröhren leuchten warm in Rosa und Bernstein an einer dunklen Backsteinwand, mit Halterungen und Spiegelungen auf nassem Pflaster.

style_layer.core: rendered as a classic roadside neon sign with warm glowing tube light in soft pink and amber. Visible glass tube bends and mounting brackets on a dark painted metal backing plate. Warm light halo and bloom around each letter, slight buzzing energy feel. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the glass-tube sign material, the warm halo and the color. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as a classic roadside neon sign — warm glowing tubes on a dark painted metal backing plate with visible bends and mounting brackets. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise soft pink and amber.
style_layer.scene: Nighttime exterior wall with visible brick texture, the sign's warm light glowing against the dark, a faint rain shimmer on the bricks and a soft halo bloom in the night air. Nostalgic Americana roadside aesthetic.

description.en: Theatrical storybook scenes with nutcracker soldiers, gilded stage arches and velvet curtains in crimson, emerald and antique gold under warm golden stage light.
description.ja: くるみ割り人形の兵隊、金の舞台アーチ、ベルベットの幕が並ぶ劇場の絵本の世界。クリムゾン、エメラルド、アンティークゴールドを温かな金色の舞台照明で包みます。
description.zh: 胡桃夹子士兵、镀金舞台拱门和丝绒帷幕组成的剧场童话画面，深红、祖母绿配古金色，笼在温暖的金色舞台光里。
description.es: Escenas teatrales de cuento con soldados cascanueces, arcos de escenario dorados y telones de terciopelo en carmesí, esmeralda y oro antiguo, bajo una cálida luz dorada de escenario.
description.pt: Cenas teatrais de livro de histórias com soldadinhos quebra-nozes, arcos de palco dourados e cortinas de veludo em carmim, esmeralda e ouro antigo, sob uma luz de palco dourada e quente.
description.de: Theatralische Märchenszenen mit Nussknacker-Soldaten, vergoldeten Bühnenbögen und Samtvorhängen in Karmesinrot, Smaragdgrün und Altgold, in warmem goldenem Bühnenlicht.

style_layer.core: a Nutcracker-themed Christmas illustration, poster, party invitation, wallpaper or card that a family, dance school or holiday shop would actually use. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: a theatrical storybook world - nutcracker soldier figures in red tunics, tall black hats and gold buttons standing guard at the sides or as the hero of an illustration, a ballet stage arch or ornate gilded frame with velvet curtains, garlands, ribbons, candy, drums, rocking horses and toy castles - framing a central panel or open area for the words; clipart and illustrations can show a single nutcracker figure on a plain ground. LIGHT: warm stage light with a soft golden glow from the centre and a gentle vignette at the edges. COLOUR: rich crimson red and deep emerald green with antique gold trim and a cream panel for the words. TEXTURE: velvet curtains, gilded filigree, painted wooden toy surfaces with a slight gloss, a hint of glitter. TIERS: the classic ballet tier is crimson, emerald and gold, ornate and theatrical; the sugar plum tier is pastel pink, mint and gold, with pink nutcracker soldiers, ballet slippers and sweets, whimsical. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; crimson or antique gold colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the nutcracker figures, the stage frame and the warm golden light always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a cream panel inside a gilded stage arch under warm golden light.

description.en: Capitals folded from colored paper in coral, teal, mustard and sky blue, with sharp creases and angular facets catching light, on clean white.
description.ja: コーラル、ティール、マスタード、スカイブルーの色紙で折った大文字。鋭い折り目と角ばった面が光をとらえ、清潔な白地に。
description.zh: 由珊瑚红、青绿、芥末黄和天蓝色纸折成的大写字母，折痕锐利、棱面分明地接住光线，置于干净白底上。
description.es: Mayúsculas plegadas en papel coral, verde azulado, mostaza y azul cielo, con pliegues nítidos y facetas angulares que captan la luz, sobre blanco limpio.
description.pt: Maiúsculas dobradas em papel coral, verde-azulado, mostarda e azul-céu, com vincos nítidos e facetas angulares que captam a luz, sobre branco limpo.
description.de: Versalien aus gefaltetem Papier in Koralle, Petrol, Senfgelb und Himmelblau, mit scharfen Falzen und kantigen Facetten, die das Licht fangen, auf sauberem Weiß.

style_layer.core: a clean origami paper-craft piece — crisp, geometric and cheerful. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering looks folded from clean colored paper — sharp crease lines, angular geometric facets catching light at different angles, subtle shadow between the paper layers, a tidy hand-folded precision. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a bright, clean paper-craft setting — soft even studio light, a few small folded paper shapes, calm uncluttered space. PALETTE: bright cheerful paper colors — coral, teal, mustard, sky blue and soft white — clean and crafty, with crisp facet highlights, never grungy or dark. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (origami fold, angular facet, geometric sans, isometric block, bold geo sans), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the folded-paper facets, the crease shadows, the clean studio light and the cheerful paper palette. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as crisp folded colored paper with sharp creases, angular facets and soft fold shadows, so the origami paper-craft feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits crisp and geometric, folded from clean colored paper with sharp crease lines and angular facets catching light, soft shadows between the layers, against a bright clean studio backdrop with a few small folded paper shapes. Tidy, cheerful origami paper-craft mood.

names.ja: ピンク クリスマス

description.en: Blush and bubblegum pink fields with glossy pink baubles, a frosted pink tree, satin bows and rose gold accents under warm fairy-light glow and soft bokeh.
description.ja: ベビーピンクとバブルガムピンクの地に、つやのあるピンクのオーナメント、霜をまとったピンクのツリー、サテンのリボン、ローズゴールドのアクセント。イルミネーションのあたたかな光とやわらかなボケ。
description.zh: 宝宝粉和泡泡糖粉的底色，亮面粉色彩球、覆霜的粉色圣诞树、缎带蝴蝶结和玫瑰金点缀，笼着暖暖的串灯光晕和柔和光斑。
description.es: Fondos en rosa pastel y rosa chicle con esferas rosas brillantes, un árbol rosa nevado, moños de satín y detalles en oro rosa, bajo la luz cálida de las series navideñas y un bokeh suave.
description.pt: Fundos em rosa-claro e rosa-chiclete com bolas rosa brilhantes, uma árvore rosa nevada, laços de cetim e detalhes em ouro rosé, sob a luz quente de pisca-pisca e um bokeh suave.
description.de: Flächen in Zartrosa und Kaugummi-Pink mit glänzenden rosa Christbaumkugeln, einem verschneiten rosa Baum, Satinschleifen und Roségold-Akzenten im warmen Schein von Lichterketten und weichem Bokeh.

style_layer.core: a pink Christmas phone wallpaper, video call background, card or party invite that a trend-loving friend would actually set or send. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: pink Christmas motifs gathered at the edges or in one corner - glossy baubles, a frosted pink tree, satin ribbon bows, snowflakes, little wrapped gifts and candles - leaving a calm open area for the words; wallpapers keep the top third quiet for the clock. LIGHT: warm soft glow like fairy lights and candlelight, gentle bokeh sparkles in the background, soft shadows only. COLOUR: blush and bubblegum pink as the main field with rose gold and pearly white accents; a deep raspberry used in one or two small places; never the traditional red-and-green scheme. TEXTURE: smooth satin and glossy ornament surfaces, a light dusting of glitter or soft snow. TIERS: the dreamy blush tier is pale pink, rose gold and cream, soft and cosy; the bold Pinkmas tier is hot bubblegum pink, playful and graphic, with more sparkle. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the pink palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the pink field, the baubles, bows and the warm glow always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a soft blush background under warm fairy-light glow with gentle bokeh.

names.ja: ピンク ハロウィン

description.en: Blush and bubblegum pink scenes of glittery pink pumpkins, little ghosts in satin bows, cobwebs, bats and candies, with black accents under soft even light.
description.ja: ベビーピンクとバブルガムピンクの画面に、ラメ入りのピンクのかぼちゃ、サテンのリボンをつけた小さなおばけ、クモの巣、コウモリ、キャンディを描き、黒をアクセントにやわらかく均一な光で仕上げたスタイル。
description.zh: 宝宝粉和泡泡糖粉的画面：带闪粉的粉色南瓜、系缎带蝴蝶结的小幽灵、蛛网、蝙蝠和糖果，黑色点缀，柔和均匀的光。
description.es: Escenas en rosa pastel y rosa chicle con calabazas rosas con brillantina, fantasmitas con moños de satén, telarañas, murciélagos y dulces, con toques negros y luz suave y pareja.
description.pt: Cenas em rosa-bebê e rosa-chiclete com abóboras rosa com glitter, fantasminhas de laço de cetim, teias, morcegos e balas, com detalhes em preto e luz suave e uniforme.
description.de: Szenen in Zartrosa und Bubblegum-Pink mit glitzernden rosa Kürbissen, kleinen Geistern mit Satinschleifen, Spinnweben, Fledermäusen und Bonbons, schwarzen Akzenten und weichem, gleichmäßigem Licht.

style_layer.core: the kind of pink Halloween image a girl hangs in her bedroom, sets as her phone wallpaper or sends as a party invite - sweet, not scary. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: pink pumpkins, little ghosts wearing satin bows, delicate cobwebs, tiny bats, wrapped candies and small hearts, either gathered at the bottom and corners around a calm open area for the words or repeated as an all-over pattern of small motifs; phone wallpapers keep the top third quiet for the clock. LIGHT: soft even light, at most a gentle sweet pink glow, soft shadows only. COLOUR: soft blush and bubblegum pink as the base, black as the contrast in small shapes such as bats and lettering accents, small touches of lilac and white; never the orange-and-black Halloween scheme. TEXTURE: soft matte flat illustration, a little glitter on the pumpkins and a satin sheen on the bows. TIERS: the girl's-room wall art tier is a framed-print composition with clean margins and the words centred; the coquette pattern tier is an all-over repeating pattern of small pink motifs for phone wallpapers and posts. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the black-and-pink palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the pink field, the pink pumpkins, bow ghosts, cobwebs and bats always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a soft blush background under even light with a faint pink glow.

description.en: Blocky 8-bit pixel capitals glowing amber-orange on a curved CRT arcade screen, with scanlines, phosphor bloom and a small INSERT COIN line.
description.ja: 湾曲したCRTのアーケード画面で琥珀オレンジに光るブロック状の8ビットピクセル大文字。走査線、蛍光体のにじみ、小さな INSERT COIN の一行。
description.zh: 方块状 8 位像素大写字母在弧面 CRT 街机屏上发出琥珀橙光，带扫描线、荧光晕和一行小字 INSERT COIN。
description.es: Mayúsculas de píxel de 8 bits en bloque que brillan en ámbar anaranjado en una pantalla CRT curva de arcade, con líneas de escaneo, resplandor de fósforo y una pequeña línea INSERT COIN.
description.pt: Maiúsculas de pixel 8 bits em bloco brilhando em âmbar-alaranjado numa tela CRT curva de fliperama, com linhas de varredura, brilho de fósforo e uma pequena linha INSERT COIN.
description.de: Blockige 8-Bit-Pixelversalien, die bernsteinorange auf einem gewölbten CRT-Arcade-Bildschirm leuchten, mit Scanlines, Phosphorschein und einer kleinen INSERT-COIN-Zeile.

style_layer.core:
Pixel art display world — all typography lives as colored square cells within screen glass, in environments defined by hardware era, color depth, and light physics.

SCREEN TRACK A: CRT ARCADE MONITOR
Jet black curved CRT glass face. Horizontal scan-line grid at correct 240p arcade frequency overlays the full frame. Phosphor bloom halos each letter cluster. Barrel-distortion vignette darkens screen edge corners to near-black. INSERT COIN pixel text at frame bottom. Screen is the sole light source; surrounding scene falls to darkness.

SCREEN TRACK B: NEON SYNTHWAVE ENVIRONMENT
Midnight black space. Synthwave outrun perspective grid on the floor plane — hot magenta-pink grid lines receding to the horizon. Deep violet-to-black gradient sky. Letters are the only illumination source in the frame. Retrowave night atmosphere.

SCREEN TRACK C: 16-BIT CONSOLE SCREEN
Deep cobalt-blue to midnight gradient backdrop. Rich 16-color game-screen saturation. Faint horizontal scanlines. Score counter and lives UI in bright yellow pixels at top frame corners. Saturated primary palette — no pastel, no desaturation.

SCREEN TRACK D: VOXEL BUILDER SPACE
Dark charcoal open stage. Subtle isometric grid on the ground plane. Consistent directional key light from upper-left. Pixel-art block stacks at far background edges. Clean builder sandbox atmosphere.

PIXEL WORLD LAWS
All in-frame elements follow the same pixel grid. No anti-aliasing anywhere in frame. Pixel-art UI elements built at the same grid resolution as the typography.

When no specific screen environment is defined by the font:
Deep black or dark charcoal background, minimal atmospheric glow only. No specific screen type, no material description.
style_layer.scene: Game-screen title composition: typography centered, filling 78–85% of frame width, anchored at vertical center. Screen environment fills the remaining frame. No foreground elements interrupt the text. One word, one screen, full impact — every character reads at pixel-perfect clarity from edge to edge.

description.en: Pop-art comic capitals filled with Ben-Day dots in flat red and yellow, thick black outlines and a hard drop shadow, bursting from a starburst on a dotted blue ground.
description.ja: 太い黒フチと硬いドロップシャドウ、青い水玉地の爆発形から飛び出します。

style_layer.core: rendered in classic 1960s comic-panel pop art style. Thick uniform black outline traces every letter contour and inner stroke — consistent weight, hard edge, zero softness. Letter fills use large Ben-Day halftone dots: dots individually visible, primary colors only (flat red, flat yellow, flat blue, flat white — no gradients, no metallics, no pastels). Graphic drop shadow offset 45° lower-right, solid black, hard edge. Entire image: zero blending, zero photographic realism, flat silk-screen aesthetic. High contrast, comic book energy. Ben-Day dots never touch the outline — always a bare white gap between dot fill and outline inner edge. No CMYK color mixing. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the thick black outline, the Ben-Day halftone fill and the graphic drop shadow. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters with a thick uniform black outline, flat Ben-Day dot fills in primary colors and a hard 45-degree black drop shadow. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise flat primary red, yellow, blue and white only.
style_layer.scene: Comic book panel: bold black panel border, bright flat primary-color background. Oversized action burst or starburst shape behind the text — flat red or yellow with hard black outline. Ben-Day dot pattern fills background zones in flat blue or yellow. Hard 45° drop shadow of text. The composition reads like a vintage American comic page panel — 100% flat graphic, bold, maximum pop art energy.

description.en: Tall condensed capitals of battle-worn dark metal, split by cracks glowing with molten orange lava, with embers and ash over scorched ground.
description.ja: 戦いで傷んだ暗い金属の縦長大文字。ひび割れから溶岩のようなオレンジの光が漏れ、焦土の上に火の粉と灰が舞います。
description.zh: 高窄的战损暗色金属大写字母，裂缝中透出熔岩般的橙色光，余烬与灰烬飘落在焦土之上。
description.es: Mayúsculas altas y condensadas de metal oscuro castigado por la batalla, partidas por grietas que brillan con lava naranja fundida, con brasas y ceniza sobre tierra calcinada.
description.pt: Maiúsculas altas e condensadas de metal escuro castigado pela batalha, partidas por rachaduras que brilham com lava laranja derretida, com brasas e cinzas sobre terra queimada.
description.de: Hohe, schmale Versalien aus kampfgezeichnetem dunklem Metall, zerteilt von Rissen, in denen geschmolzene orange Lava glüht, mit Glut und Asche über verbrannter Erde.

style_layer.core: Action movie title typography. Ultra-bold letterforms with battle-worn matte metal surface, deep surface cracks glowing with molten orange-red lava light from within. Fiery ember particles and ash debris scatter from letter edges. Top edges catch cool rim light for separation. Avoid chrome mirror finish; prefer oxidized, battle-scarred metal. High contrast dark composition. Photorealistic rendering.
style_layer.scene: Single bold title word centered on frame. Scorched earth ground beneath, rising dust and smoke haze filling the background. Ember particles drifting from letter edges. Dramatic low-angle perspective with orange-red atmospheric backlight. Dark composition with high contrast.

names.ja: チェック柄のクリスマス

description.en: Tartan, gingham and candy-stripe borders and panels with neat bows, a wreath crest and a cream text panel in red, green and navy with a touch of gold foil.
description.ja: タータン、ギンガム、キャンディストライプの縁取りやパネルに、きちんと結んだリボン、リースの紋章、クリーム色の文字パネル。赤、緑、ネイビーに金箔を少し。
description.zh: 格子呢、小方格和糖果条纹的边框与色块，配整齐的蝴蝶结、花环徽章和奶油色文字面板，红、绿、藏青三色，点一点金箔。
description.es: Bordes y paneles de tartán, vichy y rayas de caramelo con lazos impecables, un escudo de corona navideña y un panel crema para el texto, en rojo, verde y azul marino con un toque de foil dorado.
description.pt: Bordas e painéis de tartã, vichy e listras de bengala doce com laços impecáveis, um brasão de guirlanda e um painel creme para o texto, em vermelho, verde e azul-marinho com um toque de foil dourado.
description.de: Ränder und Felder aus Tartan, Vichykaro und Zuckerstangenstreifen mit akkuraten Schleifen, einem Kranzwappen und einem cremefarbenen Textfeld in Rot, Grün und Marineblau, dazu ein Hauch Goldfolie.

style_layer.core: a preppy Christmas phone wallpaper, background, card, gift tag or invitation that a classic, put-together family or a preppy girl would actually set or send. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: crisp graphic patterns - tartan plaid, gingham, candy and ticking stripes, argyle - used as borders, background bands, panels or a patchwork of squares, with neat velvet or grosgrain bows, a small wreath or monogram crest, and the words on a clean cream or white panel; wallpapers keep the top third calm for the clock. LIGHT: clean, bright, even light, like a well-lit stationery flat lay, crisp soft shadows under bows and tags. COLOUR: classic red, kelly or hunter green and navy with cream, and touches of pink; one metallic gold-foil accent used in one or two places. TEXTURE: smooth card stock, the woven look of plaid and gingham, velvet and grosgrain ribbon, crisp gold foil. TIERS: the classic plaid tier is red and green tartan, navy bows and gold; the pink preppy tier is pink, red and green stripes and gingham with playful bows, bright and young. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; red, green or navy colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the plaid and stripe patterns, the bows and the cream panel always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on a cream panel framed by tartan under clean, bright, even light.

description.en: Melting glossy bubble letters in hot pink, orange and yellow, set against vibrating concentric rainbow waves with daisies and swirls.
description.ja: ホットピンク、オレンジ、黄色の溶けかけた艶のあるバブル文字。震えるような同心円の虹の波にデイジーと渦巻き。
description.zh: 融化中的亮面泡泡字，热粉、橙、黄三色，衬在振动的同心彩虹波纹上，点缀雏菊与漩涡。
description.es: Letras burbuja brillantes que se derriten en rosa intenso, naranja y amarillo, frente a ondas de arcoíris concéntricas que vibran, con margaritas y remolinos.
description.pt: Letras bolha brilhantes derretendo em rosa-choque, laranja e amarelo, contra ondas de arco-íris concêntricas e vibrantes, com margaridas e espirais.
description.de: Schmelzende, glänzende Bubble-Buchstaben in Pink, Orange und Gelb vor vibrierenden konzentrischen Regenbogenwellen mit Gänseblümchen und Spiralen.

style_layer.core: a 1960s psychedelic poster world where saturated color is set vibrating. OPTICS / COLOR: maximum-saturation complementary pairs are placed edge to edge — hot magenta against acid green, electric orange against cobalt blue, cadmium yellow against violet — every boundary buzzing with simultaneous-contrast vibration, the defining 1960s concert-poster optical effect; color stays flat, hard-edged and screenprint-clean, never muddy or desaturated. LIGHT: flat, even, high-key illumination with no single hard source, so the whole frame hums at once like a backlit poster. FIELD: a kaleidoscopic field of concentric radiating rainbow waves, spirals and op-art ripples expands outward to every edge, framing the text. PALETTE: hot magenta, acid green, electric orange, cobalt blue, cadmium yellow, violet — full spectrum at peak saturation. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font defines its own surface (op-art contour bands, fluorescent blacklight glow, tie-dye fabric dye, melting drips, etc.), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the glyph surface — this style then governs only the surrounding color atmosphere and the vibrating field. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the chosen font carries no material of its own, render the letters in glossy candy-gloss with a soft wet melting quality, drips sliding from their lower edges and the surfaces filled with vibrating rainbow color, so the psychedelic identity always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits large and dominant in the center, owning the frame, wrapped in a kaleidoscopic burst of concentric rainbow waves and spirals that radiate outward from behind the letters to every edge. A few groovy flower-power daisies and paisley accents drift at the corners. Symmetrical, hypnotic, immersive — a full 1960s psychedelic concert-poster composition, the kind pasted on a ballroom wall during the Summer of Love.

description.en: High-speed racing typography with dynamic italic angles, checkered flag patterns, metallic chrome finish and motorsport energy.
description.ja: ダイナミックなイタリック傾斜、チェッカーフラッグ柄、メタリックなクロム仕上げ、そしてモータースポーツのエネルギーを備えた高速レーシングタイポグラフィです。
description.zh: 高速赛车风格字体，动感斜体角度、方格旗纹样、金属铬质光泽，满载赛车运动的能量。
description.es: Tipografía de carreras de alta velocidad con ángulos itálicos dinámicos, patrones de bandera a cuadros, acabado cromado metálico y toda la energía del automovilismo.
description.pt: Tipografia de corrida em alta velocidade com ângulos itálicos dinâmicos, padrões de bandeira quadriculada, acabamento cromado metálico e toda a energia do automobilismo.
description.de: Rasante Racing Schrift mit dynamischen Kursivwinkeln, Zielflaggenmustern, metallischem Chromfinish und Motorsport-Energie.

style_layer.core: Aggressive forward-lean italic attitude: every letterform tilts at an exaggerated angle, implying high-velocity motion even in stillness. Speed lines — fine horizontal streaks — trail behind strokes, fading from sharp near the letterform edge to dissolving into the background, mimicking the visual physics of a body moving faster than the eye can track. High-energy visual weight: thick strokes command visual gravity, negative space is tight and compressed, every letterform reads like it is under aerodynamic load. Racing livery surface environment: hard studio light source directly overhead or slightly to the front, casting a sharp specular axis along the top plane of each stroke. Racing color palette activated: fierce reds, championship gold, carbon-black shadows, pure white speed streaks. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting environment — single hard overhead beam, deep shadow falling behind each letterform in the direction of motion, pure black track-surface background, faint motion-haze atmospheric scatter in the air around the letters.
style_layer.scene: Race track asphalt fills the lower quarter of the frame — dark grey tarmac with faint painted white line. Letters rendered in extreme condensed italic, filling 75% of frame width at center-left, tilted forward at maximum racing lean. Hard overhead spotlight beam, cold white. Crisp specular axis along each stroke top, deep carbon shadow beneath. Background: full darkness of night circuit, faint lens flare from a distant track light at upper right. Fine horizontal speed lines trail behind each letterform, dissolving rightward. Cinematic pit lane atmosphere. Wide 16:9.

description.en: Vibrant multi-color rainbow gradient text effects with smooth color transitions, prismatic light and joyful chromatic typography.
description.ja: 鮮やかな多色レインボーグラデーションの文字エフェクトです。滑らかな色の移り変わり、プリズムのような光、そして陽気で色彩豊かなタイポグラフィが特徴です。
description.zh: 绚丽的多彩虹色渐变文字特效，色彩过渡顺滑，棱镜般的光泽与欢快的多彩排版。
description.es: Efectos de texto con degradado arcoíris multicolor y vibrante, con transiciones de color suaves, luz prismática y tipografía cromática llena de alegría.
description.pt: Efeitos de texto com degradê arco-íris multicolorido e vibrante, transições de cor suaves, luz prismática e tipografia cromática cheia de alegria.
description.de: Lebhafte, mehrfarbige Regenbogen-Farbverlaufs-Texteffekte mit sanften Farbübergängen und prismatischem Licht – eine bunte Schrift voller Freude und chromatischer Tiefe.

style_layer.core: rendered as rainbow text effect — COLOR (mandatory): each individual letter must contain a complete ROYGBIV rainbow gradient top-to-bottom within itself — top=red, upper=orange, mid=yellow-green, lower=blue-indigo, bottom=violet. NOT one color per letter. NOT a gradient across the whole word. Every letter is its own complete rainbow. Full chroma Pride flag saturation — not pastel, not muted, not shifted to any single hue. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style always governs the color — every letter still carries its own complete top-to-bottom ROYGBIV rainbow gradient. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render clean bold letters each filled with a full vertical ROYGBIV rainbow. COLOR PRIORITY: the rainbow gradient is mandatory and overrides any single font color — each individual letter is its own complete rainbow at full Pride-flag saturation.
style_layer.scene: Background: vibrant outdoor festival scene — deep gradient sky from warm amber-orange at horizon to rich cobalt blue at top, soft bokeh of colorful light orbs (pink, yellow, cyan, violet) floating in mid-air suggesting festival lights or confetti. Strong directional sunlight from upper-right creating sharp specular highlights on letter surfaces. Faint colorful confetti scatter below the letters. The overall scene feels like a summer Pride festival or birthday celebration — never a plain white or studio background.

description.en: Bold mid-century pop art (1950s–70s) — thick black outlines, flat candy colors, Ben-Day halftone dots and starbursts.
description.ja: 大胆なミッドセンチュリー・ポップアート(1950〜70年代)。太い黒の輪郭線、フラットなキャンディカラー、Ben-Dayのハーフトーンドット、そしてスターバースト模様が特徴です。
description.zh: 浓烈的中世纪波普艺术风（1950s–70s）——粗黑描边、扁平糖果色、Ben-Day 半调网点和星芒爆炸。
description.es: Arte pop bien marcado de mediados de siglo (años 50 a 70): contornos negros gruesos, colores caramelo planos, puntos de trama Ben-Day y estallidos de estrellas.
description.pt: Arte pop marcante de meados do século (anos 1950 a 70): contornos pretos grossos, cores caramelo chapadas, pontos de meio-tom Ben-Day e explosões de estrelas.
description.de: Kräftige Pop-Art der Jahrhundertmitte (1950er–70er) — dicke schwarze Umrisse, flache Bonbonfarben, Ben-Day-Rasterpunkte und Sternenexplosionen.

style_layer.core: a mid-century retro pop poster (1950s-70s). SURFACE / STYLE: bold letters with thick black keyline outlines around flat, vibrant candy-color fills, a Ben-Day halftone dot texture across the colors, and a crisp comic-book drop shadow at a slightly tilted, playful angle. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a starburst or atomic-orbit motif bursting behind the lettering, boomerang and jukebox accents, on a warm cream or candy-color ground. PALETTE: a saturated candy palette — cherry red, sunshine yellow, turquoise, mint, hot orange and cream — flat and cheerful, never muddy. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (comic halftone, Googie diner chrome, groovy, varsity), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs the outline, halftone, candy color, shadow and the starburst scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters with a thick black keyline outline, flat candy-color fill, a Ben-Day halftone texture and a comic drop shadow, so the retro-pop punch always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits bold and dominant at a slightly tilted playful angle, a starburst or atomic-orbit motif bursting behind it, on a warm cream or candy-color ground with a Ben-Day halftone texture and a few boomerang accents. Cheerful, high-energy mid-century retro-pop poster — jukebox-diner Americana.

description.en: Rose-gold script with soft glitter and flourishing swashes, framed by blush roses and peonies on a dreamy pink bokeh background.
description.ja: 柔らかなラメと伸びやかなスワッシュのローズゴールドの筆記体。ブラッシュピンクのバラと牡丹に囲まれ、夢のようなピンクのボケ背景。
description.zh: 玫瑰金手写体带柔和闪粉和舒展花饰，四周环绕腮红粉玫瑰与牡丹，背景是梦幻的粉色光斑。
description.es: Script en oro rosa con purpurina suave y remates floridos, enmarcado por rosas y peonías rosa rubor sobre un soñador fondo de bokeh rosa.
description.pt: Script em ouro rosé com glitter suave e floreios exuberantes, emoldurado por rosas e peônias rosa-blush sobre um fundo sonhador de bokeh rosa.
description.de: Roségoldene Schreibschrift mit zartem Glitzer und üppigen Schwüngen, gerahmt von zartrosa Rosen und Pfingstrosen vor verträumtem rosa Bokeh.

style_layer.core: a soft, romantic, feminine piece — tender and dreamy. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is finished with delicate romance — fine rose-gold or blush metallic shimmer, soft sparkle highlights, or a gentle satin sheen — refined and pretty, never heavy. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: surrounded by blush rose petals, soft peony and ranunculus blooms, fine sparkle and a dreamy bokeh glow, the tender mood of a love note or Valentine. PALETTE: blush pink, rose, soft coral, champagne and rose-gold with creamy ivory — soft, warm and feminine, never harsh or neon. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (rose-gold script, floral or brush calligraphy, velvet, modern calligraphy, casual hand), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the rose-gold shimmer, the petals-and-bloom scene and the blush palette. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in delicate rose-gold script with soft shimmer, surrounded by blush rose petals and a dreamy glow, so the tender romance always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits soft and graceful in delicate rose-gold with a gentle shimmer, surrounded by blush rose petals and soft peony blooms with a dreamy bokeh glow and fine sparkle. Tender, feminine, romantic Valentine mood.

description.en: Bold capitals wrapped in cognac leather with stitched edges, lit by warm amber light on a dark wood desk beside whiskey glasses.
description.ja: 縁にステッチの入ったコニャック色のレザーで包んだ太い大文字。暗い木の机の上で温かな琥珀色の光を受け、横にはウイスキーグラス。
description.zh: 包裹干邑色皮革、边缘带缝线的粗体大写字母，深色木桌上暖琥珀光照亮，旁边放着威士忌酒杯。
description.es: Mayúsculas gruesas forradas de cuero coñac con bordes cosidos, iluminadas por luz ámbar cálida sobre un escritorio de madera oscura junto a vasos de whisky.
description.pt: Maiúsculas grossas revestidas de couro conhaque com bordas costuradas, iluminadas por luz âmbar quente numa mesa de madeira escura ao lado de copos de uísque.
description.de: Kräftige Versalien, bezogen mit cognacfarbenem Leder und genähten Kanten, im warmen Bernsteinlicht auf dunklem Holzschreibtisch neben Whiskygläsern.

style_layer.core:
Dark masculine prestige atmosphere — backgrounds of deep navy, forest green, aged charcoal, and warm black. A single warm amber key light from upper-right at 35–45 degrees rakes low across the scene, catching every surface relief in sharp definition and casting directional shadows toward the lower-left. Cool blue-grey ambient fill from upper-left creates dimensional depth and secondary shadow detail. Background scene textures stay subordinate: walnut wood grain, aged slate, dark velvet, hand-laid cotton paper — present at edges and corners, never competing with the primary subject. The tonal palette: cognac amber, antique brass, deep burgundy, muted gold — never cold, never pastel. The visual grammar of premium spirits labels, heraldic gift seals, engraved plaques, and heirloom objects made to last.

When no specific surface material is defined by the font: default lighting — warm amber key from upper-right at 40 degrees, cool blue-grey ambient fill from upper-left, near-black background with a faint warm amber glow at depth.
style_layer.scene: Dark aged walnut wood panel background with fine horizontal grain. Warm amber filament-bulb key light from upper-right at 40 degrees, strong directional shadows falling to the lower-left. Small brass corner hardware details. Deep warm atmospheric darkness.

description.en: Roman-style serif capitals carved deep into warm sandstone, V-cut grooves catching amber raking light, with sedimentary grain lines across the rock.
description.ja: 暖かな砂岩に深く彫ったローマン風セリフ体大文字。V字の彫り溝が琥珀色の斜光をとらえ、岩肌には堆積層の筋。
description.zh: 罗马式衬线大写字母深刻在暖色砂岩上，V 形刻槽接住琥珀色斜光，岩面带沉积层纹理。
description.es: Mayúsculas romanas con serifa talladas a fondo en arenisca cálida, con surcos en V que captan la luz ámbar rasante y vetas sedimentarias en la roca.
description.pt: Maiúsculas romanas serifadas entalhadas fundo em arenito quente, com sulcos em V captando a luz âmbar rasante e veios sedimentares na rocha.
description.de: Römische Serifenversalien tief in warmen Sandstein gemeißelt, die V-Kerben fangen bernsteinfarbenes Streiflicht, mit Sedimentschichten im Gestein.

style_layer.core:
Text exists as an irreversible physical mark in ancient earth material — carved stone, incised desert varnish, or painted adobe plaster. Not digitally rendered.

MATERIAL TRACKS:
— Classic Stone / Bas-Relief: warm stone face; iron oxide banding shifts from cream-beige at fresh chisel cuts to amber-ochre across weathered exterior; V-cut groove interiors filled with warm amber shadow; fresh-cut sections reveal lighter stone against darker aged surface — color contrast defines dimensional depth.
— Desert Sandstone: amber-ochre to rose-red stone body; horizontal sedimentary grain lines; micro-pitting from wind erosion; fine quartz sand at letter bases.
— Petroglyph / Varnish Stone: near-black desert varnish patina on rock; scratch channels cut through to pale tan unweathered stone — high contrast between pale interior and dark patina.
— Adobe / Painted Earth: sun-baked buff terracotta plaster; warm red-ochre to burnt sienna pigment; sand aggregate and trowel marks visible through thin paint; hairline drying cracks at pigment edges.

STONE LAWS (all tracks):
— Low-angle raking sidelight from left at 15–25° grazes every surface — reveals grain, carving depth, micro-texture, patina unevenness.
— Geological color palette: cream-beige / amber-ochre / warm sienna / burnt umber / terracotta red / iron brown. No cool tones.
— All surfaces carry age: patina, oxidation staining, erosion pitting, mineral banding.
— Cut and incised sections always expose lighter, fresher material against dark weathered exterior.

FORBIDDEN: neon, digital glow, chrome, smooth modern surfaces, gradient fills, drop shadows, cool tones.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default environment — warm amber raking sidelight from lower-left at 20° angle, deep amber-brown shadow pools in surface recesses, dark desert earth background.
style_layer.scene: Ancient stone or desert rock face as the material ground. Warm raking sidelight from lower-left at a shallow 20° angle — light grazes every carved groove, incised channel, and surface grain; amber-shadow pools fill all recesses, making depth and texture fully legible. Background: near-black or deep warm-brown desert earth, dry dust atmosphere with golden-hour haze. Close examination viewpoint — camera close enough to reveal sedimentary grain lines, micro-pitting, and patina unevenness. Warm ochre-amber-sienna color throughout. No cool tones.

FOOTBALL COLOR SYSTEM: the palette is anchored by the jade-green glow of the illuminated pitch, white-gold stadium floodlight blaze, and bold team-color accents (classic football reds, blues, and greens) — with championship GOLD present as the warm aura of the trophy and the winner's celebration. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own specific color or material for the letterforms (e.g. LED green glow, dark jersey ink with white outline, chrome metallic, gold foil, etc.), that font-defined color takes absolute priority and must be preserved exactly as the font specifies. The selected font's shape and proportions take absolute priority and must be preserved exactly as the font defines them. Do not normalize letterforms to standard broadcast or championship proportions. ATMOSPHERE: regardless of letterform color, football energy fills the background — jade-green pitch glow, white-gold floodlight hazes, team-color light accents, drifting confetti and particle effects — creating the unmistakable electric charge of a big match under the lights. HIGH-CONTRAST BROADCAST QUALITY: maximum saturation, sharp contrast, stadium broadcast energy. MATCHDAY SCALE: a packed stadium, roaring crowd, the biggest game of the season.
style_layer.scene: A floodlit football stadium at the peak of a night match — an 80,000-capacity arena packed to absolute capacity, four-corner stadium floods blazing at maximum output. style_layer.core:
Stencil spray application aesthetic — the visual language of pigment applied through a physical template onto an industrial surface.

SPRAY MEDIUM: paint deposited through a cut template creates the defining edge characteristics — hard inner boundary where stencil material masked the surface, soft outer halo where overspray bled beyond the template edge. Paint density peaks at the center of strokes, thins toward periphery. Drip runs descend from areas of heavy paint application. The spray medium is matte and pigment-dense, completely unlike liquid or digital media.

COLOR REGIME: maximum contrast two-tone palette — the stencil process is inherently binary. Primary combinations: black on concrete grey, military olive on weathered wood, white on rusted metal, warning red on industrial steel. The surface beneath always participates: substrate texture shows through thinner paint coverage, grounding the mark in physical space.

SURFACE CONTEXT: stencil typography implies a physical surface — concrete wall, wooden crate, corrugated metal, canvas fabric. The substrate texture is visible through and around the paint layer, never a neutral void. Surface imperfections coexist naturally with the spray marks.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default spray environment — matte black spray paint on rough concrete grey surface, visible overspray halo at letter edges, slight texture of concrete aggregate showing through paint.
style_layer.scene: Text fills the frame, large and centered on an aged concrete wall surface. Harsh directional light from directly above at a low raking angle, illuminating the surface sharply. Industrial environment — wall texture extends to all frame edges, no soft elements.

style_layer.core: a vivid 1980s synthwave / retrowave world, lit entirely by an impossible neon sunset. PALETTE: hot magenta, electric cyan, sunset orange, deep violet-to-indigo night. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the chosen font carries no material of its own, render the letters as glossy chrome reflecting the sunset gradient — cyan top, magenta middle, orange base — edged with a magenta-and-cyan neon glow, so the synthwave identity always reads.
style_layer.scene: A deep synthwave night receding to a glowing horizon: a neon perspective grid floor runs to a vanishing point where a striped retro sun sits low, a magenta-to-violet gradient sky rises above with scattered stars, distant wireframe mountains or palm-tree silhouettes at the edges. The text sits large and dominant in the upper-center, owning the frame, the horizon line passing behind it. Cinematic 80s retrowave atmosphere — glossy, saturated, nostalgic for a 1980s that never was.

style_layer.core: a warm hand-lettered Teachers' Day greeting card — a complete flat illustrated card design filling the entire frame, not a photograph of a card. GROUND (suggested default, not fixed): lean toward a warm, saturated color filling the frame edge to edge as the card's own ground — a solid sunny yellow, blush pink, sky blue or warm apricot wash. A paler neutral (oat cream, chalk white, pale sage) is acceptable when a scene calls for a quieter register, but is not the automatic default — an all-neutral ground with no other color reads as thin and unfinished. LEGIBILITY (mandatory): unless the chosen font's own treatment names a specific ink color (gold foil, rose gold, chrome, a named color), the lettering must render in a deep tone with strong, clearly readable contrast against whichever ground color is chosen — never a pale or washed-out ink close to the ground's own value.
