LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own named material or color (gold foil, rose-gold, chrome, engraved metal), that treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs only the ground, the palette and the legibility requirement above. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in a warm hand-lettered ink or marker finish, in a deep tone with strong contrast against the ground, so the handmade card feel always reads clearly.
style_layer.scene: The text is the largest, clearest mass in the frame, set in the open middle of the desk with generous empty space around it. The desk objects are arranged behind and to both sides, resting on the surface with soft contact shadows, never printed flat onto the background. Shallow depth of field — nearest objects sharp with visible surface texture, the far edge of the arrangement softening. Background: a pale oat-cream wall or paper backdrop catching the window light.

description.en: Monospaced slab-serif type struck into cream paper, with uneven ink density, ribbon texture, faint letter misalignment and soft paper fibers.
description.ja: クリーム色の紙に打ち込まれた等幅スラブセリフ。インクの濃淡のむら、リボンの質感、わずかな文字のずれ、柔らかな紙の繊維。
description.zh: 等宽板衬线字敲印在米色纸上，墨色深浅不均，可见色带纹理和轻微错位，纸纤维柔和。
description.es: Tipos slab monoespaciados golpeados sobre papel crema, con densidad de tinta irregular, textura de cinta, leve desalineación y suaves fibras de papel.
description.pt: Tipos slab monoespaçados batidos em papel creme, com densidade de tinta irregular, textura de fita, leve desalinhamento e fibras de papel suaves.
description.de: Nichtproportionale Slab-Schrift, in cremefarbenes Papier getippt, mit ungleichmäßiger Tintendichte, Farbbandstruktur, leichtem Versatz und weichen Papierfasern.

style_layer.core: Monospaced typewriter letterforms with authentic mechanical key-strike impressions. Uneven ink distribution — some strokes darker, some lighter, ink thicker at stroke terminals. Aged cream bond paper surface with subtle fiber texture. Vintage manual-typewriter aesthetic. Warm sepia-tinted black ink. Slightly irregular baseline alignment, individual letter spacing imperfections. Visible ribbon texture on letterforms. Clean vintage typewriter quality.
style_layer.scene: Clean warm cream paper texture background, subtle paper grain visible. Soft side lighting casting gentle shadow from letterforms onto paper surface. No scene elements, no props, no decorations. Pure typography showcase.

description.en: Chrome block capitals in pastel pink and cyan, floating over a checkerboard floor beside a marble bust, palms and small katakana text.
description.ja: パステルピンクとシアンのクロームのブロック体大文字。市松模様の床の上に浮かび、大理石の胸像、ヤシ、小さなカタカナが添えられます。
description.zh: 粉彩粉与青色的铬金属方块大写字母，悬浮在棋盘格地面上方，旁边是大理石胸像、棕榈和小号片假名。
description.es: Mayúsculas de bloque cromadas en rosa pastel y cian, flotando sobre un suelo de damero junto a un busto de mármol, palmeras y pequeño texto en katakana.
description.pt: Maiúsculas em bloco cromadas em rosa pastel e ciano, flutuando sobre um piso xadrez ao lado de um busto de mármore, palmeiras e pequeno texto em katakana.
description.de: Chrom-Blockversalien in Pastellrosa und Cyan, schwebend über einem Schachbrettboden neben einer Marmorbüste, Palmen und kleinem Katakana-Text.

style_layer.core: a 1990s vaporwave dreamscape — the glow of an early consumer CRT. LIGHT & COLOR: a soft low-saturation pastel palette of cotton-candy pink, soft cyan-teal and lilac-purple, lit like a 1990s desktop-wallpaper sunset, gentle and dreamy rather than high-contrast neon. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a classical marble Roman bust, an early-3D perspective checkerboard grid receding to a pastel horizon, palm silhouettes, and decorative fullwidth letters and Japanese katakana floating as accents. TEXTURE: a soft VHS layer over everything — horizontal scanlines, gentle tracking lines, magenta-cyan chromatic-aberration bleed and analog haze. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own material (pastel chrome, fullwidth gradient, VHS glitch, Y2K silver), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style governs the pastel light, the marble-and-grid scene and the VHS texture. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in a soft pink-to-cyan vaporwave gradient with a gentle bloom and a drifting VHS scanline, so the vaporwave aesthetic always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits large and dominant in the center of a 1990s vaporwave dreamscape — a soft pink-and-cyan pastel gradient sky over an early-3D checkerboard grid receding to the horizon, a classical marble bust to one side, palm silhouettes and a katakana accent drifting in a corner, soft VHS scanlines and tracking lines across everything. Dreamy, nostalgic, lo-fi 90s aesthetic.

description.en: Norse Viking runic typography with carved stone textures, Nordic knotwork patterns, battle-worn metallic finishes and ancient Scandinavian aesthetics.
description.ja: 彫り込まれた石のテクスチャ、北欧のノットワーク模様、戦いで傷んだ金属の質感、そして古代スカンジナビアの美意識をまとった、北欧バイキングのルーン文字タイポグラフィです。
description.zh: 北欧维京符文字体，凿刻石纹、北欧绳结图案、饱经战火的金属质感，满满的古斯堪的纳维亚气息。
description.es: Tipografía rúnica vikinga nórdica con texturas de piedra tallada, patrones de nudos nórdicos, acabados metálicos curtidos en batalla y una estética escandinava ancestral.
description.pt: Tipografia rúnica viking nórdica com texturas de pedra entalhada, padrões de nós nórdicos, acabamentos metálicos marcados pela batalha e uma estética escandinava ancestral.
description.de: Nordische Wikinger Schrift mit Runen-Typografie, gemeißelten Steintexturen, nordischen Knotenmustern, kampferprobten Metalloberflächen und uralter skandinavischer Ästhetik.

style_layer.core:
ancient Norse warrior aesthetic — stark angular geometry, battle-forged weight, the material permanence of things built to outlast kingdoms. Directional forge-light or cold torch-light that sculpts every letterform face into high relief. Color palette: iron-grey, aged bronze, cold granite, dark amber — no soft pastels, no unmotivated gradients. Every letter reads as an object with real physical mass.

When no specific material is defined by the font: default to battle-worn dark iron — cold charcoal-grey letter body with visible forge-hammer surface texture, narrow cold specular highlight on the upper stroke edge, deep iron shadow on the underside, hairline stress-fracture lines along diagonal strokes. The Norse blacksmith's iron: heavy, angular, built for war.
style_layer.scene: Dramatic overcast sky, cold blue-gray atmosphere, torch fire lighting casting warm flickering highlights, ancient Scandinavian landscape.

description.en: Angular runic-style capitals made only of straight and 45-degree strokes, carved into cold steel-grey stone under an aurora night sky.
description.ja: 直線と45度の斜線だけで組んだ角ばったルーン風大文字。オーロラの夜空の下、冷たい鋼灰色の石に彫られています。
description.zh: 只用直线和 45 度斜线构成的棱角符文风大写字母，刻在冷钢灰色的石头上，头顶是极光夜空。
description.es: Mayúsculas angulares de estilo rúnico hechas solo con trazos rectos y a 45 grados, talladas en piedra gris acero fría bajo un cielo nocturno con aurora.
description.pt: Maiúsculas angulares de estilo rúnico feitas só com traços retos e a 45 graus, entalhadas em pedra cinza-aço fria sob um céu noturno com aurora.
description.de: Kantige Versalien im Runenstil aus ausschließlich geraden und 45-Grad-Strichen, in kalten stahlgrauen Stein gehauen unter einem Nachthimmel mit Polarlicht.

style_layer.core: rendered in Elder Futhark runic letterforms — all strokes constructed from straight segments at horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree diagonal angles only; no curves anywhere, angular geometry derived from the physical constraint of carving into stone with a straight blade. Tall narrow proportions, strong vertical emphasis, sharp pointed terminals where strokes meet. Each stroke presents a flat angular face — illuminated and shadow faces alternate across the word creating the faceted highlight pattern of hand-carved letters. Pure runic geometry, powerfully ancient.
style_layer.scene: flat dark slate surface, cold directional light from upper left casting clean sharp shadows, minimal composition, pure black background

description.en: Serif capitals letterpress-bitten into cream cotton card with slightly broken ink, set on an old press bed among scattered metal type.
description.ja: インクがわずかにかすれる活版でクリーム色のコットンカードに押し込んだセリフ体大文字。古い印刷機の版盤に置かれ、金属活字が散らばります。
description.zh: 衬线大写字母凸版压印进米色棉卡纸，墨色略有破损，放在旧印刷机台面上，周围散落金属活字。
description.es: Mayúsculas con serifa impresas en tipografía sobre cartulina de algodón crema con la tinta ligeramente quebrada, sobre la platina de una vieja prensa entre tipos metálicos sueltos.
description.pt: Maiúsculas serifadas impressas em tipografia sobre cartão de algodão creme com a tinta levemente falhada, sobre a mesa de uma velha prensa entre tipos de metal soltos.
description.de: Serifenversalien im Buchdruck in cremefarbenen Baumwollkarton gepresst, mit leicht ausbrechender Farbe, auf dem Fundament einer alten Presse zwischen verstreuten Bleilettern.

style_layer.core: a timeless vintage piece carrying the physical evidence of an older making — warm, aged and classic. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering looks produced by a heritage craft and softened by time — a letterpress impression bitten into cotton paper with ink slightly broken up, weathered paint on aged metal or wood, a worn rubber-stamp or postal imprint, or warm gold leaf — carrying patina, foxing, grain and gentle wear. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a warm nostalgic setting — aged cream or kraft paper, dark wood, soft amber light, faint dust and a faded heritage feel. PALETTE: warm aged tones — cream, kraft, sepia, faded red, forest green, navy, tan and antique gold — muted and time-softened, never neon-bright. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (western slab, art deco, art nouveau, letterpress, postal or rubber stamp, gold leaf, typewriter, hand-lettered script, grunge chalk), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letters; this style supplies the warm aged tone, the time-worn surface and the nostalgic heritage scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as a classic serif printed in warm faded ink on aged cream paper with a soft letterpress impression and gentle wear, so the timeless vintage feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits bold and classic, printed or worn onto an aged surface — cream or kraft paper, weathered wood, or old painted metal — under warm amber light, with soft dust, foxing and the gentle patina of age. Timeless, nostalgic heritage mood.

names.ja: ヴィンテージ クリスマス

description.en: Old printed holiday scenes of red houses, snowy hills, sleds and starry skies in faded cherry red, teal and cream on aged card stock with slight misregistration.
description.ja: 赤い家、雪の丘、そり、星空を描いた昔の印刷物のようなホリデー風景。色あせたチェリーレッド、ティール、クリーム色を、経年した厚紙にわずかな版ズレとともに刷ったスタイル。
description.zh: 老式印刷的节日画面：红房子、雪山坡、雪橇和星空，褪色的樱桃红、青绿和奶油色印在泛黄卡纸上，带一点套色错位。
description.es: Viejas escenas navideñas impresas con casas rojas, colinas nevadas, trineos y cielos estrellados en rojo cereza, verde azulado y crema desgastados sobre cartulina envejecida, con un ligero desfase de color.
description.pt: Antigas cenas natalinas impressas com casinhas vermelhas, colinas nevadas, trenós e céus estrelados em vermelho-cereja, verde-azulado e creme desbotados sobre papel-cartão envelhecido, com um leve desencontro de cores.
description.de: Alte gedruckte Weihnachtsszenen mit roten Häusern, verschneiten Hügeln, Schlitten und Sternenhimmel in verblasstem Kirschrot, Petrol und Creme auf gealtertem Karton, mit leichtem Passerversatz.

style_layer.core: a vintage Christmas card, wallpaper, poster or illustration that looks like a greeting someone kept in a box for decades. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: illustrated holiday scenes in the manner of old printed cards - little red houses on snowy hills, stylised pine trees, children on a sled, a church steeple, a starry night sky, bells, holly and robins - drawn as flat painted shapes with simple outlines and printed-looking edges; the greeting is set into the scene like the title of an old card, often on a banner, a label shape or a sky band. LIGHT: flat, even printed light with painted-in highlights; no realistic photographic shading. COLOUR: a limited retro palette of cherry red, teal or pine green, mustard and cream, slightly faded; never neon. TEXTURE: aged cream card stock, fine paper grain, slight misregistration of the colour layers, a little glitter on the snow, softly worn corners. TIERS: the mid-century tier is a 1950s card with teal skies, red houses, flat shapes and atomic stars; the Victorian ephemera tier uses ornate gilt borders, sepia and deep red, engraving-like detail, robins and bells. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the retro palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the illustrated scene, the limited palette and the aged paper always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on aged cream card under flat printed light with a faded retro palette.

names.ja: レトロ ハロウィン

description.en: Old Halloween postcards and paper decorations: grinning jack-o-lanterns, arched black cats and moon faces printed in orange, black and cream on aged card, or a sheet ghost in an old gilt-framed oil painting.
description.ja: 昔のハロウィンのポストカードや紙の飾り。にやりと笑うジャック・オー・ランタン、背を丸めた黒猫、月の顔を、オレンジ、黒、クリームの3色で黄ばんだ厚紙に刷ったもの。または金の額縁に入った古い油絵のシーツおばけ。
description.zh: 老式万圣节明信片和纸质装饰：咧嘴南瓜灯、弓背黑猫和月亮脸，用橙、黑、奶油三色印在泛黄卡纸上；或是一幅金框老油画里的床单小幽灵。
description.es: Viejas postales y adornos de papel de Halloween: calabazas sonrientes, gatos negros arqueados y lunas con cara impresos en naranja, negro y crema sobre cartulina amarillenta, o un fantasma de sábana en un viejo óleo con marco dorado.
description.pt: Antigos cartões-postais e enfeites de papel de Halloween: abóboras sorridentes, gatos pretos arqueados e luas com rosto impressos em laranja, preto e creme sobre papel-cartão amarelado, ou um fantasma de lençol numa velha pintura a óleo com moldura dourada.
description.de: Alte Halloween-Postkarten und Papierdekorationen: grinsende Kürbislaternen, buckelnde schwarze Katzen und Mondgesichter in Orange, Schwarz und Creme auf vergilbtem Karton, oder ein Bettlakengespenst in einem alten Ölgemälde mit Goldrahmen.

style_layer.core: a vintage Halloween card, postcard, poster or framed print that looks like something found in grandma's attic. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: the layout of 1930s-1950s paper Halloween decorations and postcards - grinning jack-o-lanterns, arched black cats, smiling crescent-moon faces, owls on branches, witches on broomsticks, bats and autumn leaves, drawn as flat printed shapes with simple dark outlines, often framed by an arch, a scalloped label or a ribbon banner that holds the words. LIGHT: flat printed light, shading made only with flat colour shapes and halftone dots; the oil-painting tier uses dim moonlight and a faint candle glow. COLOUR: a limited print palette of pumpkin orange, black and cream, with olive green or old red in only one or two places; never neon. TEXTURE: aged yellowed card, coarse halftone dots, slightly misregistered colour plates, soft creases and worn corners; in the oil-painting tier, cracked oil paint, yellowed varnish and a chipped gilt frame. TIERS: the printed-decoration tier is a 1950s die-cut decoration, party invitation, poster or greeting postcard; the antique oil-painting tier is an old landscape painting of a moonlit farm or field with a friendly sheet ghost painted in, in a worn gilt frame. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the print palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the old decoration motifs, the limited palette and the aged paper or old canvas always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on aged cream card under flat printed light in orange and black.

description.en: Serif capitals filled with transparent watercolor washes and small floral sprigs, white paper glowing through, on deckled cold-press paper beside a paint palette.
description.ja: 透明な水彩のにじみと小さな草花で満たしたセリフ体大文字。白い紙が光のように透け、耳付きのコールドプレス紙に、横にはパレット。
description.zh: 衬线大写字母填满透明水彩晕染和小花枝，白纸透出光亮，写在毛边冷压水彩纸上，旁边是调色盘。
description.es: Mayúsculas con serifa rellenas de aguadas transparentes de acuarela y pequeñas ramitas florales, con el papel blanco brillando a través, sobre papel prensado en frío de borde irregular junto a una paleta.
description.pt: Maiúsculas serifadas preenchidas com aguadas transparentes de aquarela e pequenos raminhos florais, com o papel branco brilhando através, sobre papel prensado a frio de borda irregular ao lado de uma paleta.
description.de: Serifenversalien gefüllt mit transparenten Aquarelllasuren und kleinen Blütenzweigen, das weiße Papier scheint durch, auf büttenrandigem Kaltpresspapier neben einem Farbkasten.

style_layer.core: a luminous transparent watercolor world painted on paper. LIGHT & GROUND: soft even north-light falls on cold-press watercolor paper whose bright unpainted white is the lightest value in the frame — highlights are the bare paper itself, never painted white. SURFACE: transparent washes let the paper glow through; pigment disperses unevenly, pooling darker along edges while centers stay pale, with soft wet-on-wet cauliflower blooms where wet meets wet and crisp hard edges where paint dried on dry paper — the signature soft/hard tension. TEXTURE: cold-press paper tooth flecks the washes with tiny bare-white gaps and heavier pigment granulates into the grain. PALETTE: a transparent fine-art aquarelle palette — sap and olive green, rose madder and blush, cobalt and cerulean blue, indigo, raw sienna — always luminous and layered, never opaque. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own material or color (botanical floral sprigs, ink-in-water diffusion, expressive splatter, line-and-wash ink, etc.), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letter surface; this style then governs only the paper, light and surrounding color atmosphere. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, paint the letters as transparent wet-on-wet watercolor washes — pale luminous centers, pigment pooling and blooming at the edges, the white paper breathing through — so the watercolor identity always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits large and centered on a sheet of fine cold-press watercolor paper, the bright paper breathing around it as generous negative space, a faint deckled torn edge and a soft cool shadow grounding the sheet. A few loose botanical sprigs and drifting pigment specks rest softly nearby. Calm, luminous, gallery-quality fine-art painting composition with plenty of white paper.

description.en: Loose wet-on-wet watercolor winter scenes of snowy villages, pines and hills in slate blue, sage and brick red, fading into white cold-press paper.
description.ja: にじみを生かしたウェット・オン・ウェットの冬の水彩画。雪の村、もみの木、丘をスレートブルー、セージ、レンガ色で描き、白い中目の水彩紙へ溶けこませます。
description.zh: 湿画法晕染的冬日水彩：雪中村庄、松树和山丘，石板蓝、灰绿和砖红，边缘渐渐淡入白色冷压水彩纸。
description.es: Escenas invernales en acuarela suelta, húmedo sobre húmedo: pueblos nevados, pinos y colinas en azul pizarra, salvia y rojo ladrillo que se funden en papel blanco de grano fino.
description.pt: Cenas de inverno em aquarela solta, molhado sobre molhado: vilas nevadas, pinheiros e colinas em azul-ardósia, verde-sálvia e vermelho-tijolo que se dissolvem no papel branco prensado a frio.
description.de: Locker nass in nass gemalte Winterszenen in Aquarell: verschneite Dörfer, Tannen und Hügel in Schieferblau, Salbei und Ziegelrot, die in weißes, kaltgepresstes Papier auslaufen.

style_layer.core: a hand-painted watercolor Christmas card, clipart, illustration or wallpaper that looks painted by an illustrator for a stationery shop. GRAPHIC LANGUAGE: a loose watercolor winter scene - a row of little Christmas village houses with glowing windows, snowy pine trees, a church, a stone bridge, soft hills and falling snow - painted wet-on-wet with soft bleeding edges and fine ink-free brushwork, sitting in the lower part of the picture or in a soft vignette, with generous white paper left around the words; clipart pieces stand alone on white paper. LIGHT: soft, cold winter daylight with warm golden light glowing from the windows. COLOUR: muted winter tones - slate blue, sage and pine green, warm brick red and ochre - on white or cream paper; colour fades out into the paper at the edges. TEXTURE: visible cold-press watercolor paper grain, pigment blooms and granulation, a few white gouache snow dots. TIERS: the cosy village tier has houses, warm windows and red accents; the quiet snowscape tier has pines, hills and a frozen stream in mostly blue and white. LETTERFORM COLOR PRIORITY: if the selected font defines its own letterform colour or material, that takes absolute priority; the muted winter palette colours the letters only when the font does not specify. ATMOSPHERE: the painted winter scene, the white paper and the soft cold light always appear around the words regardless of letterform colour. When no specific material is defined by the font: default lighting - the words sit on white cold-press paper above a painted snowy village.

description.en: Gold-foil serif with soft script flourishes on warm ivory cotton paper with a deckled edge, blush roses and eucalyptus in one corner.
description.ja: 暖かなアイボリーの耳付きコットン紙に金箔のセリフ体と柔らかな筆記体の飾り。隅にはブラッシュピンクのバラとユーカリ。
description.zh: 暖象牙色毛边棉纸上的烫金衬线字，配柔和手写花饰，一角点缀腮红玫瑰与尤加利叶。
description.es: Serifa en lámina dorada con suaves adornos caligráficos sobre papel de algodón marfil cálido de borde irregular, con rosas rubor y eucalipto en una esquina.
description.pt: Serifa em folha dourada com floreios caligráficos suaves sobre papel de algodão marfim quente de borda irregular, com rosas blush e eucalipto num canto.
description.de: Goldfolien-Serifen mit sanften kalligrafischen Schwüngen auf warmem elfenbeinfarbenem Baumwollpapier mit Büttenrand, zartrosa Rosen und Eukalyptus in einer Ecke.

style_layer.core: the hushed luxury of a fine wedding suite. GROUND: warm ivory, cream and champagne cotton paper with a soft deckled edge, or a tone-on-tone neutral stock. LIGHT: soft daylight with a gentle directional rake across the surface — enough to strike a bright specular flash along the gilded strokes so the metal reads rich, not flat. FINISH: where the lettering catches light it reads as rich gold-leaf foil and warm metallic gold ink — deep saturated antique gold and warm yellow-gold with a bright specular highlight on one edge and a darker gold shadow on the other for real metallic depth (champagne only as a soft secondary tone, never the whole gold); elsewhere it reads as letterpress and blind-emboss, pressed crisply into the paper so the strokes sit slightly below the surface with a soft debossed shadow. ORNAMENT: delicate botanical accents — eucalyptus, roses, peonies in fine line or soft watercolor — kept sparing, framing not flooding. PALETTE: ivory and cream base, rich warm antique gold and gold-leaf (saturated, not pale), with champagne, sage and eucalyptus green, dusty blue, and forest-green or navy as a deep old-money accent; generous negative space and lightness throughout. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own material or color (gold foil, rose-gold, letterpress emboss, watercolor, velvet), that font treatment takes absolute priority and owns the letter surface; this style governs only the paper, light, ornament and surrounding palette. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters in rich warm gold-leaf metallic ink on ivory paper with a bright specular highlight and a whisper of letterpress impression, so the premium wedding feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits centered with generous airy spacing on a sheet of warm ivory cotton paper with a soft deckled edge, the quiet focal point of a fine wedding suite. A few delicate botanical sprigs — eucalyptus, a blush rose or two — frame one corner, never crowding. Soft diffused daylight, a faint debossed shadow and a whisper of gold catching the light. Calm, luxurious, editorial wedding-stationery composition with plenty of negative space.

description.en: Weathered red-painted slab and wood-type capitals on a sun-bleached plank sign, with rope and horseshoe details on a dusty saloon porch.
description.ja: 日に焼けた板の看板に描かれた、風化した赤塗りのスラブセリフとウッドタイプの大文字。ロープと蹄鉄を添えて、砂ぼこりの酒場のポーチに。
description.zh: 风化的红漆板衬线与木活字大写字母，写在日晒褪色的木板招牌上，配绳索和马蹄铁，背景是尘土飞扬的酒馆门廊。
description.es: Mayúsculas slab y de tipo de madera pintadas de rojo y desgastadas sobre un letrero de tablas descolorido por el sol, con cuerda y herradura en un porche polvoriento de saloon.
description.pt: Maiúsculas slab e de tipo de madeira pintadas de vermelho e desgastadas numa placa de tábuas desbotada pelo sol, com corda e ferradura numa varanda empoeirada de saloon.
description.de: Verwitterte rot bemalte Slab- und Holzletter-Versalien auf einem sonnengebleichten Bretterschild, mit Seil und Hufeisen auf einer staubigen Saloon-Veranda.

style_layer.core: a rugged Old West frontier piece — weathered, hand-made and dusty. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering looks made on the 19th-century frontier — bold western slab or ornamental wood-type forms carved and painted on weathered timber, branded into leather or wood, or letterpressed in heavy ink on aged kraft paper — with sun-bleaching, grain, chisel marks and gentle wear. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a warm desert-sun frontier setting — a dusty saloon porch, ranch timber, old rope and a horseshoe, golden-hour light. PALETTE: warm earth tones — sun-bleached cream, barn red, tan, leather brown, faded ochre and charcoal ink — dusty and weathered, never neon or glossy. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (western slab, Clarendon or geometric slab, weathered wood plank, wanted-poster wood type, worn typewriter), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the weathered wood / leather / aged-paper material, the dusty frontier scene and the warm earth palette. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as bold western slab carved and painted on a sun-bleached weathered wood plank with chisel marks and faded paint, so the Wild West frontier feel always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits bold and weathered, carved and painted on sun-bleached frontier timber or letterpressed on aged paper, under warm desert golden-hour light with dust in the air, an old rope, a horseshoe and a saloon porch softly out of focus. Rugged, nostalgic Wild West frontier mood.

description.en: Year 2000 nostalgia aesthetics — chrome bubbles, holographic gradients, liquid metal, and bubbly pink. The signature visual language of the early internet era.
description.ja: 西暦2000年のノスタルジーを漂わせる美学——クロームのバブル、ホログラフィックなグラデーション、リキッドメタル、そしてぷるんとしたピンク。インターネット黎明期を象徴するビジュアル言語です。
description.zh: 千禧年怀旧美学——镀铬气泡、全息渐变、液态金属，还有软糯的泡泡粉。早期互联网时代的标志性视觉语言。
description.es: Estética nostálgica del año 2000: burbujas de cromo, degradados holográficos, metal líquido y rosa chicle. El lenguaje visual icónico de los primeros años de internet.
description.pt: Estética nostálgica do ano 2000: bolhas de cromo, degradês holográficos, metal líquido e rosa chiclete. A linguagem visual icônica dos primeiros anos da internet.
description.de: Nostalgie-Ästhetik des Jahres 2000 — Chrom-Blasen, holografische Verläufe, Flüssigmetall und sprudelndes Pink. Die charakteristische Bildsprache des frühen Internetzeitalters, ganz im Stil einer Y2K-Schrift.

style_layer.core: a nostalgic early-2000s Y2K aesthetic piece — glossy, futuristic and playful. SURFACE / STYLE: the lettering is finished in signature Y2K materials — hyper-reflective liquid chrome and electroplated silver, iridescent holographic foil, or glossy inflated candy bubbles — with mirror reflections, prismatic color shifts and soft pillowy volume. SCENE ATMOSPHERE: a millennium-party mood — iridescent star stickers, frosted gradients, soft studio glow, the optimistic gloss of the early internet era. PALETTE: bubblegum pink, electric lavender, cyan and silver chrome with prismatic holographic shimmer — high-saturation millennium candy, never muted or aged. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment (Y2K chrome bubble, electroplated silver, holographic foil, liquid metal, inflated bubble, pixel mono), that font's letterform takes priority and owns the letters; this style governs the glossy chrome / holo / bubble material, the prismatic color and the millennium-party scene. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as glossy liquid chrome with pink-blue-lavender iridescent reflections and a soft inflated bubble volume on a light prismatic ground, so the Y2K millennium gloss always reads.
style_layer.scene: The text sits glossy and dominant in liquid chrome, holographic foil or inflated candy bubbles, prismatic pink-blue-lavender reflections shifting across it, set against an iridescent millennium backdrop with star-sticker sparkle and a soft studio glow. Optimistic, nostalgic early-2000s Y2K energy.

description.en: Y2K bubbly inflated letters — round pillow-soft inflated forms in pastel pink-purple with glossy candy surface. Sweet 2000s party girl aesthetic.
description.ja: Y2K バブリーの膨らんだ文字。パステルのピンクからパープルへ、ぷっくりと丸く柔らかな膨張フォルムに、ツヤのあるキャンディ質感を組み合わせました。2000年代のスウィートなパーティーガール美学です。
description.zh: Y2K 泡泡充气字母——圆润柔软的充气造型，粉紫马卡龙配色，糖果光泽表面。甜甜的 2000 年代派对女孩风。
description.es: Letras infladas estilo Y2K: formas redondas suaves como almohadas en rosa y morado pastel con superficie brillante de caramelo. Estética dulce de chica fiestera de los 2000.
description.pt: Letras infladas estilo Y2K: formas redondas e macias como travesseiro em rosa e roxo pastel com superfície brilhante de bala. Estética doce de garota festeira dos anos 2000.
description.de: Y2K-typische, aufgeblasene Bubbly-Buchstaben — runde, kissenweiche Formen in pastelligem Pink-Violett mit glänzender Bonbon-Oberfläche. Süße 2000er-Party-Girl-Ästhetik als bubbly Schrift.

style_layer.core: Y2K bubbly inflated letters — extremely round pillow-soft letter forms completely inflated like over-pressurized balloons. Pastel pink-to-lavender gradient across the glossy candy surface. Strong white specular highlight on the top of each inflated letter. Extremely smooth and soft surface. Sweet 2000s Y2K party aesthetic. Maximum bubbly inflation quality. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the over-inflated pillow form, the glossy candy surface and the speculars. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as extremely round over-inflated pillow letters with an ultra-smooth glossy candy surface and a strong white top specular. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise a pastel pink-to-lavender gradient.
style_layer.scene: Pastel dreamy backdrop in soft cotton candy pink fading to lavender, scattered tiny star confetti, warm diffused soft-box lighting.

description.en: Puffy chrome capitals with iridescent rainbow reflections in pink, green and blue, glowing softly on a bright white-to-pastel background.
description.ja: ピンク、グリーン、ブルーの虹色反射をまとったふっくらしたクロームの大文字。明るい白からパステルの背景で柔らかく光ります。
description.zh: 鼓胀的铬金属大写字母映出粉、绿、蓝的彩虹镭射反光，在明亮的白到粉彩背景上柔和发光。
description.es: Mayúsculas cromadas abombadas con reflejos iridiscentes de arcoíris en rosa, verde y azul, brillando suavemente sobre un fondo luminoso de blanco a pastel.
description.pt: Maiúsculas cromadas infladas com reflexos iridescentes de arco-íris em rosa, verde e azul, brilhando suavemente sobre um fundo claro do branco ao pastel.
description.de: Aufgeblähte Chromversalien mit irisierenden Regenbogenreflexen in Pink, Grün und Blau, sanft leuchtend vor einem hellen Hintergrund von Weiß bis Pastell.

style_layer.core: Hyper-reflective mirror-polished chrome surface with the extreme specular quality of electroplated Y2K metallic aesthetics. Vivid prismatic color-map distortions across the chrome: vivid magenta, deep cobalt blue, acid green, molten orange — high-saturation color zones with razor-sharp boundaries between each hue band, warped by the convex mirror surface. Prismatic spectral splitting at color zone edges creates ultra-thin rainbow lines. Absolute mirror reflectivity — zero surface roughness. Dominant white specular flare at peak convex points. The visual language of Y2K chrome fashion accessories, millennium pop star album art, and iridescent chrome street art at maximum saturation. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the mirror-chrome surface, the prismatic color-map distortion and the razor speculars. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as hyper-reflective mirror-polished chrome with vivid prismatic color zones (magenta, cobalt blue, acid green, molten orange) and a dominant white specular flare. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise high-saturation prismatic chrome with razor-sharp hue bands.
style_layer.scene: Soft silver-white studio gradient background. Diffused multi-color ambient light from multiple directions: warm pink from left, electric blue from right, subtle mint from below. The bright environment floods the chrome surface with vivid color reflections. Single key light from above creates a dominant highlight pool. Atmosphere: premium studio product photography, millennium nostalgia.

names.ja: Y2K ホログラフィック

description.en: Y2K holographic gradient letters — vivid pink-purple-cyan iridescent surface with starbursts and holographic foil shimmer. Iconic millennium party aesthetic.
description.ja: Y2Kのホログラフィックなグラデーション文字。鮮やかなピンク・パープル・シアンが虹色に輝く表面に、スターバーストとホログラフィック箔のきらめきを重ねます。ミレニアム期を象徴するパーティーの美意識です。
description.zh: Y2K 全息渐变字体——粉紫青虹彩流光表面，点缀星芒和全息箔片微光。经典的千禧派对美学。
description.es: Letras con degradado holográfico Y2K: superficie iridiscente rosa-morado-cian con destellos de estrella y brillo de foil holográfico. La estética icónica de fiesta del milenio.
description.pt: Letras com degradê holográfico Y2K: superfície iridescente rosa-roxo-ciano com estrelas brilhantes e brilho de foil holográfico. A estética icônica de festa do milênio.
description.de: Y2K-holografische Verlaufsbuchstaben — leuchtend pink-violett-cyanfarbene, schillernde Oberfläche mit Sternexplosionen und holografischem Folienschimmer. Diese y2k schrift bringt die ikonische Millennium-Party-Ästhetik zurück.

style_layer.core: Y2K holographic gradient letters — vivid iridescent surface shifting from hot pink to electric purple to cyan blue. Holographic foil shimmer quality. Small starburst sparkle accents around letter edges. Early 2000s party poster aesthetic. Saturated millennium color palette. Premium holographic foil quality. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the holographic-foil shimmer, the iridescent gradient and the sparkle accents. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as vivid iridescent holographic-foil letters shifting hot pink to electric purple to cyan blue with small starburst sparkles. COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise the saturated millennium pink-purple-cyan iridescence.
style_layer.scene: Dark holographic backdrop with scattered light prism effects, faint rainbow light streaks fanning outward from the edges of the frame.

description.en: Y2K liquid chrome letters — flowing organic metallic forms with chrome liquid drips and fluid body deformation. The iconic liquid metal aesthetic of the 2000s.
description.ja: Y2K リキッドクロームの文字 — 流れるような有機的メタリック形状で、クロームの液だれと本体の流動的な変形が特徴です。2000年代を象徴するリキッドメタルの美学です。
description.zh: Y2K 液态铬金属字体——流动的有机金属造型，带铬液滴落和字身流体形变。千禧年那种标志性的液态金属美学。
description.es: Letras de cromo líquido Y2K: formas metálicas orgánicas que fluyen, con goteos de cromo líquido y deformación fluida del cuerpo. La estética icónica del metal líquido de los 2000.
description.pt: Letras de cromo líquido Y2K: formas metálicas orgânicas que escorrem, com gotas de cromo líquido e deformação fluida do corpo. A estética icônica do metal líquido dos anos 2000.
description.de: Y2K-Fluessigchrom-Buchstaben — fliessende organische Metallformen mit Chrom-Fluessigtropfen und fluider Koerperverformung. Diese y2k Schrift bringt die ikonische Fluessigmetall-Aesthetik der 2000er.

style_layer.core: Y2K liquid chrome surface — mirror-polished metallic liquid caught mid-pour, frozen in time. Surface shows viscous flow lines and mercury-like surface tension. Chrome liquid drips extend from letter bases, tapered to fine suspended points, still stretching under gravity. Color: cool silver base with shifting pink-blue-lavender iridescent reflections across the curved liquid surface — the Y2K-era chrome fantasy, not realistic mercury. Soft gradient environment light (pale pink, ice blue, silver white) bounces off the liquid surfaces, creating color-shifting highlights. Background: light-to-mid-tone gradient — soft silver-white, pale pink, or lavender mist — never pure black, which kills the iridescent color reflections. Photorealistic liquid metal rendering. LETTERFORM PRIORITY: when the chosen font carries its own treatment, that font's letterform shapes take priority and own the letters; this style governs the liquid-chrome material, the viscous flow and drips and the iridescent reflections. FALLBACK MATERIAL: if the font carries no material of its own, render the letters as mirror-polished liquid-chrome letters caught mid-pour with tapered chrome drips and pink-blue-lavender iridescence on a soft light gradient (never pure black). COLOR PRIORITY: keep the font's own colors if specified; otherwise a cool silver base with shifting pink-blue-lavender iridescent reflections.
style_layer.scene: Soft silver-white studio gradient background, two-point colored environment lighting: warm pale pink from left, cool ice-blue from right. Letter surfaces catch both colors in shifting iridescent bands across the liquid chrome. Chrome drip points hang below letter bases, catching the pink-blue light split. Minimal, clean, maximum liquid material focus.
